jobs.title: Head of Engineering
jobs.description:
The Opportunity

Atrom Mindcare is building the next generation of mental healthcare delivery. We're a UK based Mental Healthcare provider operating at the intersection of NHS, insurance, and private care, with a clear thesis: that mental healthcare can be delivered more thoughtfully, more efficiently, and at a higher quality than the legacy systems most of the sector still relies on.
We're now looking for a Senior Engineering Lead to help us build the platform that makes this possible.

What we are building

We're on a mission to make the patient journey smoother and swifter while also enabling the clinicians to be able to make full use of technology to deliver high standards of care - a unified seamless platform that:
•       Handles the full referral lifecycle from intake to clinical decision
•       Uses AI thoughtfully — to augment clinical and administrative judgement, not replace it
•       Maintains rigorous audit trails and meets the highest standards of healthcare data protection
•       Integrates with existing (internal and external) clinical systems rather than replacing them
•       Scales as we grow without losing the careful clinical attention that defines good mental healthcare

Some foundational work is already in place. The next phase needs someone who can take this from "good start" to "real platform."

The Role

You'll be the Business and technical voice at Atrom — owning the architecture, leading the build, and shaping where the platform goes next. This isn't a job where someone hands you a detailed spec. It's a role where you help define what we're building, then make it real.

Your work will include:
•       Architecture and direction — making the strategic technical decisions that determine what's possible
•       Hands-on delivery — you'll build significant components yourself, not just direct others
•       Quality and standards — establishing how we build, test, secure, and ship
•       Healthcare context — understanding what makes clinical software different from generic SaaS
•       Working with founders — directly with the CEO (operational strategy) and Clinical Director (medical reality)

You'll inherit some good foundations: existing infrastructure, a working prototype, clear strategic direction. What you bring is the experience to make this into a platform that genuinely changes how mental healthcare is delivered.

What we are looking for

You're probably right for this if:
•       You've delivered platform-scale software before (not just features within someone else's platform)
•       You're comfortable with Microsoft Power Platform, Azure services, and modern integration architectures — or you've built equivalent capability on adjacent stacks and are happy moving into ours
•       You understand AI as a tool you've actually deployed in production, not a buzzword
•       You have an instinct for security, privacy, and audit — particularly in regulated contexts
•       You write code well and lead other engineers well
•       You communicate clearly in writing (we're remote-async-first)
•       You're drawn to mission-driven work — mental healthcare isn't an industry you stumble into

You're probably not right for this if:
•       You're looking for a defined task list and step-by-step directions
•       You want to be insulated from the business or clinical context
•       Healthcare regulation feels like a hassle rather than something to engineer around respectfully
•       You'd rather work on consumer apps or enterprise SaaS where the stakes are lower

What we offer

•       Competitive salary — we'll match the market for the right person at this level
•       Real ownership — of the technical direction, not just the codebase
•       Direct work with the founders — no layers, no committees
•       Genuine impact — what you build affects real patients and clinicians
•       Remote-first flexibility — work when and where you work best
•       Modern stack — Azure, Power Platform, OpenAI, current tooling
•       Growth opportunity — as Atrom grows, this role grows with it

About Atrom Mindcare

We were founded in 2023 by Amrish Gupta (CEO) and Dr Aarohee Desai-Gupta (Clinical Director, Consultant Psychiatrist). We specialise in outpatient mental health, including ADHD and ASD assessment and treatment, delivered through both NHS Right to Choose and private channels. We're growing rapidly, operating in a market where demand vastly outstrips quality supply, and we're investing in our platform because we believe technology done right is how mental healthcare moves forward.
We're small enough that you'll see your work matter, structured enough that you'll have what you need to do your best work, and ambitious enough that this is a meaningful career move for the right person.

How to apply

If this resonates, we'd love to hear from you. Send us:
•       A brief note about why this opportunity interests you
•       Your background — link to LinkedIn, GitHub, portfolio, or a CV
•       Examples of platform-scale work you've led
•       A few questions you'd ask us (this tells us more than most CVs do)

Apply via

•       Email: recruitment@atrommindcare.com

Strong fits will be invited to a conversation rather than a structured interview — we want to understand each other before deciding.

Atrom Mindcare Limited is an equal opportunities organisation. We welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds and particularly encourage those underrepresented in healthcare technology to apply.

About the Company

Our client's technology estate connects core policy, claims, payment, data, and partner platforms so products and claims can operate efficiently at scale. The business operates with clear controls and a lean, collaborative structure spanning Engineering, Data, Change, QA, and Business teams.

Operating in a high-growth environment, they prioritise security, reliability, and automated connectivity. They champion entrepreneurial problem-solving, precision, and zero tolerance for technical debt. They are anti-bureaucracy but pro-governance - translating non-technical business needs into secure, practical solutions, fixing root causes, and automating manual work without adding unnecessary corporate layers.

If you are an ambitious engineer who thrives on complete technical ownership, reducing manual hand-offs, and driving platform reliability, you will find a massive opportunity here.

About the Role

Reporting directly to the Head of Engineering / CTO, this is a hands-on, senior-level engineering role. You will act as a primary technical anchor responsible for keeping the core cloud infrastructure secure, dependable, and connected across suppliers, distribution partners, and SaaS ecosystems.

This is a senior hands-on ownership role, not a primary service desk or administrative oversight position. Working alongside the IT Configuration Analyst, Data, Change, and QA teams, you will bridge business requirements with practical execution. Your core mission is to design, build, and support secure APIs, webhooks, and system integrations, lead cloud and identity security controls, manage production incidents, and prevent uncontrolled production changes across the entire tech estate.

Key Responsibilities

Own the effective operation of M365, Entra ID, Intune, NinjaOne, Bitdefender, TitanHQ, credential management, backups, devices, and core SaaS controls; set standards and delegate routine administration.
Design, build, configure, and support secure APIs, webhooks, SFTP feeds, and system connections across core policy, claims, payment, and data platforms, as well as external partners to eliminate re-keying and manual hand-offs.
Implement access, patching, vulnerability, encryption, and monitoring controls; lead technical incident response, coordinate suppliers, and drive root-cause analysis (RCA) and corrective actions.
Utilise source control (Git), peer reviews, CI/CD, and Dev/Test/Prod environments; prepare release notes, test evidence, and rollback plans to ensure zero unauthorised production changes.
Maintain system architecture documentation, technical-debt backlogs, and SaaS inventories; provide technical oversight of third-party suppliers and mentor/coach the IT Configuration Analyst.

Skills & Competencies

Strong hands-on command of Azure/M365, Entra ID, Intune, endpoint/security tooling, networking (DNS/VPN), APIs (REST/webhooks/SFTP), and production monitoring.
Solid working capability in scripting or software development (e.g., PowerShell, Python, C#, or TypeScript) and version control/CI/CD workflows (Git, Azure DevOps, GitHub).
Exceptional capability to explain complex technical issues in plain language, prioritize risk and commercial value, and work within change management frameworks.
Entrepreneurial, precise, and intolerant of technical debt—focused on fixing root causes, standardising environments, and automating repetitive tasks.

Qualifications & Experience

At least 5 years of hands-on experience in platform, cloud, infrastructure, integration, or software engineering, with direct responsibility for live services, integrations, security controls, and incident resolution.
Proven track record operating comfortably in a small, fast-scaling team.
Experience in Insurance, Fintech, MGAs, or another regulated environment; exposure to embedded products, cloud data platforms, key vaults, or specialty insurance software ecosystems.

Role overview

As a DevOps Engineer, you will work closely with developers, QA engineers, architects and project teams to improve the automation, security, scalability and reliability of Cloudfy's platform and supporting services.

You will be responsible for building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines, managing cloud infrastructure, supporting operational excellence initiatives, and helping embed DevSecOps principles across the software development lifecycle.

As a DevOps Engineer at Cloudfy, you will:

Design, build and maintain Azure DevOps CI/CD pipelines that support efficient and reliable software delivery.
Automate build, testing, deployment and release processes to improve deployment consistency, quality and frequency.

Embed security best practices into cloud infrastructure and deployment pipelines.
Support vulnerability management, identity and access management, security monitoring and remediation activities.
Help implement DevSecOps principles throughout the software delivery lifecycle.
Assist with compliance and governance initiatives, including ISO 27001 and SOC 2 controls.
Contribute to platform engineering standards, architecture discussions and operational best practices.
Promote automation-first thinking and continuous improvement across the engineering organisation.

You will bring:

2-4 years of commercial experience in a DevOps, Cloud Engineer, Infrastructure Engineer or similar role.
Hands-on experience with Azure DevOps, CI/CD practices and release management.
Experience designing, implementing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines using YAML and Git-based source control.
Strong knowledge of Azure cloud services and cloud-hosted production environments.
Experience supporting technologies such as Azure App Services, Azure Functions, Azure SQL, Storage, Front Door or similar cloud services.
Knowledge of Infrastructure as Code concepts and environment management practices.
Understanding of cloud architecture, networking, application security and identity management principles.
Experience with monitoring, logging, alerting and observability platforms.
Strong troubleshooting, problem-solving and incident management skills.
Experience collaborating with software engineering, QA and technical stakeholders.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

Working within a SaaS software business.

jobs.company: Careers at MI5, MI6 and GCHQ
jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Software Engineer

Locations
: Manchester
Salary:
£64,005 – £68,185 (depending on skills and experience) with an opportunity to qualify for additional allowances and a skills-related payment under the Government Digital and Data Profession Capability Framework (GDDPCF) - formerly known as DDaT.
Hours
: 37 hours per week.
Flexible working:
we support full-time, part-time, compressed hours and other flexible working patterns. This is primarily an office-based role, and therefore, opportunities for home or remote working will be limited and dependent on business needs.

About us

MI5 keeps the country safe from serious threats like terrorism and attempts by states to harm the UK, its people and way of life. We carry out investigations by obtaining, analysing, and assessing intelligence, and then work with a range of partners including MI6 and GCHQ to disrupt these threats. Through our protective security arm, we provide advice and guidance to government, businesses and other organisations about how to keep themselves safe. A role in MI5 means you'll do unique and challenging work in a supportive and encouraging environment, making a real difference to UK national security.

The role

Technology sits at the heart of everything we do at MI5. We're looking for Software Engineers with multiple years of experience who are prepared to take on a more senior role within a multi-disciplinary product team. You’ll develop solutions, mentor less experienced colleagues whilst working alongside a range of technical specialists including Product Owners, Business Analysts, Delivery Managers, Data Scientists and Machine Learning Engineers, to build and run secure applications and products. You’ll be using agile methodologies to deliver products that are core to MI5’s operations, and you’ll be using cloud technologies such as AWS and Azure as well, supporting on-premises platforms and long-established technologies and frameworks.
You’ll share our collective responsibility to keep the country safe and be keen to constantly improve yourself and your team, taking on ownership of large problems, breaking them down and working with the team to deliver new features throughout the engineering lifecycle. You’ll support the products owned by the team, working with users to identify and fix defects (providing on-call support if necessary) developing automated tests to maintain the assurance of our products and deploy through continuous integration pipelines.

You’ll support and mentor less experienced colleagues and help them to understand what great engineering looks like, promoting best practises, participating in our engineering community and guilds, and encourage cross-organisation initiatives to help build our community of engineers. Many of our engineers work directly within our mission teams and all engineers have a unique opportunity to see first-hand how their work contributes to UK national security, while remaining part of a supportive and inclusive technical profession.

Our tech stacks vary between products (such as Java, Python, C#, React.js, Oracle, Mongo, Elastic Search and Hadoop to name a few). We embrace DevSecOps mindset, and our teams automate, run and support what we build. You’ll be working under the Government Digital and Data Profession Capability Framework (formerly known as DDaT), which recognises and rewards specialist expertise. Due to the nature of our work, most of the teams only work from the office. There are limited opportunities to work in a hybrid way. This is not guaranteed and dependent on the business need. Whether it’s building a platform to enable the analysis of data systems to track the progress of our investigations, developing robust and scalable capabilities for our Data Science teams, compliance services to ensure we are operating legally or tooling to improve our developer experience, the nature of our work presents unique and fascinating engineering challenges.

About you

You’ll be proficient in developing enterprise or commercial software in at least one common language (for example Java, C#, Python or JavaScript) and are familiar with the principles of a modern standards approach such as continuous integration and delivery, test driven development and cloud services. You can demonstrate proficiency in the use of the agile methodology and have awareness of design patterns and how to implement them appropriately with security in mind.
We value your solid communication skills, as you communicate effectively with technical and non-technical colleagues. You’ll demonstrate competency in leadership and you’re continuously looking for opportunities to develop and learn new engineering practices and approaches.

Training and development

We’re committed to developing you and recognise this will look different for everyone. We’ll use the Government Digital and Data Profession Capability Framework (formerly known as DDaT). as a compass to provide guidance and tools to support you. You can find out more about the framework here: Government Digital and Data Profession Capability Framework . There’ll be opportunities to gain qualifications and pursue specialist pathways, as well as undertaking tailored training, coaching and mentoring. You will also have up to 20% innovation and personal development time.
As you develop, grow, and maintain your technical skills, you will have the opportunity to progress through GDDPCF pay points. You’ll need to regularly demonstrate and accredit your skills based on the framework. If you don’t maintain the required skills, you’ll be given the opportunity and support to rectify this, as you could revert to a lower level of capability and pay.

Rewards and benefits

You’ll receive a starting salary of between £64,005 – 68,185
(depending on skills and experience) plus other benefits including:
25 Days Annual Leave automatically rising to 30 days after 5 years' service, and an additional 10.5 days public and privilege holidays
opportunities to be recognised through our employee performance scheme
dedicated development budget
interest-free season ticket loan
excellent pension scheme
cycle to work scheme
facilities such as a gym, restaurant and on-site coffee bars (at some locations)
paid parental and adoption leave.

Equal opportunities

At MI5 diversity and inclusion are critical to our mission. To protect the UK, we need a truly diverse workforce that reflects the society we serve. This includes diversity in every sense of the word: those with different backgrounds, ages, ethnicities, gender identities, sexual orientations, ways of thinking and those with disabilities or neurodivergent conditions. We therefore welcome and encourage applications from everyone, including those from groups that are under-represented in our workforce such as women, those from an ethnic minority background, people with disabilities and those from low socio-economic backgrounds.
Find out more about our culture, working environment and diversity on our website.

We’re Disability Confident

MI5 is proud to have achieved Leader status within the Department for Work and Pensions’ Disability Confident scheme. This initiative encourages employers to think differently about disability and take action to improve how they recruit, retain, and develop disabled people. As a Disability Confident Organisation, we aim to ensure that a fair and proportionate number of disabled applicants who best meet the essential criteria for this position will be offered an interview, where it is practical for us to do so. (This is known as the Offer of an interview.)
To secure an interview for this role, you must meet the minimum criteria, all of which are assessed at the application sift. These criteria (in order of application process) are:
Demonstrate ability in developing software in at least one common language (assessed at application form sift)
Demonstrate an understanding of the principles of modern standards approaches such as continuous integration and delivery, test driven development and cloud services (assessed at application form sift)
Demonstrate taking on a more senior role within a team. Provide technical direction and the ability to guide and support others with regards to software developing (assessed at application form sift)

What to expect

Our recruitment process is fair, transparent, and based on merit. Here is a brief overview of each stage, in order:
1. You’ll be invited to upload your CV and complete an online application form.
2. If you pass, you’ll be invited to an interview where you will be asked questions relating to your motivation and our core competencies.
3. If you pass, you’ll be invited to a technical skill-based interview based on the Government Digital and Data Profession Capability Framework for the role. This will cover drawing upon your experience for the following areas:
a. Programming & Build including User Focus
b. Information Security
c. System Design
4. If you pass, you’ll be made a Conditional Offer of Employment, subject to vetting
Please note, you must successfully pass each stage of the process to progress to the next. Your application may take around 6 - 9 months to process including vetting, so we advise you to continue any current employment until you have received your final job offer.

Before you apply

To work at MI5 you need to be a British citizen or hold dual British nationality. You can read our full eligibility criteria here.
This role requires the highest security clearance, known as Developed Vetting (DV).

Please note, you should only launch your application from within the UK. If you are based overseas, you should wait until you visit the UK to launch an application. Applying from outside the UK will impact on our ability to progress your application. You should not discuss your application, other than with your partner or a close family member.

As an IT Infrastructure Engineer, you will play an active role in maintaining, supporting, and monitoring existing infrastructure including server, storage, network, data, and applications. The role is expected to work with and support management and the wider team in improving and enhancing key systems and processes. As an Infrastructure Engineer, you will be a subject-matter expert leading by example and providing mentorship on best practices to the wider IT function, ensuring that systems and services are available, visible, and secure.

The role requires a broad set of skills underpinned by a high degree of flexibility, adaptability, and a keen mind for determined problem-solving. Elements of the role will also present opportunities to represent the IT function across business areas as an interface with functional leaders and other consumers of the IT service around the firm. Key to your success will be your ability to communicate with others at all levels, work multiple issues alongside planning and delivering several workstreams, and ensure you deliver against commitments while maintaining an engaging, confident, can-do attitude. In achieving success, you will have access to and experience a wide range of IT products and services from traditional on-prem, through hyper-converged, to Cloud technologies.

What you will be doing:

As an Infrastructure Engineer, your responsibilities and duties include:

Being responsible for the ongoing stability and availability of systems.
Monitoring, maintaining, and supporting systems and software to ensure stability and compliance with technology standards.
Performing maintenance, including the installation of patches and upgrades with an understanding of the production environment and continuous availability targets.
Full accountability for allocated project actions, technical problems, and incidents.
Event detection, resolution, and/or escalation – conducting root cause analysis and remediation as required.
Monitoring systems availability, performance, capacity, and trends against baseline metrics.
Generating system insights by leveraging monitoring and event tools to support stabilisation and lifecycle management.
Developing in-depth knowledge of supported systems and applications and transferring knowledge to more junior staff.
Vulnerability management by assessing security status and applying mitigation solutions.
Fostering strategic partnerships with technology vendors, internal user groups, technical IT consultants, and project managers, moving beyond transactional relationships.
Demonstrating subject-matter technical expertise across Microsoft technologies, virtualisation, Cloud technologies, networking, and storage.

Actively drive the migration, optimisation, and management of workloads into the Azure cloud ecosystem.

Work to resolve issues and incidents in a timely manner aligned with ITIL best practices.

Actively participate in the Change Advisory Board (CAB) meetings and manage change within the infrastructure team.

Experienced in change management and scheduling.
Strong understanding of Infrastructure technology and protocols.

Microsoft 365 administration and security.
Experience in virtualisation technologies (VMware and Nutanix preferred).
Windows Server Infrastructure.
HPE Server and Blade Infrastructure.
Networking (HPE ProCurve and FlexFabric).
SAN technology (ideally Nimble, Alletra, and 3PAR).
Citrix Virtual Apps and Desktop experience with a good understanding of Citrix ADC.
A good understanding of firewalls (ideally FortiGate) and modern secure network architectures (e.g., SASE).
Scripting and automation skills (e.g., PowerShell) to support cloud operations.

Qualifications:

5+ years of hands-on experience working as part of an infrastructure delivery team.
Change management experience.
Strong communication skills. Can describe complex technical concepts and issues to non-technical stakeholders.
Ability to quickly arbitrate, prioritise, and filter change/deployment issues to identify solutions.

Management and migration of cloud-based solutions (Azure).
Exposure to Infrastructure as Code (IaC) principles (Terraform, Bicep, or ARM templates).
Management of server infrastructure solutions including storage.
Exposure to Nutanix AHV and DR failover technologies.

With the right backing, people and businesses have the power to progress in incredible ways. And we’ll do it with the utmost integrity, and in an environment where everyone is seen, heard and feels like they belong.

Join Team Amex and let’s lead the way together.

Role Summary

At American Express, we empower technologists to learn, innovate, and make an impact from day one. As a Software Engineer in the full-time Technology Graduate Program, you’ll join a 12-month technical and leadership development experience while contributing as a full-time colleague on an Enterprise Technology Services team. You’ll build software, collaborate with Agile teams, and help deliver secure, reliable, customer-first technology that supports the future of payments.

About The Team

Enterprise Technology Services teams build, operate, and modernize the technology that helps American Express deliver trusted, secure, and customer-first products and services. Software Engineers may support teams across backend engineering, frontend engineering, cloud engineering, mobile, AI/ machine learning, data-oriented engineering, infrastructure-adjacent engineering, or full-stack product development. You will design, code, test, improve, and support applications and services that help customers, colleagues, and partners get work done reliably and securely.

What Type Of Work Can You Expect?

Develop, test, and improve software applications as part of an Agile scrum team.
Write clean, maintainable code; participate in code reviews; and create unit tests with guidance from experienced engineers.
Identify opportunities to apply new technologies, automation, and engineering practices to solve real business challenges.
Partner with Product Managers, Senior Engineers, Quality Engineers, Architects, and business partners to understand requirements, prioritize features, and deliver value.
Work across different parts of the technology stack, such as APIs, services, microservices, user interfaces, mobile experiences, cloud platforms, or data-driven solutions.
Explore responsible use of AI-powered developer tools, machine learning concepts, and intelligent automation relevant to your team’s work.
Participate in graduate program learning, mentorship, networking, community, and career-development experiences while building your full-time career at American Express.

What You’ll Learn

How software is built and delivered “the Amex Way,” including structured onboarding, developer bootcamp concepts, code quality, testing, and secure engineering practices.
How Product, Engineering, Quality, Security, and business partners collaborate from idea to production.
How to translate customer or business needs into technical solutions while balancing quality, resilience, usability, and risk.
How to communicate progress, ask effective questions, and share technical work with both technical and non-technical partners.
How to grow through mentorship, feedback, technical learning, leadership exposure, and a strong graduate cohort community.

Qualifications

Must have earned a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, or another technical field before the full-time start date.
Students must have a graduation date between December 2026 and June 2027

Minimum Qualifications

Experience developing products or projects in an academic, personal, internship, research, open-source, hackathon, or professional setting.
Exposure to backend engineering, frontend engineering, cloud engineering, mobile engineering, AI / machine learning, data engineering, API development, or full-stack product development.
Familiarity with Java, JavaScript, React, TypeScript, Python, C#, Go, Kotlin, Node.js, REST APIs, SQL, Spring, or similar frameworks and tools.
Exposure to cloud-native development, microservices, containerization, CI/CD, DevOps, automated testing, accessibility, or secure software development concepts.
Interest in AI-powered development tools, generative AI, intelligent automation, responsible AI, or machine learning fundamentals.

Preferred Qualifications

Programming experience through coursework, projects, research, internships, open-source contributions, hackathons, or extracurricular activities using one or more languages such as Java, JavaScript, Python, C#, Go, Kotlin, Node.js, or similar technologies.
Interest in building software applications across web, mobile, backend, cloud, API, microservices, or full-stack environments.
Exposure to software development across backend, frontend, cloud, mobile, API, data, or full-stack environments.
Exposure to advanced AI software engineering concepts such as LLM integrations, prompt engineering, prompt evaluation, embeddings, retrieval-augmented generation, vector search, AI agents, agentic workflows, or human-in-the-loop review.
Familiarity with building or integrating AI-enabled applications using APIs, data pipelines, model inference endpoints, evaluation workflows, or cloud-based AI services.
Awareness of responsible AI practices, including model reliability, explainability, privacy, security, governance, bias mitigation, guardrails, and validation of AI-generated outputs.
Experience with modern software development practices such as version control, testing, code reviews, Agile methodologies, and collaborative development.
Curiosity for emerging technologies, including artificial intelligence, machine learning, developer productivity tooling, automation, and responsible AI practices.

Relativity is a leading legal data intelligence company building technology that helps users organize data, discover the truth, and act on it with confidence. Mentor team members on code quality, best practices, and technical debt management

Required

Impactful Mission

Build systems that help customers organize data, discover the truth, and act on it in high-stakes legal matters.

About The Team/Project

Join our development team and help build and evolve Bravura’s applications within the financial services and Investment Funds domain
.

As a SQL Developer with .NET
, you will play a key role in designing, developing and maintaining robust, high-performing data solutions. Working closely with .NET developers and other technical specialists, you will contribute to the development of our applications, optimise database performance and ensure that our SQL solutions follow industry best practices.

Your expertise will help ensure data integrity, application performance and the smooth operation of Bravura’s flagship products. This is an opportunity to combine strong SQL knowledge with .NET development experience while contributing to modern software engineering practices and the continuous improvement of our products.

What You’ll Do

Develop high-quality code for Bravura’s applications within the financial services and Investment Funds domain.
Optimise SQL queries and database performance to ensure efficient and reliable application functionality.
Design, develop and maintain SQL databases, queries, stored procedures and other database solutions.
Provide technical guidance and support to .NET developers on SQL queries and database-related matters.
Review and analyse existing SQL code, identifying opportunities for improvement and recommending best practices.
Develop new functionalities within .NET-based applications.
Analyse and troubleshoot technical and functional issues reported by clients.
Contribute to technical discussions, solution design and the continuous improvement of our applications.
Support the implementation and improvement of development and deployment practices.
Work closely with other developers and technical teams to deliver reliable, scalable and high-quality solutions.

Unleash Your Potential

To be successful in this role, your background and experience will include:

3+ years of professional software development experience.
Strong proficiency in writing efficient SQL queries and optimising database performance.
Strong knowledge of SQL Server, including database design concepts, T-SQL, SQL Jobs and complex stored procedures.
Experience with or knowledge of MS SQL Server Administration.
Good knowledge of .NET/.NET Framework/Core and C#.
Understanding of industry-standard software development lifecycles and methodologies, such as Agile, Scrum and Scrum of Scrums.
Understanding of software quality concepts, including testing approaches, categories and levels, as well as test automation.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Good command of English, both written and spoken.

It’s great, but not essential, if you have:

Knowledge of SQL Server internals and theoretical aspects of database design.
Experience building CI/CD solutions using industry-standard platforms such as Git, GitLab or Azure DevOps.
Experience working in complex enterprise or financial services environments.

Working at Bravura

Our people are the heart of our business. We work hard to provide a rich employee experience and a robust framework for ongoing career development.

Competitive salary and employee benefits scheme
2 paid volunteering days and a range of community-based initiatives to get involved in
Parental (including secondary) leave policy
Opportunities for professional development and continuous learning
A collaborative, inclusive and flexible working environment
Hybrid working model
The opportunity to work on innovative technology solutions for leading financial services organisations

We make hiring decisions based on your experience, skills and passion, so even if you don’t match every listed skill or tick all the boxes, we’d still love to hear from you.

Company Description

Software Mind develops solutions that make an impact for companies around the globe. Tech giants & unicorns, transformative projects, emerging technologies and limitless opportunities – these are a few words that describe an average day for us. Building cross-functional engineering teams that take ownership and crave more means we’re always on the lookout for talented people who bring passion and creativity to every project. Our culture embraces openness, acts with respect, shows grit & guts and combines employment with enjoyment.

Job Description

Project – the aim you’ll have

Join a dedicated team of Polish and British developers, testers, DevOps engineers, Data Engineers, Project Managers, and Scrum Masters building innovative document management software to advance clinical research.

We’ve partnered with our client for years, working on a trust-based, collaborative model. Our work spans development (.NET, C#, React), automation (Playwright), and DevOps (Azure, Kubernetes, Terraform), with a strong culture of knowledge sharing and teamwork.

Position – How You’ll Contribute

We are looking for a growth-oriented intern or junior .NET developer who already has solid C# basics and genuinely wants to learn. We welcome a proactive mindset, where you treat AI as an everyday coding buddy that helps you debug, research, and learn faster – not as a "magic button" that does the thinking for you. If you are ready to take ownership of your tasks, want to understand how your code works under the hood, and are excited to solve real business puzzles in a relaxed, no-nonsense engineering culture, you’ll fit right in.

Your Daily Tasks Will Include

Developing backend tasks in .NET, maintaining APIs, and assisting with system integrations
Writing clean, testable code and creating unit tests with mentor support
Utilizing AI tools consciously for code generation, refactoring, debugging, and technical research
Participating in code reviews, internal workshops, technical demos, and analyzing bugs/logs
Collaborating closely with experienced developers and verifying AI-generated solutions before implementation

Qualifications

Expectations – the experience you need

At least 1 year of commercial experience
Practical knowledge of C# and willingness to grow within the .NET / ASP.NET Core ecosystem
Hands-on experience demonstrated through personal projects, a GitHub profile, or commercial exposure
Basic understanding of backend development, Web API, Entity Framework, and databases
Working knowledge of Git and the ability to read and improve existing code
Practical skills in leveraging AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Copilot, Cursor, Claude, Gemini) for debugging, research, and automation
Good understanding of AI limitations, including hallucinations, data security, privacy, and the necessity of verification
English proficiency at a B2 level or higher
Strong communication skills, independence, curiosity, and readiness to receive constructive feedback

Additional Skills – The Edge You Have

Active GitHub profile or a portfolio of post-hours applications
Basic knowledge of SQL and database optimization
First experience with writing unit tests
Strong interest in work automation and productivity tools
Mindset focused on continuous self-development and problem-solving

What does the recruitment process look like?

During the interview, we will want to see how you think, solve problems, and use AI. You can expect a technical conversation and practical questions about .NET, C#, APIs, and AI tools.

We will look not only at the result, but also at your way of working:

how you analyse a problem
how you formulate questions for AI
how you verify answers
what you accept
what you reject
how you explain your technical decisions

jobs.title: System Architect
jobs.description:
Location:
EU remote

About the Role:

As a member of Auditdata's Architecture Group, you will join a highly skilled engineering organization building enterprise-grade solutions for audiology clinic chains worldwide. You will shape integrations, domain boundaries, system design, and platform evolution across our SaaS product portfolio.

Our tech stack
includes .NET, React ecosystem, Azure Servises (AKS, Service Bus, Event Hubs, Azure SQL Database).

What You Will Do:

Integration & API Architecture:

Define and maintain Manage’s integration strategy (REST, Events, APIs, Data Feeds).
Design standard integration patterns — real-time (Event Hubs), on-demand (REST), hybrid workflows.
Lead technical workshops with customers and partners to gather requirements and define integration approaches.
Align integrations with domain boundaries, data contracts, and platform security standards.
Govern message contracts, event schemas, versioning strategy, and error-handling models.
Enforce security best practices (OAuth2, mTLS, Azure AD, Key Vault).
Oversee monitoring, observability, and integration reliability (tracking, retries, DLQs).

Domain & System Architecture:

Serve as the technical consultant for assigned domains, ensuring architectural integrity and consistent domain boundaries.
Shape domain models and identify bounded contexts, aggregates, and integration points.
Define APIs and event contracts across microservices and cross-domain workflows.
Evaluate epics and initiatives for architectural feasibility and appropriate service ownership.
Support teams with high-level design, technology selection, and patterns.
Participate in architecture reviews and platform governance.
Coach teams on DDD, Clean Architecture, and best engineering practices.
Maintain architecture diagrams, specifications, interface documentation, and ADRs.

Platform & Multi-Tenancy:

Design and own the architecture of a secure, performant, and cost-efficient multi-tenancy model.
Contribute to the long-term architecture vision and support the evolution of the platform strategy.

Customer & Pre-Sales Engagement:

Participate in pre-sales work, technical scoping, and early-stage solution shaping.
Support troubleshooting and performance improvements for complex integrations or distributed system issues.

What You Will Bring:

Technical Skills & Experience:

Strong communication skills and the ability to articulate architectural decisions to both leadership and engineering teams.
Experience with integration architectures (Azure Service Bus, Event Hubs, Azure Functions, REST APIs, Webhooks).
Practical knowledge of microservices and event-driven architectures.
Solid understanding of Domain-Driven Design and Clean Architecture.
Proven ability to produce high-quality technical documentation and diagrams (Miro, Lucid, C4, Event Catalog).
Comfortable in customer-facing technical discussions.
Strong background in Azure Cloud services.
Ability to enforce architectural standards through ADRs, reviews, and quality gates.
Familiarity with governance, audit logging, and proactive system health monitoring.
Ability to collaborate with Product and Delivery teams to align architecture with the roadmap and business vision.
Fluent English.

Preferred:

10+ years in software engineering, including 5+ years in architecture roles within enterprise SaaS.
Proven experience modernizing or commercializing legacy platforms into scalable, multi-tenant products.
Demonstrated success designing enterprise-grade integrations.
Degree in Computer Science or a similar field.

Nice-to-Haves:

Experience with MassTransit.
Hands-on experience with AI/ML, LLMs, or agent-based architectures (semantic search, intelligent document processing, workflow automation).
Azure Cloud certifications.
Strong understanding of security and compliance for medical or regulated data (HIPAA, GDPR).
.NET and React familiarity.

Key Traits:

Strong leadership, ownership, and decision-making skills.
Ability to solve complex technical challenges and provide clear direction.
A consistent focus on continuous learning — both personal and team-wide.
A mindset that promotes cross-team alignment, technical excellence, and architectural consistency.

What’s in It for You:

Long-term engagement in a stable, growing SaaS company.
High engineering and product standards.
Flexible environment with a flat organizational structure.
Professional development opportunities, including certification support.
A global, diverse, and highly skilled team across Denmark, Ukraine, UK, Poland, Canada, Australia, USA, and more.
A culture that values personal growth as much as business outcomes.

You don’t match the description 100%? Please don’t hold back! We would love to hear from you.  

We’re looking for someone who finds the role challenging and exciting and wants to grow in this role.

We look forward to your application! ( please submit your CV in English
)

Auditdata is an equal opportunity employer that is committed to create diverse work environment free of discrimination and harassment. We make recruiting decisions based on your experience and skills.

jobs.description:

Billennium
is a global technology company with over 20 years of experience, committed to innovation and empowering businesses. As an employer, we offer a supportive, growth-focused environment where collaboration and creativity thrive.
Join us to shape the future of technology together.

Role Summary:

We are looking for a Senior QA Engineer
to join a greenfield project focused on building and evolving a core component of a new ecosystem supporting the debt servicing and receivables management processes.

The solution is designed around Domain-Driven Design (DDD)
and consists of several autonomous Bounded Contexts covering both non-financial and financial areas, including Client Management, Party Management, Debt Management, Asset Management, Finance Engine, Payment Management and Collection Accounting.
The MVP has already been successfully deployed to production, and the team is now focused on delivering new functionalities, improving existing solutions and ensuring high quality across a distributed, event-driven architecture.

You will work closely with Developers and Product Owners
in an Agile environment using Kanban
.

What You Will Do:

Design, create and maintain test scenarios and test cases
covering functional, regression, integration and UAT testing.
Test distributed systems and integrations between services
.
Test REST APIs
and systems based on asynchronous and event-driven communication, including messaging and queues.
Design, implement and maintain automated UI, API and end-to-end tests
.
Work with C# and .NET
, using tools and frameworks such as xUnit, Reqnroll and Shouldly
.
Develop automated tests using Cypress and/or Playwright
.
Use Testcontainers
and tools such as Postman or Apidog
for API and integration testing.
Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines
, including GitLab CI/CD and GitHub Actions.
Work with Git
, including branching strategies and merge requests.
Manage testing activities, reporting and traceability using Jira and Xray
.
Use Grafana
dashboards and alerts to monitor key quality and system indicators, such as payment throughput, error rates and asynchronous processing delays.
Work with SQL and PostgreSQL
to validate data and support testing activities.
Collaborate closely with Developers and Product Owners to clarify requirements and identify potential quality risks early.
Contribute to establishing and improving QA standards, testing practices and automation strategies
.
Share knowledge and support less experienced QA team members.
Leverage AI-powered tools
, such as Copilot and LLMs, to improve QA processes, automation and everyday productivity.

Role Requirements:

Must Have

4-5+ years of professional experience
as a Tester / QA Engineer, including at least 2 years in a Senior QA role
.
Strong experience in test automation
covering UI, API and/or end-to-end testing.
Hands-on experience testing distributed systems and service integrations
.
Practical experience with REST API testing
.
Experience with asynchronous communication and event-driven architectures
, including queues and messaging.
Experience creating and maintaining functional, regression and integration tests
.
Practical experience with C# and .NET
.
Knowledge of xUnit, Reqnroll and Shouldly
.
Experience with Cypress and/or Playwright
.
Experience with Testcontainers
.
Experience using Postman and/or Apidog
.
Hands-on experience with GitLab CI/CD and/or GitHub Actions
, including integrating automated tests into pipelines and modifying existing pipelines.
Good knowledge of Git
, including branches and merge requests.
Experience with Jira and Xray
for test management, reporting and traceability.
Practical SQL
skills and experience with PostgreSQL
.
Experience working in Agile
environments, preferably with Kanban.
Experience working on projects following Domain-Driven Design (DDD)
principles.

Nice to Have:

Knowledge of Docker, Kubernetes and/or OpenShift Container Platform (OCP)
.
Experience with performance testing
, e.g. JMeter or k6.
Knowledge of web technologies such as HTML, CSS and JavaScript
.
Practical experience with BDD
methodology.
Proactive approach to analysing business and technical requirements.
Strong collaboration skills and willingness to work closely with both business stakeholders and development teams.
Experience defining quality and testing standards
.
Experience mentoring or supporting junior QA engineers.
Openness to using AI tools and LLM-based solutions
in QA, test automation and software delivery.

Perks and benefits (our offer):

Comprehensive benefits
- enjoy Udemy for Business, private medical care, Multisport card, veterinary package, language lessons, and shopping vouchers.
Career growth
- access opportunities for professional development and learning, including perks related to our official partnerships with global IT giants: Microsoft, AWS, Snowflake, Salesforce & more.

to start your journey with us in the form of a welcome pack.

Join us, at Wolters Kluwer, and be part of a dynamic global technology company that makes a difference every day.

We’re innovators with impact. We provide expert software and information solutions that the world’s leading professionals rely on, in the moments that matter most. You’ll make a real difference in the lives of millions of people. Together with our customers, we help to advance sustainability, health, justice, prosperity, and commerce around the world.

About This Role

Our team is building a central GenAI Platform to empower hundreds of product teams across the organization with scalable capabilities for rapid development, validation, and deployment of AI agents. We also drive the development of the most impactful AI agents, ensuring faster delivery and greater impact across multiple domains. With over 20 agents already launched and many more in progress, our work accelerates innovation and improves outcomes in critical industries.

You'll join a 100-engineer team within a larger organization that combines the stability of an established company with the agility of a startup. In this high-autonomy, high-impact role, you'll take problems from concept to production, mentor less experienced engineers, and lead by example. You'll design and ship full-stack systems, shape platform capabilities to empower hundreds of product teams, and directly contribute to the development of the most impactful AI agents.

Apply current LLM patterns (RAG, retrieval, routing, tool-use, evals) to deliver measurable customer value—faster, more reliable AI systems; reduced time-to-decision; improved trust/safety metrics; and lower cost per query.
Lead by example and be heavily hands-on: drive architecture, mentor engineers, and take ownership of larger projects.

Minimum Qualifications

8+ years of professional software engineering experience.
Strong full‑stack development skills and cloud experience (AWS/Azure/GCP).
Expert in at least one, and proficient across the others:
AI Agent development and evaluation
Backend development
Frontend development
Cloud services (AWS/Azure/GCP)
CI/CD and Infrastructure as Code
Site Reliability Engineering (SRE)
Quality engineering / testing strategy
Secure SDLC and privacy by design

Proven track record delivering secure, reliable, cloud‑native systems to production.
Excellent problem‑solving, ownership, and cross‑functional communication.

Nice to have

Proven ability to deliver software products independently or as part of a small, fast-paced team.
Experience of taking AI agents from concept to production, including safety evaluations, iterative testing (e.g., A/B testing), and continuous improvement.
Experience with LangChain/LangGraph and MCP; vector/RAG systems; OpenSearch.
Worked on traditional ML tasks like training, deployment, and monitoring.
Understand how LLMs work, their failure modes, and techniques like fine-tuning and model adaptation.

Stages

15‑minute intro screen

1× systems design
1× presentation of past work

Typically 2–4 weeks

Your first months

expertise; ship small improvements while ramping up.

and ambitions.

along with a brief cover letter

in your submission

Be the Difference | If making a difference matters to you, then you matter to us.

jobs.title: Senior SW Engineer – BIM Geometry & Data Processing
jobs.description:
We're partnering with a global construction technology company building a leading platform used by owners, contractors, and engineers to plan, design, and build construction projects worldwide. Our Product & Technology organization spans engineering, product, design, data, and security — all working to modernize one of the world's largest, most under-digitized industries.

This role sits within BIM (Building Information Modeling) Engineering
team, which owns the pipeline that brings 3D construction models from tools like Revit, Navisworks, and IFC-based authoring software into our platform, and powers the fast, in-browser 3D viewing and coordination experience our customers rely on daily.

We're looking for a senior engineer to join our BIM Engineering team, focused on the geometry and data-processing layer that converts industry-standard CAD/BIM file formats into our internal 3D scene representation. This is deep, specialized work: you'll be responsible for parsing, translating, and optimizing complex 3D construction data so it renders quickly and accurately for our customers, at scale.

You'll act in a senior technical capacity leading complex projects, setting technical direction, and mentoring other engineers, while partnering closely with Product, Design, and adjacent engineering teams (platform infrastructure and 3D viewer/rendering) to ship features built on cutting-edge BIM 3D technology.

Responsibilities

Build and maintain parsers and data-processing pipelines that convert industry file formats (e.g. IFC, RVT, DGN) into our internal geometry and scene format
Work on geometry processing problems spanning parametric CAD data, point clouds/scans, and GIS data
Establish engineering standards and best practices across development teams; collaborate with infrastructure and platform teams on shared architecture
Help design and build systems aligned with a service-oriented architecture, supporting both enterprise and international customer needs
Collaborate cross-functionally with Engineering, Product, and UX to design solutions that solve real customer problems
Mentor other engineers reviewing designs and code, and helping the team consistently ship high-quality software
Diagnose and resolve data-fidelity issues (e.g. geometry or metadata discrepancies) reported by customers, tracing them through the parsing/processing pipeline
Contribute to safe, incremental rollout of changes to production data-processing systems, with attention to backward compatibility and rollback safety

Skills Required

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
Professional software development experience with 5+ YOE and with strong proficiency in C++
Experience with geometric modeling parametric curves and surfaces (splines/NURBS)
Experience handling engineering/CAD data, and ideally exposure to laser scan/photogrammetry or GIS data
Familiarity with common 3D/CAD file formats: IFC, RVT, DGN, glTF, or similar
Experience with relevant libraries/SDKs, such as: Open Cascade, Assimp, Open Design Alliance (ODA), MeshLab, or GDAL

Nice to have

Experience with Rust
Background in 3D rendering and real-time rasterization techniques (PBR, IBL)
Familiarity with spatial acceleration structures (BVH, K-d tree, octree)
Experience with 3D graphics techniques: triangle meshes, BREP, point clouds, level-of-detail (LOD), mesh decimation/simplification, mesh cleanup and optimization
Exposure to hardware-accelerated ray tracing (e.g. Nvidia OptiX, DX12)

jobs.description:
Company Overview

At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We’re a global close-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. We build and connect technologies to help protect people, property and places. Our solutions foster the collaboration that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future.

Department Overview

At D-Fend Solutions - now proudly part of the Motorola Solutions family - our people are our greatest strength, and technology is our passion. As the global leader in cyber-takeover counter-drone technology, we design and deliver advanced, software-defined solutions that empower our customers to detect, take control, and safely land unauthorized drones.

The Mission In Krakow

Following the acquisition, our Krakow MSI engineering center is partnering directly with the D-Fend group to drive a technological transformation: moving a critical configuration application to the Cloud. We are assembling an elite, highly agile team capable of diving deep into the existing solution, leveraging Motorola’s vast cloud expertise, and delivering high-impact results at startup speed.

We’re seeking passionate, top-tier professionals who thrive in a fast-paced, creative, and collaborative environment. If you want to build cutting-edge airspace security innovation alongside the best engineers in the industry, this is your place.

Job Description

The Role:

We are building a powerhouse Cloud/Platform team in Krakow, and we are looking for a Senior Software Engineer
to be a part of this group. You will play a crucial role in implementing, maintaining, and scaling a massive multi-tenant SaaS distributed ecosystem
,
migrating on-premise components into a modern cloud architecture.

We are looking for a highly adaptable, heavyweight engineer who is "hot on code"
and loves being deeply hands-on.

As a Senior Engineer in this elite team, you must be:

Highly Adaptable: Completely comfortable and highly effective in a rapidly changing, dynamic environment.
A Fast Learner: Able to quickly absorb new domain knowledge and master new technologies on the fly.
Decisive: Capable of making quick, pragmatic, and highly technical decisions without getting stuck in analysis paralysis.
A Team Player: Ready to collaborate effectively with top-tier engineers, sharing knowledge, and driving collective success.

(Note: While this role is heavily focused on backend engineering and cloud infrastructure, we operate with a strict 'You Build It, You Run It'
culture. End-to-end ownership is key, and you will occasionally dive into the frontend (React) to deliver complete features).

What You Will Do

Drive the Cloud Transition: Play a hands-on role in building and running multi-tenant SaaS applications designed specifically to take full advantage of cloud-native architecture.
Build Distributed Systems: Implement highly complex, high-throughput backend services and distributed systems, ensuring seamless data flow across Cloud, On-Premise, and Edge layers.
Write Exceptional Code: Write sharp, scalable, and maintainable code. You will help set and maintain the highest engineering standards.
End-to-End Ownership: Take full ownership of your features - from technical design and backend coding to automated deployment and production monitoring.
Collaborate & Accelerate: Work shoulder-to-shoulder with senior peers across MSI and D-Fend to leverage shared expertise, unblock technical challenges, and deliver results rapidly.

Basic Requirements

Requirements

Experience & Mindset: 5+ years of backend engineering experience. You thrive in a dynamic environment, make quick, pragmatic technical decisions, and excel at collaborating with top-tier engineers.
The Core Stack: Expertise in Node.js and TypeScript (including frameworks like NestJS or Express). You are highly hands-on and write extremely clean, scalable code.
Cloud & Observability: Strong experience building event-driven microservices in a major cloud provider (AWS, Azure, GCP) and implementing modern Cloud Observability patterns (metrics, distributed tracing, structured logging).
Data & Infrastructure: Solid proficiency with relational databases (PostgreSQL), in-memory caching (Redis), and containerized environments (Docker, Kubernetes).
End-to-End Ownership: Practical experience with (or a strong willingness to touch) React to help the team deliver complete, end-to-end features when necessary.

Big Advantages (Bonus Points)

Infrastructure as Code: Experience treating infrastructure as software using Terraform, AWS CDK, or Serverless Framework.
AI Tooling: Experience enriching and optimizing development using dev-assisting GenAI tools (such as GitHub Copilot, Claude or Cursor).
Security & ZTA: Knowledge of Zero Trust Architecture (ZTA) and mTLS.
Data Scale: Experience with time-series telemetry pipelines and long-term storage tiering.
Observability: Experience implementing and utilizing observability stacks (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, Datadog).

In Return For Your Expertise, We’ll Support You In This New Challenge With Coaching & Development Every Step Of The Way. Also, To Reward Your Hard Work You’ll Get

Private medical coverage with dental package
Life insurance, MultiSport card
IP Tax Relief
PPE (Employee Pension Plan)

Yearly salary increase (depends on individual performance)
Yearly bonus (depends on company performance)

Trainings and broad development opportunities
Great team atmosphere (small scrum teams)

Job Overview

WHO WE ARE

Relativity is a leading legal data intelligence company building technology that helps users organize data, discover the truth, and act on it with confidence. Our AI-powered, cloud platform, RelativityOne, transforms massive volumes of complex information into actionable insights for litigation, investigations, regulatory inquiries, data breach responses, and other high-stakes legal work where accuracy and trust are crucial.

The world’s largest law firms, corporations, and government agencies rely on Relativity’s legal AI software to securely surface and manage the most relevant and impactful information in their matters. Beyond our commercial impact, we are committed to expanding access to technology and supporting pro bono legal work.

What We Do

At Relativity, engineers do more than write code - they build systems that enable users to uncover insights from complex data at scale using cloud-native architecture, AI, and modern tools.
The Import Export organization builds and scales infrastructure for secure, reliable, high-throughput data movement across RelativityOne.

About The Role

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will design, develop, test, deploy, and support Relativity software products.
You will collaborate with a senior engineering team and business stakeholders to build features and services that evolve RelativityOne SaaS.

Job Description And Requirements

WHAT YOU’LL DO

Design architecture and non-functional aspects of Import/Export services aligned with SLO/SLA targets
Break down complex problems into resilient, cloud-native designs and deliver measurable outcomes
Mentor team members on code quality, best practices, and technical debt management
Own production systems, including on-call responsibilities, root cause analysis, and proactive issue resolution
Drive operational excellence through observability, alerting automation, and reliable metrics
Collaborate with Product to shape roadmap decisions using data and clear trade-offs
Improve CI/CD processes through automation and predictable, compliant deployments

Required

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

5+ years of experience building C#/.NET or similar services with demonstrated reliability or performance improvements
Experience designing distributed SaaS systems and translating business needs into technical solutions
Production ownership experience, including on-call rotations, incident response, and reducing MTTR using telemetry
Experience delivering cloud-native systems (Azure or similar platforms)
Hands-on experience with CI/CD automation, testing, and deployment governance
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent experience
English proficiency for technical communication

Preferred

Experience leading microservices development for high-volume, event-driven systems
Experience scaling ingestion pipelines, ETL workflows, or data processing systems with measurable outcomes
Experience mentoring teams in agile planning and cross-team collaboration

WHY WE COULD BE A GREAT FIT

Impactful Mission

Build systems that help customers organize data, discover the truth, and act on it in high-stakes legal matters.

Engineering at Scale

Work on distributed, cloud-native systems that process large volumes of data.

Cutting-Edge Technology

Build with AI, cloud platforms, and scalable architectures shaping legal tech.

Growth and Ownership

Gain experience owning systems end-to-end across cloud and distributed environments.

Collaborative Culture

Work in a team focused on knowledge sharing and continuous improvement.

Inclusive Environment

Diverse perspectives create stronger teams and better outcomes.

Compensation And Benefits

Competitive salary, benefits, DTO, parental leave, and equity program.

Relativity is committed to competitive, fair, and equitable compensation practices.

This position is eligible for total compensation which includes a competitive base salary, an annual performance bonus, and long-term incentives.

The expected salary range for this role is between following values:

208 000 and 312 000PLN

The final offered salary will be based on several factors, including but not limited to the candidate's depth of experience, skill set, qualifications, and internal pay equity. Hiring at the top end of the range would not be typical, to allow for future meaningful salary growth in this position.

Required Skills

Automation, Data Analysis, Database Management, Network Architecture, Performance Optimizations, Problem Solving, Project Management, Software Development, System Designs, Technical Leadership

The project is part of the Credit, Asset-backed & Securitized Products (CASP) division of an investment bank, focusing on platforms that support securitization and structured finance products. jobs.description:
🔵 Project Description:

Development of monitoring and diagnostics system. It fulfils both local and remote data access and analytics requirement, as well as local and remote troubleshooting purpose.
The work responsibilities contain L2 support + manual testing.
Most of the L1 support team is in Asian tmezone, but we still have preferred EU zone.

🔵 Responsibilities:

Responsible for ensuring the reliability and quality of telemetry‑driven IIoT systems through advanced troubleshooting, manual testing, and protocol‑level diagnostics across edge and cloud environments.
The L2 Support Engineer / Manual QA Engineer is responsible for second‑line support and quality validation of IoT and IIoT systems handling real‑time telemetry data. The role investigates complex issues escalated from L1, performing root‑cause analysis using logs, metrics, telemetry streams, and monitoring tools. It involves diagnosing problems across edge and cloud environments, often running on Linux‑based systems. The engineer validates fixes and configuration changes before production release and collaborates closely with development, DevOps, and L3 teams.
In parallel, the role performs manual functional, integration, and regression testing across UI, API, and backend layers. A key responsibility is validating end‑to‑end data flows from devices and gateways through brokers and backend services to dashboards and reports. The engineer ensures data accuracy, correct aggregation, timestamp alignment, and proper resolution in time‑series data.
The role requires hands‑on work with industrial and IoT protocols such as Modbus and MQTT, including validation of payloads, connectivity, and reconnection behavior. It also involves using monitoring and diagnostic systems to detect latency, data loss, or anomalies in real‑time systems. Overall, the role ensures system reliability, data quality, and observability while supporting continuous improvement across support and QA processes.

🔵 Mandatory Skills Description:

Preferrably IT education
Experience as a Manual QA Engineer and L2 Support Engineer
Strong experience with:
Telemetry data and time‑series data
Industry Monitoring and diagnostic platforms or Control systems
Edge and Cloud service experiences
Hands‑on knowledge of Modbus, MQTT or similar IIoT/industrial protocols
Strong manual testing experience (UI, API, backend)
Strong troubleshoot experiences to analyze logs, metrics, and protocol‑level issues
Understanding of IIoT architectures and data pipelines
Experience with databases (SQL / NoSQL / Time Series)
Linux knowledge

Impactful Mission

Vi söker nu en .NET-utvecklare till Skandias DevSecOps-team som utvecklar interna plattformar, verktyg och integrationer som används av utvecklingsteam i hela Skandia.

Att jobba som .NET-utvecklare

Som .NET-utvecklare blir du en del av ett tvärfunktionellt DevSecOps-team med ansvar för interna plattformar och verktyg. Tillsammans utvecklar och förvaltar ni lösningar som används av utvecklare i hela Skandia. Genom ett nära samarbete med andra team bidrar ni till effektiva, säkra och moderna utvecklingsflöden.

I Rollen Kommer Du Bland Annat Att

utveckla och vidareutveckla interna portaler och egenutvecklade lösningar
bygga integrationer mellan olika system, exempelvis Azure DevOps och ServiceNow
automatisera processer och arbetsflöden enligt principen Everything as Code
vidareutveckla och förbättra bygg-, test- och deployprocesser i Azure DevOps och Octopus Deploy
bidra till säkra och effektiva utvecklingsprocesser med fokus på kodkvalitet, säkerhet och automation

Vi arbetar agilt enligt SAFe och i nära samarbete med andra utvecklingsteam, där du bidrar till den fortsatta utvecklingen och förvaltningen av plattformen.

För att lyckas i rollen ser vi att du har:

flera års erfarenhet av utveckling i C# och .NET
erfarenhet av backendutveckling och systemintegrationer
goda kunskaper i Git, YAML och PowerShell
erfarenhet av agila arbetssätt, exempelvis SAFe
goda kunskaper i svenska, både i tal och skrift

Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av Azure DevOps, Octopus Deploy, CI/CD eller testautomation.

Vem är du?

Vi tror att du är en nyfiken och lösningsorienterad person som trivs med att ta dig an tekniska utmaningar och hitta smarta lösningar. Du trivs med att samarbeta med andra, delar gärna med dig av din kunskap och bidrar till ett öppet och hjälpsamt teamklimat.

Du är nyfiken på ny teknik och har en vilja att kontinuerligt utveckla både dig själv och de lösningar du arbetar med.

Vad händer nu? 

I ansökan kommer vi att ställa ett antal urvalsfrågor som ligger till grund för första urvalet.

Läs mer om hela vår rekryteringsprocess här.

Om du har frågor kring rollen, vänligen kontakta rekryterande chef Izabella Rolnik på izabella.rolnik@skandia.se.

Om du har frågor kopplat till rekryteringsprocess, vänligen ta kontakt med Nina Fazeli på nina.fazeli@skandia.se.

Vi kommer att ta ett sommaruppehåll i rekryteringsprocessen och återupptar intervjuerna i augusti.

Varmt välkommen med din ansökan, och trevlig sommar!

Mer om IT

Vi på Skandia IT är stolta över att vara en kundorienterad enhet som levererar effektiva och säkra lösningar för våra kunder. Med cirka 600 engagerade medarbetare är vi mitt i en spännande transformationsresa, där vi utvecklas tillsammans och har kul på vägen. Framåt tillsammans är vårt motto! 

Vi arbetar agilt och har sedan 2017 använt oss av SAFe (Scaled Agile Framework) ramverket, där leverans och kundvärde alltid står i centrum. Våra tågledningar och team, jobbar verksamhetsbaserat med aktiviteter som sprintplanering, daily stand-ups, team-synk, code reviews och retrospektiv. 

Var 12:e vecka samlas vi alla i vår ljusa och inspirerande Ljusgård på kontoret i Stockholm för 2 planeringsdagar. Planeringsperioden består av 6 tvåveckorssprintar, där den sista sprinten är en innovationssprint. Här får du chansen att, själv eller tillsammans med ditt team, utveckla och förfina våra system.

Nu söker vi en erfaren backendutvecklare som vill vara en del av vår resa och sätta sin prägel på framtidens lösningar. 🚀

Såhär kommer du att bidra

Som backendutvecklare på HiQ blir du en viktig pusselbit i konsultuppdrag som sträcker sig över olika branscher – från fordon och medtech till offentlig sektor och finans. Vissa uppdrag handlar om att bygga helt nya plattformar från grunden och andra om att vidareutveckla och optimera befintliga system.

Du kommer att:

Skapa och förvalta robusta, skalbara och säkra backendlösningar.
Jobba nära kollegor inom bland annat arkitektur, frontend, test och UX för att skapa helhetslösningar.
Få möjlighet att utforska olika branscher och bolag, samt testa på olika tekniker.
Dela med dig av din kunskap och inspirera andra.
Vara med i tekniska diskussioner och bidra till hur både kunden och vi på HiQ kan bli ännu bättre.

Matchar vi?

Vi letar efter en utvecklare med minst 5 års erfarenhet inom backendutveckling, som gillar att grotta ner sig i kod men också att se den större bilden. Du har erfarenhet av flera eller några av dessa tekniker:

Java (Spring, Spring Boot, Hibernate, Kubernetes)
Node.js (Javascript, Typescript)
C# (.NET, ASP.NET, .NET Core)

För att skapa system som är skalbara, säkra och hållbara över tid krävs att du har erfarenhet och kunskap inom Cloudteknologier som Azure, AWS eller GCP. ☁️

Som person är du nyfiken, lösningsorienterad, flexibel och kommunikativ. Du uppskattar gemenskapen i ett team, men kan också ta egna initiativ och driva ditt arbete framåt. Du är flytande i svenska och engelska i både tal och skrift.

Är du vår nästa HiQare?

I Syd har vi kontor i Malmö, Helsingborg och Karlskrona. Om du vill bygga framtidens digitala lösningar, utveckla din kompetens och samtidigt vara en del av ett gäng som tror att skratt, kaffe och kreativitet går hand i hand – då vill vi höra från dig!

👉 Skicka in din ansökan idag och bli en del av HiQ-gemenskapen!

Sist men inte minst!

Vi välkomnar ansökningar från alla - oavsett ålder, könsidentitet eller uttryck, livserfarenhet och bakgrund. Vi tror att mångfald skapar nytänkande och bidrar med fler perspektiv till bordet. Hoppas vi hörs snart!

Arbeta med backendutveckling och vidareutveckling av plattformen
Ta ansvar från behov och underlag till färdig lösning
Självständigt driva tekniska frågor framåt
Ha kontakt med externa leverantörer
Arbeta med testning och CI/CD
Bidra till att utveckla och förbättra tekniska lösningar

Du blir en del av ett engagerat utvecklingsteam i Göteborg med omnejd , där du arbetar nära både utvecklare och projektledare. Du får en viktig roll i teamet och möjlighet att påverka både tekniska lösningar och arbetssätt.

EF Core
API:er och integrationer
Azure

Git och CI/CD

Du blir en del av ett engagerat utvecklingsteam i Göteborg med omnejd , där du arbetar nära både utvecklare och projektledare. Du får en viktig roll i teamet och möjlighet att påverka både tekniska lösningar och arbetssätt.

Mer om dig

Du är en erfaren och självgående .NET-utvecklare som trivs med att ta ansvar och driva dina uppgifter hela vägen från behov till färdig lösning. Du har ett starkt intresse för integrationer och backend och gillar att hitta smarta, hållbara lösningar även när förutsättningarna inte är helt givna från början. jobs.title: Senior cloud-focused Software Engineer
jobs.description:
The job

We are looking for an experienced Software Engineer to join us in building our automation and communication platform. We help solve our customers communication needs by automating repetitive tasks in help desk, sales and marketing. We are looking to do a technical shift and move parts of it to kubernetes running on AWS - do you wanna be part of it from the start?

Software is the core part of our business at Lime and we work together in a cross-functional team for the engineering teams to get the business input. Together with our Product Owners we use ShapeUp as the agile methodology. We meet regularly and decide what’s essential to the product and how it should evolve.

The Engineers at Lime are problem solvers who strive to understand how everything fits together. We do pragmatic solutions to hard problems, a good mix of freedom and responsibility, and most importantly – have a great time at work! We are encouraged to come up with new ideas and experiment a lot. We think long-term and our ambition is to write clean and maintainable code. We take ownership of architecture and automated testing.

We always stick to the “best tool for the problem” approach – we listen to industry trends with interest, but evaluate if something is right for us. We do things that matter to our customers and maintain a vision to stay on the right path.

Requirements

Skills & Requirements

Our main stack

C#
Vue
TypeScript
MS SQL
Redis

Its a real plus if you

Have experience with developing and hosting SaaS solutions on AWS, setting up and maintaining CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps) and previous experience in taking architectural responsibilities in projects

Our process

We have a lightweight process using the latest Agile techniques with stable feature cycles, no deadlines and an emphasis on understanding the actual problem rather than specifications.

Even though we try our best, our tech and processes are far from perfect. That’s why we are looking for like-minded craftspeople to join us on the journey to building a company and product we can be proud of!

What We Offer

A stable and calm working environment
Ergonomic workplace equipment
Continuous education in the latest techs
Promote personal skill development with various activities
Commuter friendly offices in Stockholm, Gothenburg and Lund

experience
