jobs.title: Engineering Manager till Hogia Redovisning & Revision
jobs.description:
Är du en tekniskt stark ledare som drivs av att utveckla både människor och teknik? Vill du leda ett kompetent utvecklingsteam samtidigt som du driver den tekniska utvecklingen mot moderna, molnbaserade lösningar? Hos Hogia Redovisning & Revision får du en nyckelroll där du kombinerar ledarskap, teknikstrategi och innovation med ett nära samarbete med verksamheten.

Om rollen

Som Engineering Manager har du det övergripande ansvaret för ett utvecklingsteam med ca 10 medarbetare bestående av utvecklare och testare. Ditt främsta fokus är att skapa förutsättningar för teamets framgång genom ett närvarande och utvecklande ledarskap, samtidigt som du leder den tekniska utvecklingen framåt.

Du ansvarar för att driva de strategiskt viktiga teknikfrågorna inom området och säkerställa en hållbar utveckling av våra produkter. Rollen innebär ett stort fokus på modernisering, automation och AI-drivna arbetssätt där du tillsammans med teamet identifierar möjligheter att effektivisera utveckling, kvalitetssäkring och leverans. Du följer aktivt utvecklingen inom teknikområdet, omvärldsbevakar och omsätter relevanta trender till konkreta initiativ som stärker både produkterna och arbetssätten.

En viktig del av uppdraget är att balansera förvaltningen av våra hybrida Core-produkter med den fortsatta utvecklingen av våra molnbaserade lösningar. Du arbetar nära produktledning, kravställare och andra utvecklingsteam för att säkerställa rätt tekniska vägval över tid.
Rollen är huvudsakligen strategisk och ledarskapsorienterad, men beroende på situation och behov kan du även bidra operativt i tekniska frågor eller utvecklingsarbete.

Är du den vi söker?

Vi tror att du har en eftergymnasial utbildning inom systemutveckling eller motsvarande samt flera års erfarenhet av modern systemutveckling. Du har tidigare haft personalansvar eller lett utvecklingsteam och känner dig trygg i att kombinera ett coachande ledarskap med tekniskt beslutsfattande.

Du har erfarenhet av moderna utvecklingsmiljöer och molnbaserade lösningar samt ett intresse för hur automation och AI kan skapa effektivare utvecklingsprocesser och bättre produkter.
Vi arbetar bland annat med: C#, .NET Core, Microservices, Azure DevOps, Git, React, HTML/CSS, SQL, Cosmos DB, C++, MFC, XML.
Du behöver inte ha erfarenhet av samtliga tekniker, men du har en bred teknisk förståelse och en vilja att fortsätta utvecklas tillsammans med teamet.

Som person är du en trygg och prestigelös ledare som bygger engagemang, tydlighet och samarbete. Du är strukturerad och har förmågan att prioritera, skapa riktning och driva förändring även när flera initiativ pågår samtidigt. Du trivs med att arbeta långsiktigt, har ett genuint intresse för ny teknik och inspireras av att omsätta nya möjligheter till affärsnytta. Du kommunicerar obehindrat på både svenska och engelska och samarbetar naturligt med kollegor, chefer och externa samarbetspartners.

Vi kommer att lägga stor vikt vid dina personliga egenskaper.

Vad vi erbjuder

Hos oss bygger du lösningar som används av tusentals kunder och blir en viktig del av vår resa mot framtidens molnbaserade affärssystem. Du får möjlighet att påverka både teknikval, arbetssätt och teamets utveckling i en organisation som värdesätter innovation, kvalitet och långsiktighet.
Vi erbjuder goda utvecklingsmöjligheter, en hälsosam balans mellan arbete och fritid samt attraktiva förmåner. Vi satsar på hälsa och erbjuder flera träningsaktiviteter, möjlighet att arbeta hemifrån ett par dagar i veckan och en arbetsmiljö där kompetensutveckling uppmuntras.
Hos Hogia får du en roll där ditt ledarskap och din tekniska förståelse blir avgörande för att forma framtidens produkter.

Tjänsten är placerad i Stenungsund med möjlighet till att arbeta två dagar i veckan på distans.
Vi arbetar med löpande urval och intervjuer, vilket innebär att tjänsten kan tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdag.

Vi kommer börja kontakta intressanta kandidat i mitten av augusti. Under semesterperioden har vi begränsade möjligheter att besvara frågor.

Välkommen med din ansökan!

Om Hogia-gruppen

Hogia utvecklar, säljer och supportar programvaror och IT-system för företag som effektivt vill fokusera på sina verksamheter i stället för krånglig och tidsödande administration. Vi erbjuder allt från mindre löne- och bokföringsprogram för småföretagaren till kompletta, branschspecifika IT-lösningar och -system för exempelvis kollektivtrafik, åkerier, godsterminaler, revisionsbyråer och fastighetsbolag. I Hogiagruppen finns 30 operativa bolag, som vart och ett verkar inom ett väl definierat verksamhetsområde. Vår organisationsform bygger uttalat på småskalighet och entreprenörsanda. Företagskulturen skapar engagerade medarbetare. Tillsammans ger vi våra kunder de bästa tänkbara affärslösningarna. Hogia startade sin verksamhet 1980 i Stenungsund. I dag har den privatägda koncernen totalt 650 anställda på kontor i Sverige, Norge och Finland. Mer information om Hogia finns på www.hogia.se.
Vi på Hogia utvecklar och levererar branschspecifika, verksamhetsstödjande system. Vi har mängder av affärskritiska branschanpassade system som underlättar livet, för att inte tala om lösningar inom ekonomi, lön/HR som passar alla, oavsett bransch.
Vi är experter på att göra administrativa och operativa processer enklare, effektivare och faktiskt lite roligare.
Välkommen till en hel värld av smarta branschlösningar!

jobs.title: Senior Platform Engineer– Public 360° – Tieto Indtech (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Job Description

Senior Platform Engineer
– Public 360° – Tieto Indtech (m/f/d)

Tieto Public 360° – building secure, scalable digital services for the public sector across the Nordics.

About The Company

Tieto's Public 360° is a leading case management platform used across the Nordic public sector for over 20 years. Since 2014, the SaaS platform has been running on modernized Azure infrastructure with automated deployments while also supporting on-prem/hybrid/Domestic cloud installations.

The 360° Platform Currently Powers Three Solutions

Public 360° – Case and archive management

Plan & Build 360° – Building permit applications

eArchive 360° – Long-term data storage

The challenge

We're building on Public 360°'s modern foundation to expand across multiple cloud environments—strengthening Nordic digital sovereignty and enabling AI capabilities, all while maintaining the highest requirements for security and compliance.

The role

As a Senior Platform Engineer, you'll advance the technical capabilities of the 360° hosting platform. You'll design and operate cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes platforms, automation, and security systems that support continued growth and enable new AI-powered features.

Key Responsibilities

Build and operate the cloud platform foundation supporting Public 360° across Public Cloud and Domestic Cloud environments.
Deploy, manage, and continuously improve Kubernetes-based platforms and containerized workloads.
Drive automation through Infrastructure as Code (Bicep), GitOps, CI/CD, and self-service platform capabilities.
Establish secure and scalable platform services covering networking, identity, secrets management, monitoring, and operational governance.
Improve reliability and operational excellence through observability, automation, incident management, and best practices.
Support the modernization of Public 360° through cloud-native technologies, APIs, messaging, and microservices architectures.

Required Qualifications

Several years of experience in Platform Engineering, Cloud Engineering, DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering, or similar roles.
Strong Azure and cloud-native platform experience.
Strong hands-on Kubernetes experience, including:
Cluster deployment, installation, and lifecycle management.
Operations, upgrades, troubleshooting, and maintenance.
Networking, security, and scalability.
Experience operating Kubernetes in cloud, on-premises, or domestic cloud environments.

Experience with Microsoft Azure services, particularly AKS, cloud networking, security monitoring, logging, and observability platforms.
Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Bicep, Terraform or similar), GitOps, and CI/CD using Azure DevOps and/or GitHub.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with sovereign, domestic cloud, hybrid cloud, or other highly regulated environments.
Familiarity with messaging technologies such as RabbitMQ, Kafka, or Azure Service Bus.
Experience with Keycloak or other identity and access management platforms.
Experience operating distributed systems, microservices architectures, or multi-region Kubernetes environments.
Exposure to AI platform infrastructure, intelligent automation, or GenAI technologies.

Tech we use

We are Azure-first and automation-driven, building and operating our platform using Kubernetes (AKS), Docker, containers, GitOps, and Infrastructure as Code with Bicep. Our engineering teams use Azure DevOps and GitHub Workflows for CI/CD and automation, supported by Azure networking and cloud security services. We focus heavily on observability and reliability, using Grafana, Prometheus, Loki, and Alloy for monitoring and telemetry. Authentication and authorization are managed through Keycloak, while RabbitMQ provides messaging capabilities across our platform. Our API and ingress layer is built on technologies such as APISIX and NGINX, with certificate management handled through OpenBao and cert-manager. Development is primarily done using .NET (C#), TypeScript/JavaScript, PowerShell, and Bash, with Visual Studio and Visual Studio Code as our primary development tools.

Why join us

Build technology that improves citizen services across the Nordic public sector.
Work with modern cloud technologies and large-scale enterprise software.
Join a highly skilled and collaborative engineering environment with significant influence on technical decisions.
Opportunity to shape the future platform capabilities supporting Public 360°.
Professional growth through international collaboration, technical leadership opportunities, and continuous learning.
A culture built on trust, transparency, ownership, and innovation.

Practicalities

Location and work setup:
Flexible/hybrid, ideally near one of our development hubs in Scandinavia (Oslo, Stockholm, Copenhagen, or Espoo).

Language requirements:
Fluent English required. Nordic language skills are considered an advantage.

Are you our new colleague?

We look forward to hearing from you! We will fill the position as soon as we find the right person, so we encourage you to apply today.

If you have any questions regarding this role, please contact the hiring managers Ida Sirevaag
(ida.sirevaag@tieto.com) or Geir Are Bjørnsrud
(geirare.bjornsrud@tieto.com).

Additional Information

At Tieto, we believe in the power of diversity, equity, and inclusion. We encourage applicants of all backgrounds, genders (m/f/d), and walks of life to join our team, as we believe that this fosters an inspiring workplace and fuels innovation. Our commitment to openness, trust, and diversity is at the heart of our mission to create digital futures that benefit businesses, societies, and humanity.

jobs.title: AI Engineer
jobs.description:
Norrin is an AI integrator, enabling end-to-end Enterprise AI and data solutions that turn ambition into production and drive real productivity gains. We co-create the solutions, infrastructure, and adoption that make it stick. What brings us together is deep technical expertise, a creative engineering mindset, and a people-first culture. Norrin has strong roots in Finland while operating internationally across the Nordics, the United States, and APAC. Our presence across the Nordics has continued strengthening with BizOne recently joining the Norrin Group.

We’re now looking for an AI Engineer
to join our growing team in Stockholm. In this role, you will work directly with customers to design, build, and deploy AI-powered solutions that solve real business problems. You’ll combine broad engineering capability with hands-on delivery, moving fast from idea to working prototypes to production-ready value. This role is about creative engineering, co-creation with users, and shaping how enterprises adopt AI in practice. You will also be part of Norrin’s AI Guild, a community where knowledge is shared, skills are developed together, and people actively support each other’s growth.

In this role, you will

Work closely with customers to understand their problems and rapidly design practical AI solutions
Implement end-to-end AI/ML workflows, from agents and RAG setups to traditional ML where needed
Build and deploy cloud-native applications, preferably on Azure
Apply modern software engineering practices (Git, CI/CD, quality-oriented development)
Use MLOps approaches to operationalize models, monitor them, and ensure they deliver value
Integrate with APIs and enterprise systems (REST, events, custom interfaces)
Work with databases, SQL, and pragmatic data engineering where required
Navigate between solution shaping, hands-on implementation, and light advisory, depending on the customer phase

What We’re Looking For

4+ years of experience in software or data applications, ideally with hands-on AI/ML components
Experience with AI agents and large language models (LLMs)
Strong cloud development background (Azure preferred)
Strong skills in Python and modern engineering practices (Git, CI/CD, testing mindset)
Experience with deploying and operating ML systems in production
Solid understanding of APIs, integrations, databases, and SQL
Ability to frame problems, design pragmatic solutions, and work directly with end-users
Strong English and Swedish skills (written & spoken)
Educational background in computer science, applied mathematics, engineering, or similar

Nice to have

Experience with IaC and containerization (Terraform, Docker)
Familiarity with PyTorch, LangChain/LlamaIndex, deep learning, and LLM evaluation frameworks
Experience working with data platforms (Databricks, Microsoft Fabric, event streams, data warehouses)
Background in structured testing approaches to ensure robustness
Prior consulting or customer-facing engineering experience
Prior leadership or consulting experience, with the ability to guide teams and advise stakeholders

Why Norrin? 

At Norrin, you'll join an international team
of 220 professionals working across Finland, Sweden, Thailand, Vietnam, and the United States. We work with nordic enterprises that have the ambition to be the forerunners in data and AI across a wide range of industries, from industrial and finance to retail and energy. The diversity of projects, technologies, and business challenges
keeps the work both meaningful and engaging. We never work alone but always together with clients and our colleagues.

We invest in continuous learning
through training and certification opportunities, as well as our guild communities where knowledge is shared and built together. As a Microsoft and Databricks partner, we work with leading technologies and support you in continuously expanding your expertise. At Norrin, you'll have the opportunity to grow in a direction that matters to you. We believe that great work starts with a supportive environment. That's why we foster a culture built on openness, equality, and mutual respect
, with psychological safety at its core .
We're committed to promoting diversity, inclusion, and equal opportunities in the tech industry.

Our hybrid working model
combines flexibility with collaboration, giving you the freedom to work remotely while bringing people together when it creates the most value. To support your well-being, we also offer wellbeing benefits
like insurance coverage and an annual wellness allowance. Depending on the role, our competitive compensation model
offers a fixed salary model or a hybrid model including base salary and a performance-based bonus.

Could this be your next opportunity?

We’re excited to hear from you! Submit your application as soon as possible, as we will review applications on an ongoing basis and move forward as soon as we find the right match.

jobs.description:
Var med och forma framtidens datadrivna och AI-drivna organisationer 

De flesta organisationer ser idag att data och AI är avgörande för framtida konkurrenskraft. Utmaningen är att veta var man ska börja och hur man skapar rätt förutsättningar för att lyckas över tid.

Våra kunder står inför strategiska beslut kring plattformar, arkitektur, styrning och AI-adoption. De beslut som fattas idag kommer att påverka deras förmåga att utveckla verksamheten, skapa innovation och dra nytta av data under många år framöver. 

Att fatta rätt beslut från början är avgörande. Fel arkitektur kan bromsa utveckling, öka kostnader och begränsa möjligheten att skapa värde från investeringar i data och AI. 

Som Data & AI Architect på Nexer Insight hjälper du kunder att navigera dessa beslut genom att definiera framtida arkitekturer, vägleda teknikval och forma strategiska transformationsinitiativ. 

Du kommer att påverka både teknikstrategi, affärsprioriteringar och långsiktig kundframgång samtidigt som du hjälper organisationer att bygga grunden för en datadriven framtid. 

Utmaningar du kommer att arbeta med: 

Modernisera äldre data- och analysmiljöer 
Definiera framtida arkitekturer 
Etablera skalbara och säkra plattformar 
Säkerställa att teknikinvesteringar stödjer affärsmålen 
Skapa de förutsättningar som krävs för AI-adoption 

Projekt/arbetsuppgifter du kan bli en del av:

Ta fram strategier för data, analys och AI 
Designa arkitekturer baserade på Microsoft Fabric och Databricks 
Leda arkitekturworkshops med verksamhets- och teknikledare 
Driva större transformationsinitiativ inom dataområdet 
Stödja organisationer i arbetet med ansvarsfull AI-adoption 

Du kommer att spela en central roll i beslut som påverkar både teknik och affärsutveckling. 

Tekniker och plattformar 

Microsoft Fabric 
Azure 
Databricks 
Data Governance 
Analytics Platforms 
AI Services 
Enterprise Architecture 

Varför Nexer Insight? 

Hos oss blir du en del av ett team med arkitekter, data engineers, data scientists och AI-specialister som tillsammans hjälper kunder att lösa komplexa verksamhets- och teknikrelaterade utmaningar.

Du får möjlighet att lära av erfarna kollegor, påverka tekniska beslut och arbeta nära kunder i projekt som skapar verkligt affärsvärde.

Du blir en del av ett team vars kompetens har uppmärksammats av Microsoft genom vårt Solutions Partner-status och våra Advanced Specializations inom Analytics på Microsoft Azure samt Data & AI. Det är certifieringar som endast ett fåtal organisationer i Norden har, vilket speglar den erfarenhet, specialistkompetens och leveransförmåga som finns hos våra medarbetare.

Vi är även Databricks Consulting Partner med Select-status, vilket ger oss möjlighet att arbeta nära en av marknadens ledande plattformar för data, analys och AI. För dig innebär det möjligheten att arbeta med moderna teknologier, erfarna specialister och några av marknadens mest spännande data- och AI-initiativ.

Med rötter i svensk entreprenörsanda och innovation har vi hjälpt kunder att ligga steget före sedan internets början – i allt från strategi till teknik och kommunikation.

Idag är vi en betrodd partner för några av världens största och mest krävande organisationer.

Vi hjälper organisationer att omsätta data och AI till mätbart affärsvärde genom att kombinera strategi, styrning, teknik och förändringsledning. På så sätt skapar vi förutsättningar för ansvarsfull AI-adoption, datadrivet beslutsfattande och långsiktig tillväxt.

Dataarkitektur och lösningsdesign

The team

The Fungible team is the “rapid-response squad” within the Field Engineering organisation that engages with customers on the most strategic, highest-potential opportunities across Benelux and the Nordics to accelerate critical use cases, land technical wins, and drive successful Databricks adoption. If you enjoy working on novel use cases across a variety of industries on highly visible engagements, this is the right home for you!

The role

As a Fungible Solutions Architect, you lead the technical strategy on time-boxed, targeted engagements
- typically one to five months - aimed at accelerating a specific set of critical customer workloads from evaluation to a production-grade technical win. You own the architecture conversation, drive platform adoption, and act as a trusted advisor to customer architects and engineering leaders, then transition the momentum you've built to the core account team.

You bring technical depth and the judgment to apply it fast, in situations that require strong ownership
and are highly visible

The impact you will have

Accelerate what matters most: parachute into strategic, high-profile opportunities and own a clearly defined technical area, moving critical workloads and use cases from evaluation toward production and consumption.

Hand off, don't hold on: package your progress into a clean transition to core SAs, DSAs, specialists, or partners so wins are sustained and expanded after you move to the next engagement.

Several years of experience (typically ~6+) in solutions architecture, data engineering, technical pre-sales, or a senior hands-on technical role, or a track record that demonstrates equivalent depth.

Depth in distributed data systems and production cloud deployments (AWS, Azure, or GCP), scalable pipelines, streaming, and lakehouse patterns, plus the infrastructure, security, and governance to run them.
Proficiency on the Databricks Platform, or a demonstrated ability to ramp on new technology quickly. A strong "spike" in an area such as real-time/streaming, ML/AI, data governance, or migrations helps you add value fast.
Experience leading architecture discussions with senior technical stakeholders, design reviews, trade-off analysis, clear recommendations, and translating complex architecture into business value for both engineers and executives.
The temperament this team runs on: comfort with ambiguity and time-boxed engagements, strong prioritisation, and a genuine preference for variety and high-impact work.

Databricks certifications (Data Engineer, ML, or Platform).

Sergel Group is one of the leading providers of credit management services in the Nordic region. We offer services within credit scoring, debt collection, debt purchasing, as well as messaging and payment solutions. Sergel is part of Marginalen Group and has just over 150 employees across Sweden, Denmark, Norway, and Finland.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Sergel is on an exciting journey to strengthen its in-house capabilities, bringing more competence and ownership closer to the business. This means several ongoing development areas and new projects where data plays a central role, and the people who work with it are central to Sergel's ability to compete and grow across the Nordic market.

In this role, you will drive the development of scalable, efficient and compliant data solutions, with a strong focus on operational excellence and exploring new opportunities for innovation. You will have significant autonomy and a broad mandate to influence technical direction, make key decisions and ensure they are executed with real impact.

We are looking for someone who combines strong technical expertise with a natural drive to take ownership and move things forward. Over time, you are motivated by the opportunity to take on greater responsibility and a more leading position within the area.

Your responsibilities will include:
• Defining and enforcing data modeling standards, best practices and governance policies.
• Designing and maintaining scalable data pipelines and optimizing ETL processes.
• Building and maintaining applications and integrations for data ingestion, transformation and delivery.
• Driving the shift from external-dependent delivery toward strong in-house capability.
• Setting the technical direction and owning key architectural decisions.
• Ensuring that BI is an integral part of the data platform, enabling trusted reporting, analytics and data-driven decision-making across the organization.

QUALIFICATIONS AND EXPERIENCE

You are someone who combines deep technical expertise with a natural drive to take ownership. You communicate clearly across technical and non-technical stakeholders and thrive in environments where you can shape and improve things rather than just maintain them.
You enjoy working closely with others, sharing knowledge and helping the team grow through collaboration, curiosity and mutual respect. You are humble enough to listen and confident enough to challenge when needed.

You also bring:
• Solid experience as a Data Engineer and experience with designing, modeling and implementing data-intensive systems.
• Strong proficiency in SQL and C# .NET/Python.
• Experience with ETL tools, data pipeline frameworks and orchestration tools.
• Understanding of CI/CD principles.
• Knowledge of data governance, GDPR compliance and security best practices.
• The ability to drive technical decisions and set standards.
• Fluency in English.
• Valid work permit.

You don't need to be senior in every area listed above. If you bring strong fundamentals and the right mindset, there is room to develop and grow into the full scope of the role.

Meriting experience:
• Experience from financial services, credit or similar data-intensive industries.
• Knowledge of one of the Nordic languages.
• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, or a related field.

In Sergel, we care about the people we meet. We are a company with a culture based on trust and learning, where we work towards strengthening individuals through competence, compassion and a high level of engagement.
Together, we work with clear ownership and shared responsibility towards our stakeholders, which creates long-term and loyal business relations. We always try to find new ways of working and challenging the market. We want our employees to develop with the company and have fun with their colleagues on the way.

jobs.title: 1 Systemutvecklare Backend
jobs.description:
Vill du arbeta med den senaste teknologin och som del av ett scrum-team, med stöd av kompetenta och trevliga kollegor i en kreativ och internationell miljö? Vill du ha en arbetsgivare som satsar på ett hållbart medarbetarskap och erbjuder trygga, förmånliga arbetsvillkor? Välkommen att söka anställning som systemutvecklare på Uppsala universitet.

National Bioinformatics Infrastructure Sweden (NBIS) söker nu ytterligare 1 systemutvecklare. Vi är en nationell infrastruktur vars syfte är att tillhandahålla support för bioinformatiker och forskare inom livsvetenskaperna. Systemutvecklingsgruppen består av två scrumteam som utvecklar verktyg för storskalig datahantering och webbapplikationer för forskargrupper och EU-finansierade projekt, allt inom området bioinformatik.

Att vara en del av ett av våra team ger dig möjlighet att göra skillnad, genom att arbeta i projekt vars mål är att göra forskningsdata säker och delbar. Du kommer att vara anställd vid Uppsala universitet, på Institutionen för cell- och molekylärbiologi (ICM), och vara knuten till NBIS och Science for Life Laboratory (SciLifeLab). Mer information om NBIS finns på https://nbis.se. 

Arbetsuppgifter

Som systemutvecklare kommer du att vara ansvarig för utveckling och underhåll av en delningsplattform för mänsklig genomikdata från forskningsprojekt, i samarbete med våra partners i andra europeiska länder. Målet med dessa projekt, som Genomic Data Infrastructure (GDI), är att hjälpa forskare att kunna dela sin data på ett säkert vis, och att på så sätt underlätta deras samarbeten runt mänsklig hälsa och medicin.

Projektet GDI handlar om att möjliggöra säker tillgång till genomiska och kliniska data inom EU, för att kunna förbättra klinisk diagnostik, behandlingar och prediktiv medicin. Bigpicture är ett annat europeiskt flaggskepp som syftar till att bygga en Petabyte plattform för AI inom digital patologi. Våra samarbetspartner kommer från akademin såväl som sjukvården och industrin.

Du kommer arbeta tätt tillsammans med andra utvecklare i ett av våra scrum-team och bidra till de ovan nämnda projekten. Scrum-teamet är ansvarig för produkternas hela livscykel, från planering och utveckling, till driftsättning och underhåll. Du kommer vara del av ett team som värdesätter kreativitet och ser gärna att du är med och påverkar alla beslut inom gruppen. 

Kvalifikationskrav

Du som sökande skall minst ha kandidatexamen inom informationsteknik, datateknik, datavetenskap, systemvetenskap eller bioinformatik, alternativt motsvarande dokumenterad kompetens inom ett eller flera av dessa områden.

Vidare krävs:

Minst fem års dokumenterad erfarenhet i systemutveckling med Python och Java
Minst fem års dokumenterad erfarenhet i Kubernetes med Helm och Hashicorp Vault eller OpenBao
Minst fem års erfarenhet av databaser, t. ex. PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB
Minst fem års dokumenterad erfarenhet av virtualiseringslösningar och mjukvaru-containrar (t.ex. Docker eller Podman)
Minst fem års erfarenhet av versionshantering med Git och CI/CD (t. ex. GitHub Actions, GitLab CI/CD, Bitbucket Pipelines)
Minst fem års erfarenhet av att arbeta agilt enligt scrum och scrum-rollerna certifikat (scrummaster eller produktägare)
Minst fem års dokumenterad erfarenhet i Infrastructure as Code med Terraform och Ansible och ett eller flera molnleverantörer (t. ex. Azure, AWS, Google Cloud)
Minst fem års erfarenhet och god förståelse av nätverk (TLS, TCP/UDP, HTTPS, routing) 
Att du kan uttrycka dig obehindrat på svenska och engelska, både i tal och skrift.

Stor vikt kommer att läggas vid personlig lämplighet, den sökande ska ha mycket god samarbetsförmåga, initiativförmåga och goda kommunikativa kvaliteter.

Önskvärt/meriterande i övrigt

Följande räknas som meriterande:

Vana att arbeta i fysiskt distribuerade team med kommunikation och koordination via elektroniska verktyg som videomöten och liknande.
Erfarenhet av att arbeta med informationssäkerhet är starkt meriterande
God förståelse av mekanismer för autentisering och auktorisation (t. ex. OAuth, JWT)
Kunskap om bioinformatik, i synnerhet är erfarenhet av verktyg och metoder för analys av human genomikdata särskilt efterfrågat.
Erfarenhet av verktyg för projektmanagement, t. ex. Zenhub, Jira.

jobs.description:
Apply here: https://career.aura.group/en-GB/jobs/8366131-ai-solutions-engineer

Build AI that works in the real world

We are looking for an AI Solutions Engineer who wants to build AI solutions that work inside client environments, pass their security reviews and keep running after the project closes. This is not about prototypes or pilots. It is about getting solutions into production, connected to the systems clients actually use.

The role

You will work alongside our AI engineers and transformation strategists to design, build and deploy agentic solutions for clients. You will handle everything from technical design and integrations to cloud deployment and client-facing conversations about what you have built.

A central part of the role is contributing to reusable architectures and standards so that each new engagement builds on the last rather than starting from scratch. The role spans infrastructure, integrations and technical design. You may not be equally strong in all three, and we are not expecting that. We are looking for range and the appetite to keep widening it.

Contribute to the technical design of AI solutions, including agent architecture, tool selection and orchestration, and integration logic
Build and maintain integrations into client systems, including REST APIs, gateways and connections into marketing and communications technology platforms
Set up and operate solutions on Azure or AWS, covering deployment, monitoring, access control and cost management
Take part in client meetings, turning requirements into technical options and explaining what has been built to non-technical stakeholders
Contribute to reusable architectures and components that carry over to the next client
Ensure that security and data governance requirements are addressed throughout the build process

What good looks like after 6 months

Solutions you have worked on are running in client environments and can be maintained by more than one person
The client's IT and security teams are comfortable working with you directly
Integration work you have contributed to is being reused across clients
Colleagues actively want you on their engagements

Who you are

You are someone who is motivated by getting things to work in practice, not just in theory. You have a few years of experience working in tech and are comfortable being the only technical person in a room, explaining trade-offs without jargon and being honest about what will and will not work. You are curious, you ask when you do not know, and you document what you build so others can maintain it.

To succeed in this role you bring a combination of the following experience and strengths:
Experience shipping production code, including working in unfamiliar codebases
Hands-on experience with Azure or AWS, including setting up and managing infrastructure in production
Integration experience including REST APIs, authentication and webhooks
Experience building solutions powered by LLMs (e.g. OpenAI, Anthropic), with practical understanding of how agents behave with real data
Working knowledge of security and data protection principles (e.g. least privilege, data residency), with the ability to identify when specialist support is needed
Professional English. Swedish is an advantage but not required

Nice to have

Experience from an agency or consultancy environment
Familiarity with marketing and communications technology platforms
Experience with Node.js and/or Python

Working at Comprend

Comprend is a place of belonging, where people are valued and empowered to create impact. We embrace diverse perspectives, bridge gaps, dare to challenge and win as a team. This is a full-time position. We prefer you to be based in Stockholm, Helsingborg or Malmö, where most of the team is located, but are open to discuss placement in London or Helsinki as well. We offer a competitive employment package.

About Comprend

Comprend is a partner for tech-enabled marketing and communication driving transformative impact. We are 200 specialists collaborating across Sweden, Finland and the UK. With extensive expertise and a strong track record in B2B, B2C and corporate communication, we help clients decode complexity, influence audiences and strengthen brand perception. With us, your voice will be one of many diverse and highly valued perspectives that shape how we work and partner with our clients. Comprend is part of Aura, a leading consultancy group with over 500 specialists across a wide mix of backgrounds and expertise.

jobs.title: 1 Systemutvecklare Backend med inriktning mot systemarkitektur
jobs.description:
Vill du arbeta med den senaste teknologin och som del av ett scrum-team, med stöd av kompetenta och trevliga kollegor i en kreativ och internationell miljö? Vill du ha en arbetsgivare som satsar på ett hållbart medarbetarskap och erbjuder trygga, förmånliga arbetsvillkor? Välkommen att söka anställning som systemutvecklare på Uppsala universitet.

National Bioinformatics Infrastructure Sweden (NBIS) söker nu ytterligare 1 systemutvecklare. Vi är en nationell infrastruktur vars syfte är att tillhandahålla support för bioinformatiker och forskare inom livsvetenskaperna. Systemutvecklingsgruppen består av två scrumteam som utvecklar verktyg för storskalig datahantering och webbapplikationer för forskargrupper och EU-finansierade projekt, allt inom området bioinformatik.

Att vara en del av ett av våra team ger dig möjlighet att göra skillnad, genom att arbeta i projekt vars mål är att göra forskningsdata säker och delbar. Du kommer att vara anställd vid Uppsala universitet, på Institutionen för cell- och molekylärbiologi (ICM), och vara knuten till NBIS och Science for Life Laboratory (SciLifeLab). Mer information om NBIS finns på https://nbis.se. 

Arbetsuppgifter

Som systemutvecklare kommer du att vara ansvarig för utveckling och underhåll av en delningsplattform för mänsklig genomikdata från forskningsprojekt, i samarbete med våra partners i andra europeiska länder. Målet med dessa projekt, som Genomic Data Infrastructure (GDI), är att hjälpa forskare att kunna dela sin data på ett säkert vis, och att på så sätt underlätta deras samarbeten runt mänsklig hälsa och medicin.

Projektet GDI handlar om att möjliggöra säker tillgång till genomiska och kliniska data inom EU, för att kunna förbättra klinisk diagnostik, behandlingar och prediktiv medicin. Bigpicture är ett annat europeiskt flaggskepp som syftar till att bygga en Petabyte plattform för AI inom digital patologi. Våra samarbetspartner kommer från akademin såväl som sjukvården och industrin.

Du kommer arbeta tätt tillsammans med andra utvecklare i ett av våra scrum-team och bidra till de ovan nämnda projekten. Scrum-teamet är ansvarig för produkternas hela livscykel, från planering och utveckling, till driftsättning och underhåll. Du kommer vara del av ett team som värdesätter kreativitet och ser gärna att du är med och påverkar alla beslut inom gruppen. 

Kvalifikationskrav

Du som sökande skall minst ha kandidatexamen inom informationsteknik, datateknik, datavetenskap, systemvetenskap eller bioinformatik, alternativt motsvarande dokumenterad kompetens inom ett eller flera av dessa områden.

Vidare krävs:

Minst fem års dokumenterad erfarenhet i systemutveckling med Golang och Kubernetes inklusive Observability (t. ex. OpenTelemetry, OpenTracing, Prometheus, Datadog)
Helm och Hashicorp Vault eller OpenBao

Minst fem års dokumenterad erfarenhet i Infrastructure as Code med Terraform och Ansible och ett eller flera molnleverantörer (t. ex. Azure, AWS, Google Cloud)
Minst sju års dokumenterad erfarenhet av virtualiseringslösningar och mjukvaru-containrar (t.ex. Docker eller Podman)
Minst sju års erfarenhet av versionshantering med Git och CI/CD (t. ex., GitHub Actions, GitLab CI/CD, Bitbucket Pipelines) och Bash
Minst sju års erfarenhet av databaser, t. ex. PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB
Minst sju års erfarenhet och god förståelse av meddelandeköer eller händelseströmmar (t. ex. RabbitMQ, Kafka)
Minst sju års erfarenhet av att arbeta agilt enligt scrum
Att du kan uttrycka dig obehindrat på engelska och svenska, både i tal och skrift.

Stor vikt kommer att läggas vid personlig lämplighet, den sökande ska ha mycket god samarbetsförmåga, initiativförmåga och goda kommunikativa kvaliteter.

Önskvärt/meriterande i övrigt

Följande räknas som meriterande:

Vana att arbeta i fysiskt distribuerade team med kommunikation och koordination via elektroniska verktyg som videomöten och liknande.
Erfarenhet av att arbeta med informationssäkerhet är starkt meriterande
Erfarenhet av att undervisa och handleda
God förståelse av mekanismer för autentisering och auktorisation (t. ex. OAuth, JWT)
Kunskap om bioinformatik, i synnerhet är erfarenhet av verktyg och metoder för analys av human genomikdata särskilt efterfrågat.
Erfarenhet av scrum-rollerna (scrummaster, produktägare).
Erfarenhet av verktyg för projektmanagement, t. ex. Zenhub, Jira.
Erfarenhet av arbete med infrastruktursystem för känsliga data, speciellt inom den offentliga sektorn eller akademin.

jobs.description:
Jobba hos oss här får du frihet, passion, kunskap och work-life balance.

Hos oss är det ena projektet inte det andra likt. Just nu söker vi efter seniora utvecklare som gillar att ta ansvar, samarbeta och driva utvecklingen framåt. Våra kunder ligger ofta i teknikframkanten och du kommer att få uppdrag där din insats gör skillnad för människor lång tid framöver, kanske till och med ändra på vad vi idag ser som normalt till något nytt.

Du kommer att arbeta i tvärfunktionella team tillsammans med andra utvecklare, UX, Product Managers och andra kompetenser. Uppdragen kan se olika ut, men gemensamt är att du får möjlighet att vara med hela vägen – från behov och idé till färdig lösning i produktion.

Vi tycker att det är bra ifall du känner till några av följande teknologier:

God erfarenhet av modern mjukvaruutveckling, frontend och/eller backend.
TypeScript, JavaScript, Node.js, Java, Kotlin eller liknande.
React, Angular eller motsvarande moderna frontendramverk.
Molnplattformar som AWS, Azure eller Google Cloud Platform.
Docker och/eller Kubernetes.
Terraform eller motsvarande verktyg för infrastructure as code.
RESTful services och API-utveckling.
CI/CD, exempelvis GitHub Actions eller motsvarande.
Testning, observability och arbete med kvalitet och hållbar arkitektur.

Vi söker
dig som är senior och självgående och som kan bidra från första dagen.

Du har en stabil grund inom mjukvaruutveckling och känner dig hemma i moderna utvecklingsmiljöer. Du kan ta ansvar för dina tekniska beslut, samarbeta med andra och omsätta behov till lösningar som skapar värde.

Du är nyfiken på ny teknik och tycker att det är spännande att utvecklas tillsammans med tekniken. Erfarenhet av AI-assisterad och agentisk utveckling, exempelvis med Claude Code eller Codex, är meriterande och kan vara en naturlig del av ditt utvecklingsarbete.

Framför allt söker vi dig som vill vara med och utveckla både våra kunders lösningar och oss som team.

Vi söker efter personer som behärskar svenska i tal och skrift.

Att vara konsult på Sylog

Att vara konsult hos oss innebär att du arbetar under ett varumärke som står för kvalitet, teknisk kompetens och långsiktiga samarbeten. Med vår långa erfarenhet inom inbyggda system och systemutveckling är vi ett namn som våra kunder litar på.

Vi brukar säga att vår anställningsform kombinerar det bästa av två världar och så har det varit sedan starten av Sylog 2002. Självständigheten och friheten som många förknippar med att vara egen, tillsammans med tryggheten och förmånerna som kommer med en anställning.

Vi behandlar ansökningar löpande, så varmt välkommen att skicka in din ansökan redan idag! Just nu söker vi efter personer som behärskar svenska i tal och skrift.

jobs.title: Forward Deployed AI Engineering Intern
jobs.description:
About The Job

We are looking for two Forward Deployed AI Engineering Interns to join our tech development team. You will get the opportunity to build software used by financial institutions and gain hands-on experience working with real products, client data and users.

We are building the next generation of financial intelligence on Palantir Foundry, working side by side with Advisense’s regulatory specialists. You will work alongside experienced engineers, product owners and regulatory specialists, contributing across data, backend and frontend and taking on more complex work as you grow.

AI is an integral part of how we work. Claude Code, Codex and Foundry’s AI tooling are part of our working day, while AI is also embedded in the products we build. During the internship, you will learn how to use AI effectively and responsibly while understanding, validating and testing the code you produce.

As Part Of Our Tech Development Team, You Will

Contribute to production modules across data, backend and frontend.
Build and improve APIs, data pipelines, integrations and user interfaces.
Help turn financial and regulatory requirements into useful and correct product features.
Explore and implement AI-enabled workflows with guidance from experienced engineers.
Take part in client implementations together with a senior engineer.
Learn to test, deploy, monitor and maintain production software.
Take part in code reviews, technical discussions and product development from discovery through release.

Background And Experience

Programming experience in both Python and TypeScript, from academic, professional, personal or open-source work.
At least one application or substantial software project you have built.
Interest in working across frontend, backend, data and AI.
An eye for clear and useful user experiences.
Curiosity about AI-enabled applications and AI-assisted development.
Willingness to understand, test and take responsibility for the code you produce.
A collaborative approach and openness to feedback.
Professional proficiency in English. Swedish is appreciated but not required.

Experience with Palantir Foundry, cloud platforms, AI tools, financial services or regulated data is beneficial but not required.

Who You Are

We are looking for someone at the beginning of their engineering career with strong foundations, curiosity and a genuine interest in building software. We do not expect you to arrive as a complete engineer – what matters is that you enjoy solving problems, learn quickly and are motivated to develop across different parts of the technology stack.

You are curious about AI and want to learn how to use it effectively and responsibly in software development. You enjoy collaborating with others, are open to feedback and are motivated to take on more ownership as your experience grows.

You will join a small, collaborative development team where experienced engineers provide technical guidance and support. During the internship, you will gain hands-on experience across the full product stack, work with software used by real financial institutions and gradually take on more ownership as your experience grows.

Additional Information

This is a 12-month paid internship based in Stockholm, with two positions available.

We review applications continuously, so don’t wait—apply as soon as you’re ready! As long as the job posting is live, the position is still available.

Our selection process is designed to highlight your strengths through interviews and a technical case. We focus on competencies throughout the process and strive to make your experience as smooth as possible by keeping you informed along the way.

To comply with GDPR regulations, we do not accept applications via email. Please submit your application through the official application portal.

Company Description

Advisense has grown to become a market-leading expert company in governance, risk, and compliance (GRC). Through the acquisition of Transcendent Group in 2022, we are now the largest independent consulting firm in the Nordics in this area, helping our clients with advisory, services, technology, and fund solutions. We strive to be the best workplace for GRC experts and have more than 450 employees at our offices in Sweden, Belgium, Denmark, Finland, Germany, Lithuania and Norway. Read more about us here.

Who We Are

Helsing is a defence AI company. Our mission is to protect our democracies. We aim to achieve technological leadership, so that open societies can continue to make sovereign decisions and control their ethical standards.

As democracies, we believe we have a special responsibility to be thoughtful about the development and deployment of powerful technologies like AI. We take this responsibility seriously.

We are an ambitious and committed team of engineers, AI specialists and customer-facing programme managers. We are looking for mission-driven people to join our European teams – and apply their skills to solve the most complex and impactful problems. We embrace an open and transparent culture that welcomes healthy debates on the use of technology in defence, its benefits, and its ethical implications.

The role

At Helsing we develop and deliver AI-based capabilities and the enabling infrastructure that allow semi-autonomous platforms to localise, navigate, and perceive the world in real time. We build software that is subject to significant and unorthodox technical constraints, must operate in a wide variety of constantly-changing environments, and has to support an ever-growing list of challenging use-cases. What we build ultimately ends up in the hands of real people in high-risk, high-stress situations, so must
be both reliable and frictionless. Taken together, this brings a whole host of interesting engineering challenges across a wide variety of fields that you’ll help us solve. To give some examples:

Distributed systems (e.g., intermittent connectivity and byzantine actors)
Embedded computing (e.g., resource-constrained compute and reverse-engineering)
Robotics (e.g., control systems and tasking)
Networking (e.g., long-range low-bandwidth radios and cross-medium routing)
Deployment infrastructure (e.g., air-gapped devices and heterogenous fleets)
Security (e.g., data sharing in low-trust, no-TLS networks and actually-secret data handling)
Machine learning (e.g., systems for model development, storage, and dissemination)

In several of these areas, we are working near the state-of-the-art; we actively read (and sometimes implement) research papers, and often need to push even further to make theory work in practice. In others, we are applying well-known techniques to real-world situations (with real-world limitations) that have never been used in before, which requires skill, diligence, and honing a deep understanding of the underlying technologies.

The day-to-day

Review code contributions, proposals, and RFCs from colleagues. At Helsing we strongly believe that unblocking others takes precedence over spending more time on your own work.
Propose and implement new features, capabilities, algorithms, infrastructure, or even full products across our stack. We encourage our engineers to look beyond their immediate team for missed opportunities, and to speak up when they identify one.
Become a mentor, find a mentee, and help support and develop our interviewing pipeline. The people make or break the company, and we want as many engineers as possible to be part of fostering and growing the organisation.
Share your experience and technical know-how with other Helsingers. We host tech talks, get together for smaller “let’s learn together” groups, run topical office hours (e.g., on Rust), etc. to help each other get better with time.
Maintain our existing software stack, including working with internal and external customers to identify issues, improving operational reliability and performance, and fending off technical debt. The stack is a mix of Rust and Python, with Python mainly living in the ML-heavy sections.
Further develop our tests and benchmarks, both at the micro and macro level. We operate in a domain where robustness is of the utmost importance, and an extensive and ever-improving test suite is key to achieving that. And without thorough benchmarks, we would be flying blind.
Present your work at our weekly demo sessions. We want engineers to come together around what they are working on and to feel like they are not endlessly squirrelling away at something that doesn’t matter. To that end, we host (and actively work towards) demo sessions that allow early feedback, celebration of progress, and a better shared understanding of everything that goes on at Helsing.

You should apply if you

Can write legible, maintainable, and performant code.
Communicate well in English, both verbally and in writing.
Enjoy collaborating with others, including reviewing code and pair programming.
Are comfortable working asynchronously (writing PRs and RFCs, having discussions by email).
Have backend development experience, ideally with a language like Rust, Java, Go, or C++.
Are familiar with backend interface tools like REST, GraphQL, gRPC/Protocol Buffers, and Arrow.
Strive to improve yourself, your peers, and the culture you work in over time.
Feel like ethical considerations are an inherent part of engineering.

Note: We operate at an intersection where women, as well as other minority groups, are systematically under-represented. We encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all the listed qualifications; ability and impact cannot be summarised in a few bullet points.

Nice to have

Rust and Python specifically.
Container-based and cloud-native application architectures (e.g., Docker, Azure, AWS).
Metrics tooling (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, ELK).
SQL and streaming database systems.
Routing protocols (e.g., IGP, BGP).
Cryptographic protocols (e.g., Signal, WireGuard).
Hardware interfaces (e.g., Arduino).
Robotics (e.g., control systems).
Production ML systems.

Join Helsing and work with world-leading experts in their fields

Helsing’s work is important. You’ll be directly contributing to the protection of democratic countries while balancing both ethical and geopolitical concerns.
The work is unique. We operate in a domain that has highly unusual technical requirements and constraints, and where robustness, safety, and ethical considerations are vital. You will face unique Engineering and AI challenges that make a meaningful impact in the world.
Our work frequently takes us right up to the state of the art in technical innovation, be it reinforcement learning, distributed systems, generative AI, or deployment infrastructure. The defence industry is entering the most exciting phase of the technological development curve. Advances in our field of world are not incremental: Helsing is part of, and often leading, historic leaps forward.
In our domain, success is a matter of order-of-magnitude improvements and novel capabilities. This means we take bets, aim high, and focus on big opportunities. Despite being a relatively young company, Helsing has already been selected for multiple significant government contracts.
We actively encourage healthy, proactive, and diverse debate internally about what we do and how we choose to do it. Teams and individual engineers are trusted (and encouraged) to practise responsible autonomy and critical thinking, and to focus on outcomes, not conformity. At Helsing you will have a say in how we (and you!) work, the opportunity to engage on what does and doesn’t work, and to take ownership of aspects of our culture that you care deeply about.

What We Offer

A focus on outcomes, not time-tracking
Competitive compensation and VSOP options
Relocation support
Social and education allowances
Regular company events and all-hands to bring together employees as one team across Europe
A hands-on onboarding program (affectionately labelled “Infraduction”), in which you will be building tooling and applications to be used across the company. This is your opportunity to learn our tech stack, explore the company, and learn how we get things done - all whilst working with other engineering teams from day one

Helsing is an equal opportunities employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, religion, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability or gender identity. Please do not submit personal data revealing racial or ethnic origin, political opinions, religious or philosophical beliefs, trade union membership, data concerning your health, or data concerning your sexual orientation.

jobs.description:
Jobba hos oss här får du frihet, passion, kunskap och work-life balance.

Hos oss är det ena projektet inte det andra likt. Just nu söker vi efter seniora utvecklare som gillar att ta ansvar, samarbeta och driva utvecklingen framåt. Våra kunder ligger ofta i teknikframkanten och du kommer att få uppdrag där din insats gör skillnad för människor lång tid framöver, kanske till och med ändra på vad vi idag ser som normalt till något nytt.

Du kommer att arbeta i tvärfunktionella team tillsammans med andra utvecklare, UX, Product Managers och andra kompetenser. Uppdragen kan se olika ut, men gemensamt är att du får möjlighet att vara med hela vägen – från behov och idé till färdig lösning i produktion.

Vi tycker att det är bra ifall du känner till några av följande teknologier:

God erfarenhet av modern mjukvaruutveckling, frontend och/eller backend.
TypeScript, JavaScript, Node.js, Java, Kotlin eller liknande.
React, Angular eller motsvarande moderna frontendramverk.
Molnplattformar som AWS, Azure eller Google Cloud Platform.
Docker och/eller Kubernetes.
Terraform eller motsvarande verktyg för infrastructure as code.
RESTful services och API-utveckling.
CI/CD, exempelvis GitHub Actions eller motsvarande.
Testning, observability och arbete med kvalitet och hållbar arkitektur.

Vi söker
dig som är senior och självgående och som kan bidra från första dagen.

Du har en stabil grund inom mjukvaruutveckling och känner dig hemma i moderna utvecklingsmiljöer. Du kan ta ansvar för dina tekniska beslut, samarbeta med andra och omsätta behov till lösningar som skapar värde.

Du är nyfiken på ny teknik och tycker att det är spännande att utvecklas tillsammans med tekniken. Erfarenhet av AI-assisterad och agentisk utveckling, exempelvis med Claude Code eller Codex, är meriterande och kan vara en naturlig del av ditt utvecklingsarbete.

Framför allt söker vi dig som vill vara med och utveckla både våra kunders lösningar och oss som team.

Vi söker efter personer som behärskar svenska i tal och skrift.

Att vara konsult på Sylog

Att vara konsult hos oss innebär att du arbetar under ett varumärke som står för kvalitet, teknisk kompetens och långsiktiga samarbeten. Med vår långa erfarenhet inom inbyggda system och systemutveckling är vi ett namn som våra kunder litar på.

Vi brukar säga att vår anställningsform kombinerar det bästa av två världar och så har det varit sedan starten av Sylog 2002. Självständigheten och friheten som många förknippar med att vara egen, tillsammans med tryggheten och förmånerna som kommer med en anställning.

Vi behandlar ansökningar löpande, så varmt välkommen att skicka in din ansökan redan idag! Just nu söker vi efter personer som behärskar svenska i tal och skrift.

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description:
At Resolve Financial Software, we build software that helps financial-services organisations gather, standardise and distribute data, automate back-office processes, and manage complex calculations. Our IntegraLynx platform is used by leading insurance and funds organisations, so the work you do here has real operational and regulatory importance.

We are looking for a Software Engineer with 2–4 years’ experience who can take ownership of features in an established C#/.NET codebase and who has built something real using an LLM API. This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys solving problems across the stack and wants to work on practical AI products - not AI for its own sake.

What you will do

Design, build, test and maintain production-quality features in C# and ASP.NET MVC.
Work across the stack, including controllers, views, JavaScript and SQL Server.
Integrate and improve AI capabilities using LLM APIs, retrieval, embeddings, tool use and related techniques.
Turn client and business requirements into reliable, maintainable software.
Work with colleagues and subject-matter experts to understand workflows, data and regulatory needs.
Investigate and resolve complex issues in application code and data-heavy back-end processes.
Contribute to technical design, code reviews, testing, documentation and continuous improvement.
Support deployments when required. We aim to minimise disruption for clients, which can occasionally mean working outside normal business hours.

What you will bring

Professional software-development experience, ideally around 2–4 years, or equivalent evidence through substantial projects.
The ability to work independently in an established codebase and deliver complete features with appropriate care and discipline.
Practical experience using an LLM API to build something real. Any provider or model is relevant; we care about what you built and learned.
Working knowledge of an object-oriented language, with C#/.NET experience particularly useful.
Experience with SQL or relational databases; SQL Server and T-SQL are an advantage.
A thoughtful approach to software quality, security, data protection and change in a regulated environment.
Clear communication, curiosity and a willingness to learn from both technical and non-technical colleagues.

Azure experience, Entity Framework, DevOps, or experience in financial services, insurance, funds, data management or other regulated domains would be advantageous—but they are not all required.

What we can offer

Salary: €55,000–€70,000, depending on experience and fit for the role.

Location: Dublin city centre. The role is office-based while you get up to speed, moving to a hybrid split thereafter.

Our benefits package includes:

23 days’ annual leave
Company pension plan
Life assurance
Company bonus scheme
Hybrid working
Support for professional development, training and relevant professional qualifications
Bike to Work Scheme
Employee Assistance Programme (EAP)
Employee wellness programme

All benefits are subject to the applicable company policies.

About Resolve Financial Software

Resolve are a Dublin-based FinTech company helping financial-services organisations automate data-driven workflows and complex calculations through our proprietary IntegraLynx platform and actuarial expertise.
Our team brings together software engineers, actuaries and financial-services specialists. We work closely with clients, learn from the problems they need solved, and are increasingly applying AI in ways that are useful, controlled and grounded in real business processes.

Summary / Objective

The Software Development Engineer in Test I (entry level) will have the opportunity to build hands-on experience working alongside experienced Quality Assurance and Engineering team members to help conceive, design and develop our AWS based registry platform by developing, executing and maintaining software & frameworks to test the registry platform

This role reports to the Director, Quality Assurance.

What You’ll Do

Develop and maintain automated tests in C# for new and existing product features, with guidance from experienced SDETs
Works with senior SDETs to enhance our existing automation framework which is written in C#
Writes data driven back-end tests using relational & non-relational database methods from the automation framework
Works with more senior automation engineers to understand features and design documents
Derives automated & manual tests from specifications and development design documents
Assists with deploying environments using cloud platforms such as AWS via Azure DevOps
Collaborate with Quality Assurance Engineers and software engineers as part of an Agile development team on automation tests in C#
Build knowledge of our registry platform to understand the different modules and how they interact with each other
Learn to configure and maintain automated tests within our TeamCity continuous integration environment
Understands requirement documents for the purpose of writing test cases
Maintains work items (bugs, test plans and estimates) to reflect the work accomplished
Actively models and promotes Identity Digital’s core values through day-to-day interactions, behaviors, and decision-making
Other duties as assigned

Who You Are / What You Bring

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent experience
0–1 years of experience in software development, software testing, test automation, or a related technical area
Recent graduates are encouraged to apply; relevant internships, co-ops, academic projects, personal projects, or similar experience will be considered
Foundational experience with object-oriented programming languages such as C# or Java, gained through coursework, internships, projects, or professional experience
Familiarity with SQL queries and stored procedures white box testing (MS-SQL / MySQL / PostgreSQL)
Familiarity automation testing of xml/Json API backend services
Exposure to AI tools and concepts in software testing, with a keen interest in leveraging AI to enhance QA efficiency, test design, and automated QA code generation
Exposure to cloud technologies is a plus
Strong communication, collaboration, reporting, analytical and problem-solving skills
Curiosity and a willingness to learn new technologies, tools, and systems
Displays a passion for technology and software quality
Ability to work outside core business hours as needed
Ability to travel as needed
Ability to work across time zones as part of a global organization as needed
Reliable transportation to the workplace

Physical Requirements

Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer
Must be able to lift up to 15 pounds at times

Location:

36 Dame Street, Dublin 2, D02 K7K5 (hybrid)

Salary Range

The base salary range for this full-time position is €55,000 - €65,000 (flexibility based on experience) plus additional benefits. In addition, the successful candidate will be eligible to receive other compensation from time to time in the form of discretionary and/or nondiscretionary bonuses and long-term incentive plan. Actual compensation will be influenced by a candidate’s qualifications, internal employee equity considerations, and location. We will not ask for information about a candidate's current or past compensation for purposes of developing an offer of employment.
Note: Benefits programs are subject to eligibility requirements and may vary in certain locations.

The Opportunity

At Easee, we're building technology that makes electrification effortless. Our products are used across Europe, and our success depends on attracting people who share our ambition, curiosity, and commitment to great results.

As our Software Engineer, you'll help build, test, and maintain the RESTful APIs and microservices that power Easee's platform. You'll write clean, well-tested code while working closely with senior engineers on backend architecture. This is a role designed for someone with solid backend foundations who is ready to take ownership of real services in a supportive, collaborative environment.

Working alongside the API team, Frontend Engineers, the Platform team, and Product Support, you will help make sure our services are reliable, well-tested, and built to scale.

What's In It For You

A collaborative environment with experienced senior engineers for code reviews, architectural discussions, and technical sparring
High ownership over feature design and implementation, backed by strong team support when you need it
Opportunities to design end-to-to-end systems independently, particularly in the EV charger domain
A clear path from Software Engineer to Senior Software Engineer as you grow

Core Outcomes

Short-term

You have completed onboarding, set up your local development environment, and have a clear understanding of our core API codebases.
You have shipped early bug fixes and feature enhancements to production, building familiarity with our system architecture and review practices.
You have integrated smoothly into the API team's daily workflows, code review practices, and sprint cadence.

Long-term

You have full autonomy in designing and deploying end-to-end API features.
You have a deep understanding of our core system architecture and data flows.
You actively contribute ideas that improve our test and development workflows.

What You Need To Bring Along

A bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, IT, or equivalent practical experience. Relevant hands-on experience can compensate for formal education.
2–4 years of professional backend development experience in a production environment.
Proven experience building, testing, and maintaining RESTful APIs or microservices.
Core programming skills in at least one backend language (e.g., .Net and C# (what we use), Java, or Go).
A solid understanding of REST principles, HTTP, and relational or NoSQL databases.
Familiarity with Git, Docker, automated testing frameworks, and CI/CD pipelines.

We request two professional references in our final round. We may conduct background checks if necessary.

Who we are

We develop smart charging and energy solutions designed to make access to electrification simpler, smarter, and more scalable.

Dare:
We challenge assumptions and explore new possibilities.

Care:
We support each other, our partners, and our customers.

We take ownership and follow through on our commitments.

We believe great results come from ambitious people who care about each other, challenge the status quo, and take ownership.

The chance to work alongside some of the experts behind one of the world's best-selling EV chargers

Competitive salary and benefits package

jobs.description:
Job Description

Senior Platform Engineer
– Public 360° – Tieto Indtech (m/f/d)

Tieto Public 360° – building secure, scalable digital services for the public sector across the Nordics.

About The Company

Tieto's Public 360° is a leading case management platform used across the Nordic public sector for over 20 years. Since 2014, the SaaS platform has been running on modernized Azure infrastructure with automated deployments while also supporting on-prem/hybrid/Domestic cloud installations.

The 360° Platform Currently Powers Three Solutions

Public 360° – Case and archive management

Plan & Build 360° – Building permit applications

eArchive 360° – Long-term data storage

The challenge

We're building on Public 360°'s modern foundation to expand across multiple cloud environments—strengthening Nordic digital sovereignty and enabling AI capabilities, all while maintaining the highest requirements for security and compliance.

The role

As a Senior Platform Engineer, you'll advance the technical capabilities of the 360° hosting platform. You'll design and operate cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes platforms, automation, and security systems that support continued growth and enable new AI-powered features.

Key Responsibilities

Build and operate the cloud platform foundation supporting Public 360° across Public Cloud and Domestic Cloud environments.
Deploy, manage, and continuously improve Kubernetes-based platforms and containerized workloads.
Drive automation through Infrastructure as Code (Bicep), GitOps, CI/CD, and self-service platform capabilities.
Establish secure and scalable platform services covering networking, identity, secrets management, monitoring, and operational governance.
Improve reliability and operational excellence through observability, automation, incident management, and best practices.
Support the modernization of Public 360° through cloud-native technologies, APIs, messaging, and microservices architectures.

Required Qualifications

Several years of experience in Platform Engineering, Cloud Engineering, DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering, or similar roles.
Strong Azure and cloud-native platform experience.
Strong hands-on Kubernetes experience, including:
Cluster deployment, installation, and lifecycle management.
Operations, upgrades, troubleshooting, and maintenance.
Networking, security, and scalability.
Experience operating Kubernetes in cloud, on-premises, or domestic cloud environments.

Experience with Microsoft Azure services, particularly AKS, cloud networking, security monitoring, logging, and observability platforms.
Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Bicep, Terraform or similar), GitOps, and CI/CD using Azure DevOps and/or GitHub.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with sovereign, domestic cloud, hybrid cloud, or other highly regulated environments.
Familiarity with messaging technologies such as RabbitMQ, Kafka, or Azure Service Bus.
Experience with Keycloak or other identity and access management platforms.
Experience operating distributed systems, microservices architectures, or multi-region Kubernetes environments.
Exposure to AI platform infrastructure, intelligent automation, or GenAI technologies.

Tech we use

We are Azure-first and automation-driven, building and operating our platform using Kubernetes (AKS), Docker, containers, GitOps, and Infrastructure as Code with Bicep. Our engineering teams use Azure DevOps and GitHub Workflows for CI/CD and automation, supported by Azure networking and cloud security services. We focus heavily on observability and reliability, using Grafana, Prometheus, Loki, and Alloy for monitoring and telemetry. Authentication and authorization are managed through Keycloak, while RabbitMQ provides messaging capabilities across our platform. Our API and ingress layer is built on technologies such as APISIX and NGINX, with certificate management handled through OpenBao and cert-manager. Development is primarily done using .NET (C#), TypeScript/JavaScript, PowerShell, and Bash, with Visual Studio and Visual Studio Code as our primary development tools.

Why join us

Build technology that improves citizen services across the Nordic public sector.
Work with modern cloud technologies and large-scale enterprise software.
Join a highly skilled and collaborative engineering environment with significant influence on technical decisions.
Opportunity to shape the future platform capabilities supporting Public 360°.
Professional growth through international collaboration, technical leadership opportunities, and continuous learning.
A culture built on trust, transparency, ownership, and innovation.

Practicalities

Location and work setup:
Flexible/hybrid, ideally near one of our development hubs in Scandinavia (Oslo, Stockholm, Copenhagen, or Espoo).

Language requirements:
Fluent English required. Nordic language skills are considered an advantage.

Are you our new colleague?

We look forward to hearing from you! We will fill the position as soon as we find the right person, so we encourage you to apply today.

If you have any questions regarding this role, please contact the hiring managers Ida Sirevaag
(ida.sirevaag@tieto.com) or Geir Are Bjørnsrud
(geirare.bjornsrud@tieto.com).

Additional Information

At Tieto, we believe in the power of diversity, equity, and inclusion. We encourage applicants of all backgrounds, genders (m/f/d), and walks of life to join our team, as we believe that this fosters an inspiring workplace and fuels innovation. Our commitment to openness, trust, and diversity is at the heart of our mission to create digital futures that benefit businesses, societies, and humanity.

jobs.description:
Job Requisition ID #

26WD101130

Help Shape How Cities Are Designed

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join us in developing the next generation of our AI-powered architecture design platform. Your contributions will have a direct impact on the quality and capability of our product. You'll work on systems that combine cloud architecture, performance-sensitive applications, and AI to support complex design and simulation workflows.

Your work will enable architects, planners, and developers to discover smarter, more sustainable solutions and gain meaningful insights into their projects.

About Us

We’re on a mission to help design better cities.

With 90% of future population growth expected in urban areas, and construction responsible for around 40% of global CO₂ emissions, the AEC industry must evolve. Our cloud-based Autodesk Forma platform helps users evaluate design choices based on environmental impact, living quality (sun, daylight, noise), and project feasibility. We started as Spacemaker in Norway and became part of Autodesk in 2020.

Learn more about Autodesk Forma here.

How We Work

We work in small, autonomous teams with a high degree of trust and ownership. We strongly believe in servant leadership and team accountability. In each team, software engineers work closely together with product managers and designers. To learn more about our way of working, read through our tech and product core beliefs.

Responsibilities

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will deliver high-quality work and contribute to technical decisions within your team, while increasing your impact through ownership of complex features and systems.

In This Role, You Will

Contribute to technical direction within your team and provide input on architectural decisions
Take ownership of complex features and systems, driving their design and delivery end-to-end
Contribute to technical planning within your team and help align work with product goals
Navigate trade-offs between performance, cost, and user experience in complex workflows
Collaborate closely with engineers, product managers, and designers to deliver meaningful user outcomes
Share knowledge and support the growth of your teammates

Desired profile

Works independently on complex problems and navigates ambiguity within your domain
Takes ownership of technical decisions within your team and contributes to broader architectural conversations
Strong expertise in your primary domain with growing breadth across related technologies
Collaborates effectively and helps teammates grow
Proactively identifies and acts on improvements within your scope
Collaborates across functions to align engineering with product and user outcomes
Motivated by our mission and focused on delivering meaningful outcomes at scale

Areas of expertise that might resonate with you

You get your energy from building the foundations other people rely on, pulling systems apart into simple, observable pieces, owning something in production long enough to feel responsible for it, and reaching for the boring, reliable option before building something new.
You're drawn to problems where the math is the hard part, geometry, simulation, optimization, and you like taking a model from "this is the theory" to something that runs reliably on real inputs and matches what users expect to see.
You start from the user and the problem, not the ticket. You are comfortable with a fuzzy brief and a blank repo, shipping fast to learn, and shaping what gets built as much as how it gets built.

What Will Help You Succeed In This Role

Strong hands-on engineering background building cloud-based, user-facing systems
Strong collaboration and communication skills across disciplines and seniority levels
Experience with Agentic AI

You might also bring

Experience with TypeScript, serverless architectures and AWS
Background in large-scale systems or platform development
Experience working in cross-functional, international product teams
Experience with 3D graphics, WebGL/WebGPU, or real-time rendering in the browser

26WD101129

Help Shape How Cities Are Designed

We are looking for a Principal Software Engineer to join us in developing the next generation of our AI-powered architecture design platform.
