jobs.title: Utvikler – SRE Cloude Engineer
jobs.description:
Oppdragsbeskrivelse:

Digitaliseringsavdelingen (DIGA) er UDI sin IT-avdeling. Avdelingen har en teamorganisering, fordelt på tekniske team, digitaliseringsteam og muliggjørende team. DIGA har ansvaret for UDI og utlendingsforvaltningen sine Digitale løsninger. I tillegg til å ansvaret for drift, forvaltning og utvikling av løsningene har UDI ved DIGA fått i oppdrag å gjennomføre et moderniseringsprogram, modernisering av utlendingsforvaltningen (ModUlf), som skal gjennomføre frem til 2031.

Team Datalagring har behov for en SRE Cloude Engineer. Teamet moderniserer sentrale og kritiske databaser og flytter dem fra on-prem til sky. Teamet trenger å styrke midlertidig med en SRE Engineer som skal bidra med å automatisere, overvåke og videreutvikle UDIs databaseplattform i skyen, og som bidrar til å sette premissene for hvordan vi former fremtidens driftsprosesser.

Arbeidsoppgaver:

Automatisert deployment og drift i sky
Automatisere og standardisere Database plattformdrift ved bruk av Infrastructure as Code (IaC), GitOps og CI/CD
Samarbeide tett med skyutviklingsteamene rundt deploy og runtime-miljø
Etablere og videreutvikle observability (monitoring, logging og alerting) i. Utarbeide en Proof-of-concept for UDI sin Cloud Monitoring med SRE KI agent.
Feilsøke hendelser og gjennomføre strukturerte rotårsak analyser
Administrere storage-, backup- og gjenopprettingsløsninger
Kravstille og lede skymigrasjon
Være kravstiller for nye databaser og lede migreringsprosesser til sky der database er en sentral komponent b. Være en pådriver for å identifisere nye muligheter, holde deg oppdatert på teknologi og trender innen skybaserte databaseplattformer
Vurdere skymigrasjon det dette er hensiktsmessig og forsvarlig
Sikkerhet og støtte til team
Sammen med arkitekter bidra til databasestruktur med fokus på personvern og sikkerhet.
Gjennomføre og bidra til ROS-analyser (risiko- og sårbarhetsvurderinger) for databaseplattform
Støtte team og prosjekter der det er naturlig

Kompetansekrav
:

Ressursen må ha minimum 8 års relevant erfaring innenfor arbeidsoppgavene som er angitt
Ressursen må ha minimum formell kompetanse på bachelorgradsnivå eller tilsvarende innenfor IKT relaterte områder. Lang og relevant dokumentert erfaring (mer enn 12 års erfaring) kan oppveie for kravet om formell utdannelse.
Ressursen må ha dokumentert erfaring med drift og administrasjon av skybaserte databaser, for eksempel Azure SQL, PostgreSQL eller Cosmos DB
Ressursen må har erfaring med å utarbeide POC for Cloude Monitoring med SRE KI-agent eller tilsvarende
Ressursen må ha erfaring med Microsoft Azure (App Services, nettverk, sikkerhet og lagring)
Ressursen må ha erfaring med plattformdrift, observability og livssyklushåndtering
Ressursen må ha kjennskap til Infrastructure as Code og DevOps-prinsipper

Ressursen må ha god skriftlig og muntlig fremstillingsevne på norsk

Ressursen må kunne sikkerhetsklareres og autoriseres for nivå BEGRENSET i henhold til sikkerhetsloven

Team Datalagring er på utkikk etter en SRE spesialist som har erfaring med plattformdrift av databasemiljøer i sky, utvikling av overvåkningsløsninger og automatiseringsløsninger ved hjelp av KI i drift og utvikling. Ressursen må ha lang erfaring med skybaserte databaser, gjerne fra miljøer med høye krav til stabilitet, ytelse, sikkerhet og automatisering. Ressursen må ha god forståelse for Infrastructure as Code, automatisering av overvåkning og varsling, trives med å ta i bruk moderne AI-verktøy i driftsarbeidet. Teamet har behov for en senior ressurs med lang og variert bakgrunn innen databaseutvikling. Ressursen må kunne dokumentere erfaring med drift og utvikling av database i sky.

Det er en fordel om ressursen har erfaring med:

Azure og Postgres SQL
API-desgin (OpenAPI/REST)
Infrastructure as Code og automatisering med GitOps, Terraform og CI/CD
Erfaring med å gjennomføre ROS-analyser (Risiko og sårbarhetsvurderinger)
Erfaring med KI/ML-plattformer eller høytytende arbeidsbelastninger er en fordel

Personlige egenskaper:

Initiativrik og løsningsorientert.
Tydelig som kravstiller.
God til å samarbeide med andre.
Omstillingsdyktig og fleksibel
Gode kommunikasjons- og formidlingsegenskaper.
En god prosessdriver.
Kunne være bindeledd mellom teamet og andre applikasjonsteam
Pedagogisk
Ha godt humør.

Omfang og varighet: Fra asap - 30.04.2027, opsjon om forlengelse

Arbeidssted: UDI sine lokaler på Valle, men etter avtale kan noe hjemmekontor benyttes

Intern søknadsfrist: 17.9

jobs.title: Full-stack Developer – Digital Marketing and CRM
jobs.description:
You could call it a Full-stack Developer role - but we’re really looking for someone who enables seamless, personalized customer journeys through smart technology.

The CRM and Marketing Solutions unit at If P&C Insurance is advancing its capabilities in data driven marketing and supporting a digital first strategy. To create customer-centric solutions in this area we utilize many data sources and turn them into event-driven personalized solutions with high business impact.

We want to offer our customers personalized journeys driven by important life events. You will have a key role in making this happen.

About The Role

As a Full-stack Developer, you will be developing APIs, integrations and applications to enable us to communicate with leads and customers in a safe and secure way and ensure that If can reach out in any channel through our new Bloomreach Engagement CDP platform and transform data into personalized customer journeys. You’ll join an easy-going Nordic team of developers who make this happen and have fun while doing it.

You’ll develop B2C and B2B integrations solutions in .Net and C# in Azure Cloud and connect them to our omni-channel CRM touchpoints (email, SMS, web, CX, app, chat and marketing channels) and first party data sources so we can communicate with leads, partners and customers. This includes development and integration to CRM data sources both in Azure, on-premise and to partners via APIs, reliable and asynchronous messaging, and various other channels of data communication. You will practice Agile and DevOps in your day-to-day life.

We offer

An including work environment where everyone is welcome
Career and development opportunities in the biggest insurance company in the Nordics
Social activities, as well as highly skilled professional environment
Possibility of hybrid workplace
Health promoting workplace with e.g., wellness allowance and various sports activities
Great insurance benefits

About The Team

We’re a Nordic team of highly motivated developers who are passionate about serving customers with timely, personalized communications to help them live a worry-free life and insure what is most dear to them. We work closely with business stakeholders to make this happen and value common Agile DevOps principles with CI/CD so we can continuously deploy value to clients.

We promote continuous tech nurturing, certifications and learning including hackathons both within our team and together with our partners at Microsoft, Bloomreach and Google. We love experimentation and constantly follow new technology to create better solutions.

Who are you?

You’re passionate about solution development in Azure
and have a solid understanding of Object-Oriented Programming
using .NET
and C#
.

You Bring

Strong experience with .NET, C#, and Object-Oriented Programming
Experience developing solutions in Azure Cloud
Proficiency in REST APIs, microservices, and message-based architectures
Solid knowledge of Azure data storage (SQL Server, CosmosDB, Azure Storage)
Awareness of Information security and protecting our customers’ integrity (GDPR)
Bonus: Experience with React for UI development

You Also Have

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or equivalent experience
Excellent communication skills in English
Proven experience in application and software development

Additional Facts And Recruitment Process

Application Deadline
: Screening and interviewing will be conducted on a rolling basis, however, application deadline is October 16, 2026

Work location:
Espoo or Turku (Finland), Stockholm (Sweden)

Please attach your CV

Travelling:
Occasional travel within the Nordics

Start:
As soon as possible or by agreement

Norrin has strong roots in Finland while operating internationally across the Nordics, the United States, and APAC.

We are now looking for a Integration Engineer
to strengthen our team in Helsinki. In this role, you will design, build, and maintain integration solutions that connect cloud services, enterprise systems, and business-critical applications. You will work closely with customers and internal delivery teams to ensure integrations are reliable, secure, and scalable.

The role combines hands-on technical work with responsibility for contributing to and shaping integration architectures that support long-term business needs. You will take an active role across the full lifecycle of integration projects, from solution design and implementation to deployment and continuous improvement.

In this role, you will

Design and implement API based and event driven integration solutions
Design integration solutions following Azure best practices and cloud native patterns
Build integrations using Azure Integration Services such as Logic Apps, Functions, API Management, Service Bus, and Event Hubs
Develop and maintain integrations using C# and the .NET ecosystem
Apply Infrastructure as Code practices using tools such as Terraform
Ensure secure authentication, authorization, and API security using OAuth and best practices
Collaborate with architects, developers, and customers to design end to end integration solutions
Support deployments, monitoring, and continuous improvement of integration platforms, ensuring reliability and observability in production environments

What We’re Looking For

3+ years of experience in API and integration development
Strong expertise in Azure Integration Services (Logic Apps, Functions, API Management, Service Bus, Event Hubs)
Hands on experience with Infrastructure as Code (tools such as Terraform)
Good understanding of OAuth authentication and API security best practices
Ability to take ownership of integration solutions and make technical decisions in customer projects
Experience with C# programming and the .NET ecosystem, particularly when building Azure Functions or custom integration components
Fluency in both Finnish and English
Strong problem solving skills and the ability to work both independently and as part of a team

Nice to have

Microsoft certifications such as Azure Solutions Architect Expert or Azure Developer Associate
Experience with DevOps practices and CI/CD pipelines
Expertise in BizTalk
Previous experience delivering or managing integrations in large organizations
Broader data engineering development experience to contribute to both integration and data projects

Why Norrin?

At Norrin, you'll join an international team
of 220 professionals working across Finland, Sweden, Thailand, Vietnam, and the United States. We work with Nordic enterprises that have the ambition to be the forerunners in data and AI across a wide range of industries, from industrial and finance to retail and energy. The diversity of projects, technologies, and business challenges
keeps the work both meaningful and engaging. We never work alone but always together with clients and our colleagues.

We invest in continuous learning
through training and certification opportunities, as well as our guild communities
where knowledge is shared and built together. As a Microsoft and Databricks partner, we work with leading technologies and support you in continuously expanding your expertise. At Norrin, you'll have the opportunity to grow in a direction that matters to you.

We believe that great work starts with a supportive environment. That's why we foster a culture built on openness, equality, and mutual respect
, with psychological safety at its core .
As a member of the Women in Tech network, we're committed to promoting diversity, inclusion, and equal opportunities in the tech industry.

Our hybrid working model
combines flexibility with collaboration, giving you the freedom to work remotely while bringing people together when it creates the most value. To support your well-being, we offer comprehensive benefits
, including extensive occupational healthcare and dental care, insurance coverage, regular massages, and culture and sports benefits. Our compensation model includes a competitive base salary, a performance-based bonus
, and the opportunity to participate in an employee fund.

jobs.title: Intelligent Automation Developer
jobs.description:
Are you looking for a career in an inspiring, global environment where your expertise makes a difference? At Neste, you will be working for the world’s leading producer of renewable diesel and sustainable aviation fuel, which enable our customers to reduce their greenhouse gas emissions.

We are looking for you,

Intelligent Automation Developer

to our Intelligent Automation & Key Expert Network team in the Marketing & Services business unit. This position is based at our headquarters in Espoo, Finland.

You will focus on implementing Marketing & Services’ Strategy Passion for Excellence and Best Customer Experience by automating processes with RPA (robotic process automation) and other Intelligent Automation solutions. We build our solutions on our Intelligent Automation platform, utilizing UiPath as our main tool. We currently have over 100 automations in production handling over 20,000 transactions per month.

As an Intelligent Automation Developer, you will combine hands-on development work with active business engagement. In this role, building new automations requires a strongly solution-oriented mindset, an outgoing personality, and a proactive approach to working closely with various business units. By actively listening to business needs and connecting with stakeholders, you ensure we build the best possible solutions to drive and support the business.

You will also get involved in our transformation journey as we design and implement Microsoft Dynamics 365 to replace the current fragmented system landscape. You will become part of our growing intelligent automation team, currently consisting of 3 experts, working closely with Marketing & Services teams in Finland, Estonia, Latvia, and Lithuania, as well as other Intelligent Automation developers across Neste.

Reasons to join

We operate in an inspiring and evolving business environment as a global leader in renewable fuels. We contribute to Neste’s success by living our values every day: we care, we have courage, we cooperate.

We prioritize safety at all times and in every location. We strive to create a positive and impactful work environment.

Transformation brings new possibilities and fosters our courage and curiosity. As a global company, we support personal development with versatile learning and career opportunities. Collaboration is key, and we believe in flexible, smart ways of working. We offer a hybrid working model, working at our Espoo office at least three days a week to ensure seamless teamwork, active daily collaboration, and a strong sense of belonging.

In addition, our benefits for employees in Finland include, for example, a personnel fund as part of the overall remuneration, high-quality occupational health care, membership in a health insurance fund, and leisure time accident insurance. We also support leisure activities by offering benefits for sports and culture (ePassi).

More about the job

Your role in our team

Active Business Collaboration: Actively engage and communicate with business units to discover automation opportunities, understand business needs, and build optimal solutions that maximize operational value.

Hands-on Development: Develop, implement, and maintain Intelligent Automation solutions in cooperation with key stakeholders to improve processes and increase efficiency with measurable results.

Solution-Oriented Problem Solving: Take a proactive, outgoing approach to designing innovative and practical automation solutions.

Standardization & Best Practices: Work with other Neste Intelligent Automation teams, Business Analysts, and developers to define and continuously improve automation standards and ways of working.

Documentation & Quality: Create and maintain process documentations, Solution Design Documents (SDD), and technical documentations according to defined Neste standards.

Testing & Monitoring: Participate in User Acceptance Testing (UAT) with internal customers and monitor automations after deployment.

Continuous Learning: Follow up on developments in automation technologies and share knowledge with the team.

Agile Ways of Working: Attend relevant Scrum meetings and commit to Sprint deliverables.

The best combination to succeed in this role

Solution-Oriented & Outgoing Personality:
Excellent communication skills with a customer-centric and proactive approach to building relationships with business partners.

Hands-on Automation Experience:
Solid RPA development experience with UiPath, Blue Prism, or similar platforms.

Programming Skills:
Experience coding in Python, VB.NET, C#, Java, or SQL in a professional environment.

AI & Machine Learning:
Hands-on experience or strong familiarity with Machine Learning development and/or Artificial Intelligence solutions.

Process & Tech Mindset:
Process-oriented mindset with an interest in intelligent process automation, databases, and software development methodologies (e.g., Scrum, DevOps, DevSecOps).

Proactivity:
Independent drive to solve complex problems, embrace change, and achieve tangible results.

Intercultural Collaboration:
Ability to collaborate seamlessly in a cross-functional and multicultural environment with both internal and external parties.

Education & Languages:
B.Sc. level degree (including studies in Computer Science, Information Technology, or Process Development) and fluency in English
(written and spoken).

Compliance Awareness:
Basic knowledge of GDPR and Know Your Customer (KYC) guidelines.

Other strengths we value are
experience with Microsoft Power Platform and Power Automate.

Let’s get you started

We look forward to receiving your CV and application with a salary request by September 15, 2026.

If you have any questions regarding the process or the position, please get in touch with Milla Nieminen, Manager, Intelligent Automation and Solutions, +358 400 655 315, on weekdays between 8:00-16:00 (EEST / Finnish time) until September 3rd, 2026.

To ensure security and confidentiality, please submit your application through our recruitment system, as we are unable to consider applications sent via email. We will do our best to contact you within 2 w eeks after the application time has ended. The recruitment process will include interviews and a potential aptitude assessment. The first interviews are preliminarily scheduled to take place in week 40-41 . Depending on the requirements of the position, the process may include a security clearance (with a drug test) and a potential statutory health examination based on work-related exposures.

Neste in brief

Neste (NESTE, Nasdaq Helsinki) is the world's leading producer of renewable diesel and sustainable aviation fuel (SAF), with production on three continents. The company’s renewables production capacity is expected to reach 6.8 million tons annually in 2027. Neste also produces high-quality oil products at its Porvoo refinery in Finland. The company has a network of nearly 1,000 fuel stations with expanding service offering, such as EV charging, in Finland and in the Baltics.

Neste’s strategy focuses on growth in renewable fuels, which help its customers to reduce their greenhouse gas emissions. Neste is included in many international indices for its sustainability performance. In 2025, Neste's revenue stood at EUR 19.0 billion. Read more: neste.com

jobs.title: Senior Platform Engineer– Public 360° – Tieto Indtech (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Job Description

Senior Platform Engineer
– Public 360° – Tieto Indtech (m/f/d)

Tieto Public 360° – building secure, scalable digital services for the public sector across the Nordics.

About The Company

Tieto's Public 360° is a leading case management platform used across the Nordic public sector for over 20 years. Since 2014, the SaaS platform has been running on modernized Azure infrastructure with automated deployments while also supporting on-prem/hybrid/Domestic cloud installations.

The 360° Platform Currently Powers Three Solutions

Public 360° – Case and archive management

Plan & Build 360° – Building permit applications

eArchive 360° – Long-term data storage

The challenge

We're building on Public 360°'s modern foundation to expand across multiple cloud environments—strengthening Nordic digital sovereignty and enabling AI capabilities, all while maintaining the highest requirements for security and compliance.

The role

As a Senior Platform Engineer, you'll advance the technical capabilities of the 360° hosting platform. You'll design and operate cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes platforms, automation, and security systems that support continued growth and enable new AI-powered features.

Key Responsibilities

Build and operate the cloud platform foundation supporting Public 360° across Public Cloud and Domestic Cloud environments.
Deploy, manage, and continuously improve Kubernetes-based platforms and containerized workloads.
Drive automation through Infrastructure as Code (Bicep), GitOps, CI/CD, and self-service platform capabilities.
Establish secure and scalable platform services covering networking, identity, secrets management, monitoring, and operational governance.
Improve reliability and operational excellence through observability, automation, incident management, and best practices.
Support the modernization of Public 360° through cloud-native technologies, APIs, messaging, and microservices architectures.

Required Qualifications

Several years of experience in Platform Engineering, Cloud Engineering, DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering, or similar roles.
Strong Azure and cloud-native platform experience.
Strong hands-on Kubernetes experience, including:
Cluster deployment, installation, and lifecycle management.
Operations, upgrades, troubleshooting, and maintenance.
Networking, security, and scalability.
Experience operating Kubernetes in cloud, on-premises, or domestic cloud environments.

Experience with Microsoft Azure services, particularly AKS, cloud networking, security monitoring, logging, and observability platforms.
Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Bicep, Terraform or similar), GitOps, and CI/CD using Azure DevOps and/or GitHub.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with sovereign, domestic cloud, hybrid cloud, or other highly regulated environments.
Familiarity with messaging technologies such as RabbitMQ, Kafka, or Azure Service Bus.
Experience with Keycloak or other identity and access management platforms.
Experience operating distributed systems, microservices architectures, or multi-region Kubernetes environments.
Exposure to AI platform infrastructure, intelligent automation, or GenAI technologies.

Tech we use

We are Azure-first and automation-driven, building and operating our platform using Kubernetes (AKS), Docker, containers, GitOps, and Infrastructure as Code with Bicep. Our engineering teams use Azure DevOps and GitHub Workflows for CI/CD and automation, supported by Azure networking and cloud security services. We focus heavily on observability and reliability, using Grafana, Prometheus, Loki, and Alloy for monitoring and telemetry. Authentication and authorization are managed through Keycloak, while RabbitMQ provides messaging capabilities across our platform. Our API and ingress layer is built on technologies such as APISIX and NGINX, with certificate management handled through OpenBao and cert-manager. Development is primarily done using .NET (C#), TypeScript/JavaScript, PowerShell, and Bash, with Visual Studio and Visual Studio Code as our primary development tools.

Why join us

Build technology that improves citizen services across the Nordic public sector.
Work with modern cloud technologies and large-scale enterprise software.
Join a highly skilled and collaborative engineering environment with significant influence on technical decisions.
Opportunity to shape the future platform capabilities supporting Public 360°.
Professional growth through international collaboration, technical leadership opportunities, and continuous learning.
A culture built on trust, transparency, ownership, and innovation.

Practicalities

Location and work setup:
Flexible/hybrid, ideally near one of our development hubs in Scandinavia (Oslo, Stockholm, Copenhagen, or Espoo).

Language requirements:
Fluent English required. Nordic language skills are considered an advantage.

Are you our new colleague?

We look forward to hearing from you! We will fill the position as soon as we find the right person, so we encourage you to apply today.

If you have any questions regarding this role, please contact the hiring managers Ida Sirevaag
(ida.sirevaag@tieto.com) or Geir Are Bjørnsrud
(geirare.bjornsrud@tieto.com).

Additional Information

At Tieto, we believe in the power of diversity, equity, and inclusion. We encourage applicants of all backgrounds, genders (m/f/d), and walks of life to join our team, as we believe that this fosters an inspiring workplace and fuels innovation. Our commitment to openness, trust, and diversity is at the heart of our mission to create digital futures that benefit businesses, societies, and humanity.

jobs.title: Fullstack-kehittäjä (pääpaino backend)
jobs.description:
Haluatko tehdä koodia, jolla ratkaistaan oikeita asiakkaiden ongelmia, ja nähdä konkreettisesti oman työsi vaikutuksen?

Etsimme Koho Sales Oy:lle fullstack-kehittäjää osaksi ohjelmistokehitystiimiämme Helsingin Kalasatamaan. Roolin pääpaino on backend-kehityksessä, mutta meillä kehittäjät työskentelevät tarvittaessa myös frontendin parissa.

Koho on suomalainen SaaS-toiminnanohjausjärjestelmä, joka auttaa asiantuntijayrityksiä hallitsemaan muun muassa asiakkuuksia, projekteja, työaikaa, laskutusta, resursointia ja raportointia.

Millaista työ meillä on?

Meillä ohjelmistokehitys on hyvin käytännönläheistä ja lähellä asiakasta. Emme rakenna tuotetta tyhjältä pöydältä tai jahtaa uusimpia teknologiatrendejä, vaan kehitämme yli kymmenen vuotta rakennettua, laajasti käytössä olevaa järjestelmää, jonka pitää toimia luotettavasti asiakkaidemme arjessa. 

Tehtävässä ratkot asiakkaiden käytössä vastaan tulevia ongelmia, toteutat heidän tarpeistaan syntyviä muutoksia ja räätälöintejä sekä kehität samalla Kohoa jatkuvasti paremmaksi. Työssä pääset näkemään konkreettisesti, miten tekemäsi ratkaisut vaikuttavat asiakkaidemme päivittäiseen työhön.

Mitä pääset tekemään?

Fullstack-kehittäjänä työskentelet ennen kaikkea Kohon taustajärjestelmän kehittämisen ja ylläpidon parissa, mutta tehtävään kuuluu myös frontend-kehitystä. Kehitystyömme nojaa vahvasti Ruby on Rails -ohjelmistokehykseen ja MySQL-tietokantoihin. 

Työpöydälläsi voi olla esimerkiksi asiakkaalta noussut ongelma, olemassa olevan toiminnallisuuden parantaminen, integraatio tai uusi ominaisuus.

Työhösi kuuluu esimerkiksi:

Kohon backendin kehittäminen ja ylläpito
asiakkaiden tarpeista ja tiketeistä syntyvien muutosten ja räätälöintien toteuttaminen
bugien ja teknisten ongelmien selvittäminen ja korjaaminen
uusien ominaisuuksien kehittäminen osaksi olemassa olevaa järjestelmää
integraatioiden, rajapintojen ja tietokantojen parissa työskentely
tarvittaessa frontend-muutosten toteuttamista
tuotantoympäristön ongelmatilanteiden selvittäminen
yhteistyö muiden kehittäjien ja koholaisten kanssa.

Mitä odotamme sinulta?

Etsimme ensisijaisesti kehittäjää, jolla on jo jonkin verran kokemusta ohjelmistokehityksestä ja valmiudet tarttua itsenäisesti käytännön kehitystehtäviin. AI-työkalut voivat olla osa työkalupakkiasi, mutta meille on tärkeää, että ymmärrät itse tuottamasi koodin, osaat arvioida ratkaisujen toimivuutta ja laatua sekä pystyt perustelemaan tekemäsi tekniset valinnat. Sinun ei kuitenkaan tarvitse välttämättä olla senioritason konkari. Tärkeintä on riittävä tekninen osaaminen, oppimiskyky ja motivaatio kehittyä.

Toivomme sinulta:
kokemusta backend-ohjelmistokehityksestä
osaamista Ruby on Railsista tai valmiutta ottaa se nopeasti haltuun
perustason osaamista frontend-teknologioista (HTML, CSS, JavaScript)
ymmärrystä tietokannoista ja rajapinnoista
hyvää ongelmanratkaisukykyä ja uteliasta otetta ongelmien selvittämiseen
huolellisuutta sekä kiinnostusta laadukkaaseen ja ylläpidettävään koodiin
kykyä työskennellä sekä itsenäisesti että yhdessä muiden kanssa
sujuvaa suomen ja englannin kielen taitoa.

Kuka viihtyy meillä?

Viihdyt tässä roolissa todennäköisesti hyvin, jos pidät käytännönläheisestä ohjelmistokehityksestä ja ongelmanratkaisusta. Sinua motivoi se, että pääset selvittämään erilaisia tilanteita, kehittämään olemassa olevaa järjestelmää ja tekemään siitä jatkuvasti toimivamman ja paremman.

Työskentelet mielelläsi pitkäikäisen SaaS-tuotteen parissa ja pidät vaihtelevasta tekemisestä: vastaan tulee niin pieniä korjauksia ja asiakastarpeita kuin laajempia kehityskokonaisuuksiakin. Arvostat työn konkreettisuutta ja sitä, että tekemäsi ratkaisut päätyvät oikeasti asiakkaiden käyttöön.

Asiakaslähtöisyys on meille tärkeää myös ohjelmistokehityksessä. Olet kiinnostunut siitä, kuka tekemääsi ratkaisua käyttää, mitä sillä halutaan saavuttaa ja miten se helpottaa asiakkaan arkea. Arvostat sitä, että teknisellä työlläsi on selkeä yhteys asiakkaan tarpeisiin ja käytännön tekemiseen.

Mitä tarjoamme?

Saat ympärillesi kokeneen ohjelmistokehitystiimin ja mahdollisuuden ottaa vastuuta oman osaamisesi mukaan. Työsi vaikutukset näkyvät konkreettisesti asiakkaidemme arjessa, ja joskus ratkaisemasi ongelma helpottaa asiakkaan työtä jo saman päivän aikana.

Meillä on matala organisaatio, rento työilmapiiri ja mahdollisuus vaikuttaa siihen, miten asioita tehdään. Työskentelemme hybridimallilla, ja toimistomme sijaitsee Helsingin Kalasatamassa.

Tarjoamme lisäksi muun muassa lounas- ja matkapuhelinedun, kattavan työterveyshuollon sekä hammasedun.

Kiinnostuitko?

Lähetä hakemuksesi palkkatoiveineen viimeistään  25.10.2026
 mennessä. Älä kuitenkaan jää odottelemaan viimeiseen hakupäivään, sillä täytämme paikan heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä.

Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa rekrytoiva esihenkilö Jaakko Kuisma (0503501107) perjantaisin klo 12:00-13:00.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer (C#/.NET, Azure)
jobs.description:
WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT TO US

SimCorp is developing a new game changing Software-as-a-Service solution for Performance Measurement and Attribution, which will allow Investment Managers to interact with, and analyze their investments in a modern web application. It is connected to a high-performance computing calculation engine in the back-end, thus combining more than 50 years of industry-leading experience of SimCorp with a modern user experience and cloud computing, enabling users to do in minutes what used to take hours.

We welcome applications from both early‑career and mid‑career software engineers.

WHAT YOU WILL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR

Build solutions: collaborate closely with your team, Product Managers, Architects, peers and end-users to deliver high-quality, secure and valuable solutions in the Performance Product Area.
Contribute across the entire development lifecycle - from requirements analysis and design to implementation, test automation, documentation, and ongoing support.
Coordinate and execute on development and maintenance of the investment performance solution in collaboration with product owners and other teams.
Think beyond the code: Understand our strategy, goals and customer needs to enhance SimCorp’s impact.
You will work closely with experienced engineers who support your development. Over time, you will grow into taking ownership of larger components and may mentor more junior colleagues as your experience grows.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

Solid knowledge of C#, .NET Core/Framework, and object-oriented design principles.
Experience with APIs.
Familiarity with modern engineering practices, including CI/CD pipelines and trunk-based development. We use Git (Azure DevOps).
Interest in cloud engineering. We use Microsoft Azure.
You understand the importance of automated testing of business‑critical functionality and quality assurance practices.
Willingness to dive into a complex domain, working with finance, investment performance & attribution and investment-related instruments.
You are able to solve complex problems in a structured manner.
You are enthusiastic about building state-of-the-art software, and have the mindset needed to make others understand your ideas.
Curiosity and adaptability to learn in-house tools and frameworks - including the APL programming language (no prior experience in APL required, we provide extensive training).
You are good at coordinating with both programmers and non-programmers, to ensure a full understanding of tasks.
You have a Master’s degree or higher within Computer Sciences, Engineering, Finance, Physics, Mathematics, Economics or similar experience.
If you have knowledge of a financial domain it is plus, otherwise we will bring you up to speed using technical discussions, training and a comprehensive onboarding program.

WHAT IS IT LIKE TO WORK HERE

SimCorp plans work in an agile manner, using 4 planning intervals (PI’s) per year, each consisting of 5 sprints of 2 weeks each, followed by a 3-week Innovation and Planning sprint, which can be used for mastering skills in various areas, or more freely investigating ideas with prototypes. It is important that our people learn and grow constantly, and SimCorp invests a lot to foster the continuous learning environment to support people on their journeys.

Global hybrid work policy
- We ask you to work 2 days a week from the office. If you choose you can work remotely the other days. Of course you are welcome at the office if that is your preference.
Growth and innovation
- Every 6th sprint is reserved for planning and innovation. So, with regular intervals you have a chance to explore and learn new skills or improve something that you believe will be beneficial to you, your team or the application.
Self- Direction
- High degree of self-organization. Each team and developer have a high degree of freedom to plan, organize and design their work.
Inclusive and diverse company culture

jobs.description:
Airborne self-protection systems rely on software prepared, configured, and analyzed before and after flight. The quality of this software directly influences how advanced defense systems perform in practice. In this role, you will help design, build, and improve the mission software behind it. Come and join us!

We are expanding and strengthening our capabilities in defense and aerospace, developing advanced mission-critical systems used on land, at sea, and in the air. As complexity increases, so does the need for robust, well-engineered software. This is part of Terma’s overall purpose – securing people through advanced technology.

Your role in our team

As our new software Engineer, you will develop and maintain mission software with long service-lives, supporting configuration, analysis, and verification of airborne self-protection systems. Your work spans the full software lifecycle – from design and implementation to testing, deployment, and long-term evolution.

In this role, you will collaborate closely with Systems Engineers, architects, testers, and domain specialists who represent product and user needs. Working in an agile and iterative way, you help qualify and challenge how solutions are implemented, bringing technical judgement and practical experience where it adds value, with a strong focus on correctness, traceability, and operational reliability.

You will become part of the Self Protection Mission software team within Terma’s Defense Air organization, working on mission-level systems used throughout the lifecycle of airborne operations. The team combines experienced engineers and early-career colleagues, with strong domain knowledge and a culture of mutual support, shared responsibility, and pride in the work. We approach our systems with professionalism and responsibility, while recognizing that thoughtful judgement, transparent dialogue, and a healthy sense of humor are essential to building resilient teams and robust software.

How you will make a meaningful contribution

You will work on software with clear requirements for correctness, stability, and traceability. Typical challenges include:

Designing, implementing, and maintaining C#-based mission software
Supporting configuration and analysis workflows used before and after flight
Working with domain-specific rules and system behavior rather than ad-hoc logic
Ensuring quality through structured testing, documentation, and compliance
Develop reliable software used in operational and mission-critical contexts
Take ownership appropriate to your experience, from understanding domain needs to seeing solutions deployed
Contribute to technical quality, continuous improvement, and knowledge sharing

Our tool chain is pragmatic and proven rather than bleeding-edge. Modernization is an active focus area, supported by a deliberate effort to strengthen technical leadership across the organization.

Bring your world class expertise into play

Qualifications

You are fluent in English both in writing and verbal at a professional level. Danish is an advantage but not a requirement. Moreover, we are also looking for a new colleague with the following qualifications:

You hold a bachelor´s or Master´s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or another relevant technical field.
Experience with C# and the .NET application platform, and an interest in building robust, maintainable solutions
Willingness to broaden your skill set across areas such as DevOps, APIs, UX, testing, performance, and design practices
Experience working on complex systems, or an interest in growing into that space

As a person, you collaborate effectively with others and contribute positively to teams that share knowledge and take collective responsibility for complex systems. You are curious and confident in asking relevant questions, and you value open, honest dialogue. You take pride in delivering reliable solutions that work in practice and approach your work with sound judgement and professionalism. At the same time, you maintain a willingness to learn and bring a constructive attitude that supports strong collaboration and high-quality results.

Terma is an international high-tech company developing advanced systems for defense and security. We work with complex technologies in long-lived products and value technical depth, collaboration, and long- term responsibility. We offer strong professional communities and room to grow, both technically and personally.

When joining Terma, we promise that you will experience: Great people, challenging tasks, world-class expertise, and meaningful contribution in your daily work.

Benefits at Terma

At Terma, we prioritize the well-being of our employees, ensuring they are well taken care of. Joining our team comes with a multitude of perks designed to enhance your social life, cultural experiences, and health.

International Environment:
Explore great teamwork and professional sparring with colleagues around the world.

Flexible Working Hours:
Enjoy the opportunity to work flexibly and the option to work from home up to two days per week. Internet connection at home is paid for by Terma.

Comprehensive Benefits Package:
Receive a 10% paid pension along with a beneficial health care and insurance package. Enjoy discounts from various business partners.

Well-being Perks:
Opportunity to enroll in our on-site massage-offer at our locations in Denmark.

Social and Professional Events:
We have an active staff association that arranges a variety of social activities and events to bring all of our colleagues together.

Competence networking across professional experts in Terma:
Professional presentations and knowledge sharing across the organization.

We are dedicated to fostering a diverse, equitable, inclusive, and welcoming workplace. Our commitment to DEIB (Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Belonging) means we actively value and celebrate unique backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences. We strive to create an environment where all employees have equal opportunities to succeed, feel respected and valued, and experience a true sense of belonging.

To support an unbiased evaluation process, we kindly encourage applicants to omit personal details such as photos and age from their applications.

If you would like to take on the challenge of working in an innovative company, we look forward to receiving your application. A resume is required, while a cover letter is optional. To ensure that your application will reach us and is properly processed, we only accept applications via . Applications will be processed continuously.

Do you have any questions regarding the position?

Feel free to contact Hiring Manager on e-mail: REHJ@terma.com

Bear in mind, that we need you to confirm that you can obtain a security clearance by the Danish Defense Intelligence Service, and that all adults in your household are not posing any risk to the related risk-evaluation. This entails among other issues:

That you have as a minimum stayed within NATO/EU/MISWG countries for the last 7 years only interrupted by short stays abroad, and

That you have not committed serious criminal offences

Terma group has headquarters in Denmark and is a high-tech company developing products and systems for defense and non-defense security applications, including command and control systems, radar systems, self-protection systems for aircraft, space technology, and aerostructures for the aircraft industry .

Carry the technical responsibility of complex feature implementations
Critically assess our way of working and contribute to improving and maturing it

Banking Circle is an international company. Our internal workforce consists of over 50 nationalities, and our clients and partners are located all over the globe. Therefore, our company language is English.

jobs.description:
Experienced Cloud Developer

Brænder du for cloud-arkitektur, integrationer og moderne udviklingsprincipper – og motiveres du af at bygge robuste, skalerbare løsninger tæt på forretningen?

Så har vi en spændende mulighed i Kvik A/S, hvor du bliver en central, spiller i vores Cloud Integration & Development (CID) team.

Måske arbejder du i dag som udvikler og er klar til at tage næste skridt i din karriere?

Som Cloud Developer i Kvik A/S, tilbyder vi netop denne mulighed.

Om teamet (CID)

CID-teamet driver en moderne Microsoft cloud platform i Kvik og er med til at sikre stabile og løbende forbedrede digitale services til vores butikker og interne teams.

Vi arbejder i krydsfeltet mellem forretning og teknologi og bygger integrationer og API-services, der binder vores forretningssystemer sammen.

Vi arbejder tæt sammen med bl.a. BizApps (Power Platform/Dynamics 365), ERP (D365 Business Central), Data (MS DWH/Fabric) og Digital Marketing – og vi lægger vægt på kvalitet, samarbejde og en kultur med højt til loftet.

Det er derfor vigtigt at du ikke kun bringer stærke tekniske kompetencer ind i rollen, men også meget gerne en solid forretningsforståelse, og helt sikkert en vilje til at lære.

Om stillingen

Som Cloud Developer får du et bredt ansvar, hvor du både sætter teknisk retning, skaber overblik og omsætter arkitektur til virkelighed. Du bliver en nøgleperson i arbejdet med at udvikle og vedligeholde vores cloud‑principper, patterns- og standarder – og du hjælper teams og stakeholders med at træffe de rigtige tekniske valg.

Samtidig er du hands-on udvikler og deltager aktivt i design og implementering af C#/.NET baserede løsninger i Azure, herunder API’er, integrations-flows og eventdrevne komponenter baseret på messaging og asynkrone mønstre.

Du arbejder især med de forretningskritiske og komplekse dele af platformen, hvor robusthed, skalerbarhed og driftssikkerhed er afgørende.

Dine primære ansvarsområder

Cloud‑strategi og arkitektur: Udvikle og vedligeholde skalerbare cloud‑arkitekturprincipper og standarder (primært Microsoft-teknologi).
Thought leadership: Være et fagligt fyrtårn og bidrage til retning, kompetencesikring og best practices i CID’s virke.
Governance & compliance: Sikre overholdelse af sikkerhed, lovgivning og interne retningslinjer i cloud‑miljøer.
Innovation og optimering: Identificere nye teknologier og metoder, der skaber forretningsværdi og reducerer omkostninger.
Samarbejde og rådgivning: Arbejde tæt sammen med udviklingsteams, arkitekter og stakeholders for at sikre helhedsorienterede løsninger – og proaktivt drive integrations‑ (og evt. AI-) initiativer.
Automatisering og drift: Drive automatisering, DevOps-principper og Infrastructure as Code.
CI/CD og platform: Vedligeholde og videreudvikle CI/CD-processer og tekniske processer på tværs af vores services.
AI, udvikling og anvendelse Det forventes at du har erfaring med AI i tooling, anvendelse og kvalitetssikring. Det vil være en fordel med erfaring fra AI udviklingsprojekter, men ikke et krav.

Teknologier og værktøjer

Vores stack er Microsoft- centreret og inkluderer typisk:

Azure (Cloud development, Functions, integrationer, Service Bus, API Management, Redis Cache)
Cloud Architecture / platform design
Azure DevOps / CI/CD
.NET / C# og API design
Power Platform / Dynamics 365 (tæt samarbejde og integrationsflader)
Github Enterprise

Din profil

Vi forestiller os, at du:

Har solid erfaring med Azure og cloud arkitektur i praksis (gerne integrations-/platformfokus)
Har solid erfaring med C# / .NET
Har erfaring med API’er, integrationer og event‑baserede patterns
Har stærk forståelse for DevOps, CI/CD, automatisering og IaC
Kan kombinere arkitektur og rådgivning med evnen til at få ting til at ske i praksis
Trives i et tværgående setup med mange stakeholders og kan kommunikere klart – også på engelsk
Taler flydende dansk og kommunikerer ubesværet på engelsk i skrift og tale
Tager end-to‑-end ansvar for løsninger ud fra et “you build it, you own it”‑ princip, fra ‑C#kode‑ og arkitekturvalg til drift, overvågning og løbende forbedringer

Du tilbydes

Mulighed for at arbejde i hjertet af et forretningskritisk applikations- og integrationslandskab
Indflydelse og ansvar i et selvstyrende team med fokus på samarbejde og trivsel
En international virksomhed i vækst med spændende digitaliseringsinitiativer
Tæt sparring med erfarne kolleger og mulighed for at præge Kvik’s cloud og integrationsrejse

Praktisk

Arbejdssted: Risskov ved Aarhus (Mosevej 3 B, 8240 Risskov).

Join AutoProff – Help Shape the Future of Automotive Tech!
🚀

We’re looking for a DevEx Engineer
to join our Empower platform squad “Taycan”
. The squad is split between our HQ in Vejle and our Copenhagen office, so the role can be based in either location.

The Taycan squad helps engineers spend more time delivering product value and less time solving the same technical problems. We build shared capabilities that make the preferred engineering path easier to use.

As our new DevEx Engineer
, you’ll work on the shared tooling, libraries and development patterns used by engineering squads across AutoProff. From scaffolding and shared libraries to patterns such as Outbox, Sagas and messaging, you’ll help make software development simpler and more consistent – so our product squads can spend less time solving the same technical problems and more time building great products.

You’ll work closely with platform engineers, service owners and engineers across our product squads, building solutions that are used across the engineering organisation rather than within just one product area.

Help build shared capabilities and DevEx foundations that enable teams to work effectively with agentic AI.

Use agentic AI in your own DevEx work and share practical learning with engineering teams.

We foster a developer-friendly culture with room to explore new technologies and ways of working. You’ll have access to modern AI-powered tools, join hackathons and take part in internal developer forums where we share ideas and discuss architecture, technology and engineering challenges.

Let's dive into your key responsibilities, you will

Build and evolve shared libraries, scaffolding templates, and CI/CD tooling that remove recurring friction for product squads.
Build paved paths for messaging patterns like Outbox and Sagas, observability, and rehydration/recovery tooling.
Support developers in adopting shared standards for tracing, service integration, and AWS infrastructure.
Work with engineers across product squads to understand recurring friction and turn it into DevEx priorities.
Help squads adopt platform practices that make service ownership, operation, and reuse easier.
Support developers in adopting shared standards for tracing, service integration, AWS infrastructure, and secure, reliable defaults

The need-to-have

Strong engineering experience in .NET / C#.
Proficiency in AWS services (e.g., ECS, Lambda, SQS, S3) and infrastructure-as-code (CDK/Terraform).
Familiarity with microservices, event-driven architecture, and distributed-systems patterns such as Outbox, Sagas, and CDC.
Hands-on experience building shared libraries, observability tooling, and reusable APIs.
Excellent collaboration and communication skills, able to support squads, gather feedback, and drive adoption.

The nice-to-have skills

Experience in platform engineering or developer enablement roles.
Familiarity with internal documentation practices, onboarding tooling, and automated scaffolding.
Hands-on work with service event rehydration, incident recovery tooling, or metadata standards.
Practical experience using LLMs, generative AI, or agentic AI in software development.

We’re eager to hear from you! If this sounds like a great match and sparks your interest, don’t wait, apply today!

About AutoProff

AutoProff was founded in 2013 by the experienced car dealer Jesper Ratza in Denmark. The aim was to digitalize B2B used car trading, helping car dealers increase sales and improve profits.

in August 2022, AutoScout24, the leading specialized pan-European online car marketplace, acquired a majority stake in AutoProff. The partnership has supported the rapid expansion of AutoProff's solutions across Europe and enables the creation of Europe's first fully integrated C2B-B2B-B2C dealing solution for used cars.

At AutoProff, we specialize in providing online B2B used-car dealing solutions designed to improve the buying and selling experience for professional car dealers and their customers.

We are the emerging European leader with more than 150,000 B2B used cars on our online trading platforms annually.

With a focus on effective solutions, digitization and customer service, we are committed to being the home of B2B car dealing for European car dealers.

Build and evolve shared libraries, scaffolding templates, and CI/CD tooling that remove recurring friction for product squads.

Support developers in adopting shared standards for tracing, service integration, and AWS infrastructure.

Experience in platform engineering or developer enablement roles.

We are the emerging European leader with more than 150,000 B2B used cars on our online trading platforms annually.

who enjoys building useful software and wants to do more than experiment with AI, someone who can turn it into reliable solutions that people actually use.

This is a practical, hands-on engineering role. You’ll have space to explore new ideas, but the goal is always the same: build something useful, reliable, and ready for the real world.

You don’t need to know every technology in our stack from day one. We’re looking for a strong software engineer who already has some hands-on experience with AI and wants to go deeper.

We call ourselves the “Unified Platform Services” team and work across products and development teams to build shared solutions and make individual product teams more effective. We also help shape how AI is used across our different products. We are a small team with a mix of skills across AI, DevOps, and traditional software development.

What You Will Be Doing

As our new AI engineer colleague, you will be assigned to specific AI projects and deliveries, but you’ll also share what you learn and help other development teams make effective use of AI tools. As part of these two focus areas, you will:

Design, build and maintain AI-powered applications, assistants and services.
Develop backend services and APIs.

Collaborate with product teams and internal functions to understand problems and turn them into practical technical solutions.
Build reusable tools, integrations and templates that help other teams work effectively with AI.
Share knowledge and contribute to how we use AI across the company.

At least 3+ years of software development experience

Experience building production services or APIs – ideally AI-related ones
Hands-on experience building AI-powered applications or integrating AI into software

C#

Data pipelines

Vill du ta ett övergripande arkitektansvar och vara med och forma hur moderna affärssystem används i komplexa verksamheter?

Hos Nexer Enterprise Applications finns nu en möjlighet för en senior lösningsarkitekt inom Dynamics 365 F&SCM
med stark förankring i både affär och teknik.

Hos oss får du ett tydligt mandat, korta beslutsvägar och stort förtroende i uppdrag där kvalitet, struktur och affärsnytta står i fokus.

Om rollen

I rollen som lösningsarkitekt har du ett övergripande ansvar för lösningsdesign och arkitektur i våra D365 F&SCM projekt. Du fungerar som strategisk rådgivare till kund och som funktionell ledare i leveransteamet, med ansvar för att lösningen är hållbar, skalbar och väl förankrad i verksamhetens behov.

Du är involverad tidigt i uppdragen från presales och lösningsförslag till genomförande och vidareutveckling och bidrar även till att utveckla Nexers Enterprise Applications erbjudande inom D365 F&SCM.

Ditt ansvar omfattar bland annat:

Arkitektur- och lösningsansvar i D365 F&SCM Management.

Kravanalys och processdesign med fokus på distribution och/eller tillverkning.
Kvalitetssäkring av lösning genom design, teststrategi och kunskapsöverföring.
Nära samarbete med projektledare och leveransteam för att säkerställa en stabil och affärsmässig leverans.

Våra kunder finns både i Sverige och internationellt, från växande bolag till större organisationer, vilket gör rollen både varierad och affärskritisk.

och har ett mycket nära samarbete med Microsoft, både i Sverige och globalt. Microsoft ser oss som en nyckelpartner för att realisera affärsvärde hos företag

Du är en trygg och erfaren arkitekt som skapar förtroende i kunddialogen och är van att ta ansvar för helheten. Du har ett konsultativt förhållningssätt, kan navigera komplexa kravbilder och säkerställer att lösningen stödjer verksamhetens långsiktiga mål.

Stark förståelse för affärsprocesser inom distribution och/eller tillverkning.

Vi tror på att bli bättre tillsammans. Stabiliteten från en större organisation.
Flexibiliteten och närheten i en mindre verksamhet.
En kultur där vi firar framgångar med events, resor och konferenser.

jobs.location: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
jobs.description:
Job Description

Senior Platform Engineer
– Public 360° – Tieto Indtech (m/f/d)

Tieto Public 360° – building secure, scalable digital services for the public sector across the Nordics.

About The Company

Tieto's Public 360° is a leading case management platform used across the Nordic public sector for over 20 years. Since 2014, the SaaS platform has been running on modernized Azure infrastructure with automated deployments while also supporting on-prem/hybrid/Domestic cloud installations.

The 360° Platform Currently Powers Three Solutions

Public 360° – Case and archive management

Plan & Build 360° – Building permit applications

eArchive 360° – Long-term data storage

The challenge

We're building on Public 360°'s modern foundation to expand across multiple cloud environments—strengthening Nordic digital sovereignty and enabling AI capabilities, all while maintaining the highest requirements for security and compliance.

The role

As a Senior Platform Engineer, you'll advance the technical capabilities of the 360° hosting platform. You'll design and operate cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes platforms, automation, and security systems that support continued growth and enable new AI-powered features.

Key Responsibilities

Build and operate the cloud platform foundation supporting Public 360° across Public Cloud and Domestic Cloud environments.
Deploy, manage, and continuously improve Kubernetes-based platforms and containerized workloads.
Drive automation through Infrastructure as Code (Bicep), GitOps, CI/CD, and self-service platform capabilities.
Establish secure and scalable platform services covering networking, identity, secrets management, monitoring, and operational governance.
Improve reliability and operational excellence through observability, automation, incident management, and best practices.
Support the modernization of Public 360° through cloud-native technologies, APIs, messaging, and microservices architectures.

Required Qualifications

Several years of experience in Platform Engineering, Cloud Engineering, DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering, or similar roles.
Strong Azure and cloud-native platform experience.
Strong hands-on Kubernetes experience, including:
Cluster deployment, installation, and lifecycle management.
Operations, upgrades, troubleshooting, and maintenance.
Networking, security, and scalability.
Experience operating Kubernetes in cloud, on-premises, or domestic cloud environments.

Experience with Microsoft Azure services, particularly AKS, cloud networking, security monitoring, logging, and observability platforms.
Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Bicep, Terraform or similar), GitOps, and CI/CD using Azure DevOps and/or GitHub.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with sovereign, domestic cloud, hybrid cloud, or other highly regulated environments.
Familiarity with messaging technologies such as RabbitMQ, Kafka, or Azure Service Bus.
Experience with Keycloak or other identity and access management platforms.
Experience operating distributed systems, microservices architectures, or multi-region Kubernetes environments.
Exposure to AI platform infrastructure, intelligent automation, or GenAI technologies.

Tech we use

We are Azure-first and automation-driven, building and operating our platform using Kubernetes (AKS), Docker, containers, GitOps, and Infrastructure as Code with Bicep. Our engineering teams use Azure DevOps and GitHub Workflows for CI/CD and automation, supported by Azure networking and cloud security services. We focus heavily on observability and reliability, using Grafana, Prometheus, Loki, and Alloy for monitoring and telemetry. Authentication and authorization are managed through Keycloak, while RabbitMQ provides messaging capabilities across our platform. Our API and ingress layer is built on technologies such as APISIX and NGINX, with certificate management handled through OpenBao and cert-manager. Development is primarily done using .NET (C#), TypeScript/JavaScript, PowerShell, and Bash, with Visual Studio and Visual Studio Code as our primary development tools.

Why join us

Build technology that improves citizen services across the Nordic public sector.
Work with modern cloud technologies and large-scale enterprise software.
Join a highly skilled and collaborative engineering environment with significant influence on technical decisions.
Opportunity to shape the future platform capabilities supporting Public 360°.
Professional growth through international collaboration, technical leadership opportunities, and continuous learning.
A culture built on trust, transparency, ownership, and innovation.

Practicalities

Location and work setup:
Flexible/hybrid, ideally near one of our development hubs in Scandinavia (Oslo, Stockholm, Copenhagen, or Espoo).

Language requirements:
Fluent English required. Nordic language skills are considered an advantage.

Are you our new colleague?

We look forward to hearing from you! We will fill the position as soon as we find the right person, so we encourage you to apply today.

If you have any questions regarding this role, please contact the hiring managers Ida Sirevaag
(ida.sirevaag@tieto.com) or Geir Are Bjørnsrud
(geirare.bjornsrud@tieto.com)

Additional Information

At Tieto, we believe in the power of diversity, equity, and inclusion. We encourage applicants of all backgrounds, genders (m/f/d), and walks of life to join our team, as we believe that this fosters an inspiring workplace and fuels innovation. Our commitment to openness, trust, and diversity is at the heart of our mission to create digital futures that benefit businesses, societies, and humanity.

jobs.title: Frontend Developer
jobs.description:
Shape the experience thousands of Danes use every day.

At Spillehallen.dk ApS — part of the Gaming group— we're looking for a developer who cares as much about how something feels as about how it's built.

This is not a role where someone hands you a Figma file and a ticket. You will sit close to the people who talk to our customers every single day, and close to the people who bring them here. You'll see the friction first-hand, form your own opinion about it, and then go fix it in the product.

You'll report directly to our CTO, but your everyday rhythm is set by Commercial Operations — Customer Center and Marketing. That's deliberate. The fastest way to build a better product is to sit where the problems actually surface.

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

- Improve the user experience on Spillehallen.dk: flows, navigation, forms, onboarding, responsiveness, accessibility and performance. You'll propose changes, not just implement them.
- Design and build in the same motion. Wireframe it, prototype it, build it in React and TypeScript, ship it, measure it.
- Work in Umbraco. Build and maintain page types, blocks, templates and components so Marketing and Customer Center can create and adjust content themselves, without a developer in the loop.
- Build AI-driven automated testing. Help us raise the bar on regression and end-to-end coverage using modern AI-assisted testing tooling, so we can ship faster with more confidence.
- Handle the real work that comes with a live platform: campaign pages, content structures, self-service improvements, small internal tools, and the quick fixes that make a colleague's day easier.
- Reduce support load by design. Fewer confusing screens means fewer tickets.
- Contribute to technical decisions on frontend architecture, design system and component structure.

OUR TECHNOLOGY

React, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML5 and CSS, Umbraco, .NET / C#, REST APIs, Microsoft SQL Server, Docker, Azure DevOps and Pipelines, Git.

We already use AI-assisted development tools such as Codex in our daily work, and we're actively expanding into AI-driven testing. We want colleagues who are genuinely excited about that shift — not sceptical bystanders, and not uncritical believers either.

WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

We're describing a strong junior or an aspiring senior: someone with a couple of years of real, professional experience who is clearly on the way up and wants a place with room to grow fast.

You probably recognise yourself in most of this:

- You are a developer first, but you have a genuinely strong eye for UX and UI. Bad spacing bothers you. Unclear copy bothers you. A three-step flow that should be one step bothers you.
- You're comfortable in React and TypeScript, and you write CSS you're not embarrassed by.
- You've worked with a CMS before. Umbraco experience is a clear plus, but we'll happily teach it.
- You like talking to non-technical colleagues, and you can translate "customers keep calling about this" into a concrete solution.
- You take ownership from idea to production, and you follow up on whether it actually worked.
- You're curious about AI-assisted development and testing, and you want to help figure out how we use it well.
- You want visible impact rather than being a small cog in a large machine.

Experience from gaming, betting, fintech, payments or e-commerce is a plus, but not a requirement. What matters more is what you've built, how you think, and the value you've created.

WHY SPILLEHALLEN.DK

You'll join a skilled team where ideas matter more than hierarchy. We combine the professionalism of a mature technology company with the ownership and pace you'd normally find in a small product team.

Because you sit between technology and commercial operations, you'll get an unusually complete picture of the business early in your career — the kind of perspective that turns a good developer into a senior one.

We offer:

- A high degree of ownership and real influence on product direction
- Direct access to the CTO and to the people closest to our customers
- Modern tools, a modern stack, and a genuine mandate to improve things
- Flexible working arrangements when needed
- Lunch arrangement
- An active employee association with regular social events
- A collaborative and informal working environment

LOCATION

Spillehallen.dk ApS,Jens Juuls Vej 2, 8260 Viby J, Denmark.

We have a strong in-office culture and believe the best solutions come from close collaboration — especially in a role that lives this close to Customer Center and Marketing. Flexibility is available when needed, but this is primarily an office-based position.

INTERESTED?

Send us your application, LinkedIn profile, GitHub, portfolio — or just reach out for an informal conversation. Show us something you've built and tell us why you made the choices you did.

If you like the idea of owning the experience on a platform thousands of people use every day, we'd love to hear from you.

Job Description & Requirements

We are seeking a hands-on AI Application Engineer to help bridge the gap between rapid AI prototyping and production-grade software delivery. In this role, you will help establish a structured path to production for high-potential AI use cases—transforming initial prototypes into secure, scalable, and fully governed applications.
Sitting within our core engineering division, you will collaborate with product owners, data engineers, security specialists, and business stakeholders to refactor, harden, and scale AI-driven solutions across the organization.
Key Responsibilities

Re-architect early-stage AI prototypes and experimental code into maintainable, production-ready software using clean architecture, secure authentication, and robust APIs.
Design and build end-to-end AI capabilities, including conversational interfaces, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures, workflow agents, and enterprise automation tools.
Build and maintain scalable applications across front-end UI, back-end APIs, database integrations, authentication, logging, and monitoring systems.
Implement AI safety patterns, including retrieval grounding, prompt management, input/output filtering, audit logging, and human-in-the-loop workflows.
Develop standardized starter templates, reusable patterns, and engineering playbooks to accelerate AI delivery across multiple teams.
Build automated testing suites (functional, regression, prompt quality, and guardrail validation) and implement system monitoring for latency, token usage, cost, and error tracking.
Partner with platform engineers to deploy applications via modern CI/CD pipelines, containerization standards, and enterprise cloud infrastructure.
Maintain solution designs, standard operating procedures, and support guides to ensure long-term maintainability.

Required Qualifications

7+ years of hands-on software development experience building and supporting enterprise-grade or cloud-native applications.
Strong expertise in modern languages and frameworks such as React, TypeScript, Node.js, Python, .NET, or Java.
Hands-on experience integrating applications with major cloud AI services (e.g., Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Search, Azure ML, or equivalent public cloud environments) and RESTful services.
Practical experience implementing LLMs, RAG patterns, prompt engineering, vector search, embeddings, and workflow orchestration.
Solid understanding of secure coding practices (secrets management, least-privilege access) and identity frameworks (OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, SAML, JWT, RBAC).
Experience using CI/CD platforms (e.g., GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps), containerization, deployment rollbacks, and environment management.
Firm grasp of AI-specific risks, including hallucinations, prompt injection, data leakage, and explainability limitations.

Preferred Experience

Experience with AI orchestration frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen) and vector databases (e.g., pgvector, Pinecone).
Exposure to AI evaluation, red teaming, and safety benchmarking.
Experience integrating with enterprise collaboration platforms and workflow systems.
Familiarity with public sector compliance, data classification, and regulatory frameworks.
Practical use of AI-assisted development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot) to improve engineering velocity.

jobs.title: Sr Staff Software Engineer
jobs.description:
What if the work you did every day could impact the lives of people you know? Or all of humanity?

At Illumina, we are expanding access to genomic technology to realize health equity for billions of people around the world. Our efforts enable life-changing discoveries that are transforming human health through the early detection and diagnosis of diseases and new treatment options for patients.

Working at Illumina means being part of something bigger than yourself. Every person, in every role, has the opportunity to make a difference. Surrounded by extraordinary people, inspiring leaders, and world changing projects, you will do more and become more than you ever thought possible.

Summary

At Illumina, we are expanding access to genomic technology to realize health equity for billions of people around the world. Our efforts enable life-changing discoveries that are transforming human health through the early detection and diagnosis of diseases and new treatment options for patients.

Sequencing has moved genomics from single studies to population scale. Multi-million-sample cohorts, linked phenotypes and multi-omic data are now generated faster than most organizations can analyze them. Our team builds the data platform and the analytical applications that turn these assets into products: a cloud-native lakehouse for genomic and phenotypic data, large-scale statistical genetics pipelines that run reliably at population scale, and the APIs and user interfaces that let scientists ask questions of billions of records and get answers in seconds.

We are looking for a Sr. Staff Software Engineer for this effort in Singapore: someone who can take state-of-the-art analytical methods and turn them into scalable, high-performance, commercial software, and who can work fluently across bioinformatics scientists, cloud infrastructure engineers, and product management. You will work with a globally distributed team, prototyping quickly, demonstrating early, and iterating toward a releasable product.

Responsibilities

Turn advanced statistical genetics methods (for example, genome-wide and phenome-wide association testing for both common and rare variants) from prototypes into high-performance, scientifically accurate, commercially releasable products.
Design and implement analysis pipelines that scale to millions of samples on a cloud-native lakehouse, and establish the standardized, reusable design pattern for low-latency analysis on open table formats at petabyte scale.
Deliver the APIs, web UI and natural-language/agentic query interfaces through which scientific users explore association results and cohort/phenotype data interactively at scale.
Own the operability and unit economics of the platform: orchestrate, monitor, debug and cost-optimize workloads spanning millions of concurrent jobs, designing for fault tolerance and reproducible results.
Partner with bioinformatics scientists, cloud infrastructure teams and product management to translate scientific and customer needs into a product architecture and credible delivery plan aligned with the platform and data business strategy, applying a clear view of what distinguishes a commercial-grade offering from research and open-source community tooling.
Set technical direction and raise engineering standards through design review, mentorship and hands-on contribution, prototyping and iterating rapidly with a customer-first mindset across a globally distributed team.

Requirements

Degree in Computer Science / Engineering / Bioinformatics / Mathematics or a related field.
Demonstrated experience designing and delivering large-scale, data-analysis production software in the cloud (AWS, Azure, or GCP), including containerization (Docker), orchestration, infrastructure automation, and CI/CD.
Strong experience with modern data lake / lakehouse architectures, including open table format internals rather than usage alone: Apache Iceberg or Delta Lake table specifications, catalog services, snapshot lifecycle, partitioning and pruning strategy, compaction, and schema evolution, over columnar storage (Parquet) with distributed query engines (for example Spark, Trino, Databricks).
Solid algorithms and systems engineering foundation, with proven ability to implement performance-critical code in a compiled language such as C/C++, including concurrency, memory management, vectorization and SIMD, and work with columnar in-memory formats and vectorized engines such as Apache Arrow, DuckDB, or Velox.
Proven track record of profiling and optimizing end-to-end systems for runtime, memory, I/O and cloud cost at large scale, and of designing for horizontal scalability.
Proficiency in Python for rapid prototyping, data analysis, and productionized tooling, with familiarity with the scientific and ML/DL library ecosystem.
Experience designing and operating distributed batch and workflow systems that manage very large numbers of concurrent jobs, including metrics, tracing and structured logging, retry, checkpointing and idempotency, and failure triage at million-task scale.
Experience with scientific workflow languages and engines (for example Nextflow, WDL, CWL) and with execution on cloud batch or Kubernetes.
Experience designing and delivering service APIs with an API-first approach: REST or gRPC interface design, versioning and backward compatibility, and multi-tenant access patterns; plus enough full-stack fluency to partner on (or build) modern web front ends and to hold strong opinions on UI/UX for data-heavy scientific applications.
Experience validating numerically and statistically sensitive software: concordance testing against reference implementations, calibration checks, benchmark suites, versioned reference data, and end-to-end reproducibility.
Proven technical leadership and influence at senior level, with strong verbal and written communication skills, and the ability to self-manage and manage interdisciplinary relationships.
Demonstrated experience using AI tooling to plan, manage and accelerate the full software development lifecycle, and to materially increase engineering productivity and quality.

Experience / Education

Sr. Staff Software Engineer: Typically requires a minimum of 12 years of related experience with a Bachelor's degree; or 8 years and a Master's degree; or a PhD with 5 years experience; or equivalent experience.

Desired

Working knowledge of statistical genetics and population genomics: genome-wide and phenome-wide association studies, common and rare variant analysis (including gene-based burden and aggregate tests), mixed-model and whole-genome regression approaches, and the standard data formats and quality control practices of the field (VCF/gVCF, PLINK, BGEN, summary statistics, cohort and phenotype definition, ancestry and relatedness handling).
Hands-on experience with genomics-native storage and query stacks such as TileDB / TileDB-VCF, Hail, GLOW, or GenomicsDB.
Experience delivering commercial or clinical-grade genomics or life-science data products, including taking an internal or research tool through to a commercially released product, and a clear understanding of the differences in philosophy, obligations and trade-offs between commercial productization and academic, non-profit or research-community tooling.
Familiarity with techniques for low-latency query over very large result sets: precomputed summary indices, bitmap and zone maps, sketching, and tiered materialization.
Experience building agentic workflows and products, including tool/agent orchestration and MCP-style integrations, over enterprise data; and with machine learning, deep learning or foundation model training applied to genomic or biomedical data.
Experience implementing data governance controls: role-based and row/column-level access, audit trails, tenant isolation, and consent-driven restrictions on data use.
Experience with interactive data visualization for very large result sets, and with modern front-end frameworks.
Cloud cost engineering: cost-per-analysis modelling, spot and preemptible capacity strategy, storage tiering, and egress management.
Be curious, detail oriented, and analytical, with a proven ability to learn quickly.
Be customer-focused, team-oriented, and motivated, taking ownership of assigned tasks and of ambiguous problems.

Listed responsibilities are an essential, but not exhaustive, list of the usual duties associated with the position. Changes to individual responsibilities may occur due to business needs.

Suntem un start-up care sprijină SOLOprenorii în drumul lor spre succes. Construim un produs folosit deja de zeci de mii de oameni și vrem să-l ducem la următorul nivel.

Vei colabora cu echipa pentru a livra funcționalități în producție
Vei participa la decizii tehnice și vei învăța cum să le iei în timp
Vei folosi AI în workflow-ul tău pentru a crește viteza și calitatea

2–4 ani experiență în dezvoltare software;
Experiență cu backend (ideal .NET Core, dar nu obligatoriu);
Experiență cu baze de date relaționale și modelare de date;
Capacitatea de a lucra pe probleme care nu sunt complet definite;
Interes pentru produs și modul în care este folosit de utilizatori;
Te folosești de AI (Cursor, Claude, Copilot sau similar) pentru a-ți îmbunătăți modul de lucru și înveți să validezi output-ul.

Salariu competitiv (în funcție de nivel);
Zile nelimitate de concediu (pe care le și folosim);
Program flexibil;
Abonament premium la clinicile medicale Regina Maria;
Abonament Bookster;
Acces la tool-uri AI (Claude, Cursor, Copilot etc.) și buget de utilizare;
Lucrăm hibrid din București. Poți lucra până la 2 zile pe săptămână de acasă. În perioada de probă, te așteptăm zilnic la birou: e cea mai rapidă cale să înțelegi contextul, să cunoști echipa, și să ajungi să livrezi pe cont propriu.
