new_jobs.description:
Oletko kokenut ohjelmistokehittäjä, joka on huomannut käyttävänsä yhä enemmän aikaa teknisten ratkaisujen suunnitteluun, arkkitehtuurin hahmottamiseen tai muiden kehittäjien sparraamiseen?

Haemme
Digian Customer Applications & Power Platform (CA&PP) -yksikköön osaajaa, joka haluaa ottaa seuraavan askeleen urallaan kohti teknistä arkkitehtiroolia. Sinun ei tarvitse olla valmis arkkitehti, mutta toivomme, että sinulla on jo kokemusta teknisistä päätöksistä, ratkaisujen suunnittelusta sekä kokonaisuuksien hahmottamisesta.

CA&PP-yksikössämme työskentelee yli 80 Power Platform- ja Dynamics 365 -osaajaa. Meitä yhdistää vahva asiantuntijuus, auttamisen kulttuuri sekä halu rakentaa asiakkaille aidosti lisäarvoa tuottavia ratkaisuja.

Työskentelemme hybridimallilla ja se tarkoittaa meille sitä, että digialaisilla on vapaus valita työskentelypaikkansa viitenä päivänä viikossa työn ja työyhteisön tarpeet huomioiden.

Mitä pääset tekemään?

Tässä roolissa yhdistyvät käytännön kehitystyö ja kasvava vastuu teknisestä suunnittelusta.

Pääset esimerkiksi:

suunnittelemaan Power Platform- ja Dynamics 365 -ratkaisujen teknisiä toteutuksia
osallistumaan arkkitehtuurien, integraatioiden ja ratkaisukokonaisuuksien mallintamiseen
Rakentamaan tekoälyratkaisuja asiakkaille
sparraamaan kehittäjiä teknisissä ratkaisuissa
tekemään edelleen hands-on-kehitystä osaamisesi ja kiinnostuksesi mukaan
osallistumaan asiakaskeskusteluihin ja teknisten vaihtoehtojen arviointiin
vaikuttamaan siihen, miten ratkaisuja rakennetaan nyt ja tulevaisuudessa
seuraamaan Microsoft-ekosysteemin kehitystä ja tuomaan uusia mahdollisuuksia osaksi asiakasratkaisuja

Sinulla ei tarvitse olla pitkäaikaista kokemusta arkkitehtina. Sen sijaan arvostamme kokemusta ja kiinnostusta tekniseen suunnitteluun.

Toivomme, että sinulla on kokemusta ainakin osasta seuraavista:

Power Platformista (Power Apps, Power Automate, Dataverse)
Dynamics 365 -ratkaisuista
JavaScriptista ja/tai C#:sta (esimerkiksi pluginit)
integraatioista ja Azure-palveluista
DevOps- ja ALM-käytännöistä
teknisten ratkaisujen suunnittelusta, dokumentoinnista tai arkkitehtuurikuvausten laatimisesta
tekoälytyökalujen hyödyntämisestä omassa työssä
muiden kehittäjien tukemisesta tai teknisestä ohjaamisesta

Työssä tarvitset hyvää suomen ja englannin kielen taitoa.

Tämä rooli sopii erinomaisesti sinulle, joka haluat kasvaa kohti teknistä arkkitehtuuria kokeneiden ammattilaisten ympäröimänä.

Tarjoamme:

mahdollisuuden rakentaa omaa polkuasi senior developerista kohti teknistä arkkitehtiroolia.
Oppimista tukevan kulttuurin. Sinulle varataan viikoittain aikaa uuden oppimisen ja teknologioihin syventymiseen eli työarjessasi on väljyyttä.
Mentorointia ja tukea kokeneilta arkkitehdeilta ja kehittäjiltä. Myös toimitustiimien ja heimojen kautta osaamista jaetaan työajalla.
Mahdollisuuden vaikuttaa roolisi sisältöön ja urapolkuusi.
Erinomaiset työsuhde-edut, kuten kattavat työterveyspalvelut, loma-ajan mökit, 2000 euron rekrytointibonuksen jne.
OpenClub-yhteisöt: leffat, padel, käsityöt, lautapelit, kahvihifistely, viinit, uinti… löydät varmasti omasi!

Räätälöimme lopullisen roolin osaamisesi, kokemuksesi ja uratoiveidesi mukaan.

Hakuaika päättyy 11.10.2026.

new_jobs.title: Intelligent Automation Developer
new_jobs.description:
Are you looking for a career in an inspiring, global environment where your expertise makes a difference? At Neste, you will be working for the world’s leading producer of renewable diesel and sustainable aviation fuel, which enable our customers to reduce their greenhouse gas emissions.

We are looking for you,

Intelligent Automation Developer

to our Intelligent Automation & Key Expert Network team in the Marketing & Services business unit. This position is based at our headquarters in Espoo, Finland.

You will focus on implementing Marketing & Services’ Strategy Passion for Excellence and Best Customer Experience by automating processes with RPA (robotic process automation) and other Intelligent Automation solutions. We build our solutions on our Intelligent Automation platform, utilizing UiPath as our main tool. We currently have over 100 automations in production handling over 20,000 transactions per month.

As an Intelligent Automation Developer, you will combine hands-on development work with active business engagement. In this role, building new automations requires a strongly solution-oriented mindset, an outgoing personality, and a proactive approach to working closely with various business units. By actively listening to business needs and connecting with stakeholders, you ensure we build the best possible solutions to drive and support the business.

You will also get involved in our transformation journey as we design and implement Microsoft Dynamics 365 to replace the current fragmented system landscape. You will become part of our growing intelligent automation team, currently consisting of 3 experts, working closely with Marketing & Services teams in Finland, Estonia, Latvia, and Lithuania, as well as other Intelligent Automation developers across Neste.

Reasons to join

We operate in an inspiring and evolving business environment as a global leader in renewable fuels. We contribute to Neste’s success by living our values every day: we care, we have courage, we cooperate.

We prioritize safety at all times and in every location. We strive to create a positive and impactful work environment.

Transformation brings new possibilities and fosters our courage and curiosity. As a global company, we support personal development with versatile learning and career opportunities. Collaboration is key, and we believe in flexible, smart ways of working. We offer a hybrid working model, working at our Espoo office at least three days a week to ensure seamless teamwork, active daily collaboration, and a strong sense of belonging.

In addition, our benefits for employees in Finland include, for example, a personnel fund as part of the overall remuneration, high-quality occupational health care, membership in a health insurance fund, and leisure time accident insurance. We also support leisure activities by offering benefits for sports and culture (ePassi).

More about the job

Your role in our team

Active Business Collaboration: Actively engage and communicate with business units to discover automation opportunities, understand business needs, and build optimal solutions that maximize operational value.

Hands-on Development: Develop, implement, and maintain Intelligent Automation solutions in cooperation with key stakeholders to improve processes and increase efficiency with measurable results.

Solution-Oriented Problem Solving: Take a proactive, outgoing approach to designing innovative and practical automation solutions.

Standardization & Best Practices: Work with other Neste Intelligent Automation teams, Business Analysts, and developers to define and continuously improve automation standards and ways of working.

Documentation & Quality: Create and maintain process documentations, Solution Design Documents (SDD), and technical documentations according to defined Neste standards.

Testing & Monitoring: Participate in User Acceptance Testing (UAT) with internal customers and monitor automations after deployment.

Continuous Learning: Follow up on developments in automation technologies and share knowledge with the team.

Agile Ways of Working: Attend relevant Scrum meetings and commit to Sprint deliverables.

The best combination to succeed in this role

Solution-Oriented & Outgoing Personality:
Excellent communication skills with a customer-centric and proactive approach to building relationships with business partners.

Hands-on Automation Experience:
Solid RPA development experience with UiPath, Blue Prism, or similar platforms.

Programming Skills:
Experience coding in Python, VB.NET, C#, Java, or SQL in a professional environment.

AI & Machine Learning:
Hands-on experience or strong familiarity with Machine Learning development and/or Artificial Intelligence solutions.

Process & Tech Mindset:
Process-oriented mindset with an interest in intelligent process automation, databases, and software development methodologies (e.g., Scrum, DevOps, DevSecOps).

Proactivity:
Independent drive to solve complex problems, embrace change, and achieve tangible results.

Intercultural Collaboration:
Ability to collaborate seamlessly in a cross-functional and multicultural environment with both internal and external parties.

Education & Languages:
B.Sc. level degree (including studies in Computer Science, Information Technology, or Process Development) and fluency in English
(written and spoken).

Compliance Awareness:
Basic knowledge of GDPR and Know Your Customer (KYC) guidelines.

Other strengths we value are
experience with Microsoft Power Platform and Power Automate.

Let’s get you started

We look forward to receiving your CV and application with a salary request by September 15, 2026.

If you have any questions regarding the process or the position, please get in touch with Milla Nieminen, Manager, Intelligent Automation and Solutions, +358 400 655 315, on weekdays between 8:00-16:00 (EEST / Finnish time) until September 3rd, 2026.

To ensure security and confidentiality, please submit your application through our recruitment system, as we are unable to consider applications sent via email. We will do our best to contact you within 2 w eeks after the application time has ended. The recruitment process will include interviews and a potential aptitude assessment. The first interviews are preliminarily scheduled to take place in week 40-41 . Depending on the requirements of the position, the process may include a security clearance (with a drug test) and a potential statutory health examination based on work-related exposures.

Neste in brief

Neste (NESTE, Nasdaq Helsinki) is the world's leading producer of renewable diesel and sustainable aviation fuel (SAF), with production on three continents. The company’s renewables production capacity is expected to reach 6.8 million tons annually in 2027. Neste also produces high-quality oil products at its Porvoo refinery in Finland. The company has a network of nearly 1,000 fuel stations with expanding service offering, such as EV charging, in Finland and in the Baltics.

Neste’s strategy focuses on growth in renewable fuels, which help its customers to reduce their greenhouse gas emissions. Neste is included in many international indices for its sustainability performance. In 2025, Neste's revenue stood at EUR 19.0 billion. Read more: neste.com

new_jobs.title: Senior Platform Engineer– Public 360° – Tieto Indtech (m/f/d)
new_jobs.description:
Job Description

Senior Platform Engineer
– Public 360° – Tieto Indtech (m/f/d)

Tieto Public 360° – building secure, scalable digital services for the public sector across the Nordics.

About The Company

Tieto's Public 360° is a leading case management platform used across the Nordic public sector for over 20 years. Since 2014, the SaaS platform has been running on modernized Azure infrastructure with automated deployments while also supporting on-prem/hybrid/Domestic cloud installations.

The 360° Platform Currently Powers Three Solutions

Public 360° – Case and archive management

Plan & Build 360° – Building permit applications

eArchive 360° – Long-term data storage

The challenge

We're building on Public 360°'s modern foundation to expand across multiple cloud environments—strengthening Nordic digital sovereignty and enabling AI capabilities, all while maintaining the highest requirements for security and compliance.

The role

As a Senior Platform Engineer, you'll advance the technical capabilities of the 360° hosting platform. You'll design and operate cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes platforms, automation, and security systems that support continued growth and enable new AI-powered features.

Key Responsibilities

Build and operate the cloud platform foundation supporting Public 360° across Public Cloud and Domestic Cloud environments.
Deploy, manage, and continuously improve Kubernetes-based platforms and containerized workloads.
Drive automation through Infrastructure as Code (Bicep), GitOps, CI/CD, and self-service platform capabilities.
Establish secure and scalable platform services covering networking, identity, secrets management, monitoring, and operational governance.
Improve reliability and operational excellence through observability, automation, incident management, and best practices.
Support the modernization of Public 360° through cloud-native technologies, APIs, messaging, and microservices architectures.

Required Qualifications

Several years of experience in Platform Engineering, Cloud Engineering, DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering, or similar roles.
Strong Azure and cloud-native platform experience.
Strong hands-on Kubernetes experience, including:
Cluster deployment, installation, and lifecycle management.
Operations, upgrades, troubleshooting, and maintenance.
Networking, security, and scalability.
Experience operating Kubernetes in cloud, on-premises, or domestic cloud environments.

Experience with Microsoft Azure services, particularly AKS, cloud networking, security monitoring, logging, and observability platforms.
Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Bicep, Terraform or similar), GitOps, and CI/CD using Azure DevOps and/or GitHub.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with sovereign, domestic cloud, hybrid cloud, or other highly regulated environments.
Familiarity with messaging technologies such as RabbitMQ, Kafka, or Azure Service Bus.
Experience with Keycloak or other identity and access management platforms.
Experience operating distributed systems, microservices architectures, or multi-region Kubernetes environments.
Exposure to AI platform infrastructure, intelligent automation, or GenAI technologies.

Tech we use

We are Azure-first and automation-driven, building and operating our platform using Kubernetes (AKS), Docker, containers, GitOps, and Infrastructure as Code with Bicep. Our engineering teams use Azure DevOps and GitHub Workflows for CI/CD and automation, supported by Azure networking and cloud security services. We focus heavily on observability and reliability, using Grafana, Prometheus, Loki, and Alloy for monitoring and telemetry. Authentication and authorization are managed through Keycloak, while RabbitMQ provides messaging capabilities across our platform. Our API and ingress layer is built on technologies such as APISIX and NGINX, with certificate management handled through OpenBao and cert-manager. Development is primarily done using .NET (C#), TypeScript/JavaScript, PowerShell, and Bash, with Visual Studio and Visual Studio Code as our primary development tools.

Why join us

Build technology that improves citizen services across the Nordic public sector.
Work with modern cloud technologies and large-scale enterprise software.
Join a highly skilled and collaborative engineering environment with significant influence on technical decisions.
Opportunity to shape the future platform capabilities supporting Public 360°.
Professional growth through international collaboration, technical leadership opportunities, and continuous learning.
A culture built on trust, transparency, ownership, and innovation.

Practicalities

Location and work setup:
Flexible/hybrid, ideally near one of our development hubs in Scandinavia (Oslo, Stockholm, Copenhagen, or Espoo).

Language requirements:
Fluent English required. Nordic language skills are considered an advantage.

Are you our new colleague?

We look forward to hearing from you! We will fill the position as soon as we find the right person, so we encourage you to apply today.

If you have any questions regarding this role, please contact the hiring managers Ida Sirevaag
(ida.sirevaag@tieto.com) or Geir Are Bjørnsrud
(geirare.bjornsrud@tieto.com).

Additional Information

At Tieto, we believe in the power of diversity, equity, and inclusion. We encourage applicants of all backgrounds, genders (m/f/d), and walks of life to join our team, as we believe that this fosters an inspiring workplace and fuels innovation. Our commitment to openness, trust, and diversity is at the heart of our mission to create digital futures that benefit businesses, societies, and humanity.

Diversity, equity and inclusion | Sustainability | Tieto

new_jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer (C#/.NET, Azure)
new_jobs.description:
WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT TO US

SimCorp is developing a new game changing Software-as-a-Service solution for Performance Measurement and Attribution, which will allow Investment Managers to interact with, and analyze their investments in a modern web application. It is connected to a high-performance computing calculation engine in the back-end, thus combining more than 50 years of industry-leading experience of SimCorp with a modern user experience and cloud computing, enabling users to do in minutes what used to take hours.

We welcome applications from both early‑career and mid‑career software engineers.

WHAT YOU WILL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR

Build solutions: collaborate closely with your team, Product Managers, Architects, peers and end-users to deliver high-quality, secure and valuable solutions in the Performance Product Area.
Contribute across the entire development lifecycle - from requirements analysis and design to implementation, test automation, documentation, and ongoing support.
Coordinate and execute on development and maintenance of the investment performance solution in collaboration with product owners and other teams.
Think beyond the code: Understand our strategy, goals and customer needs to enhance SimCorp’s impact.
You will work closely with experienced engineers who support your development. Over time, you will grow into taking ownership of larger components and may mentor more junior colleagues as your experience grows.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

Solid knowledge of C#, .NET Core/Framework, and object-oriented design principles.
Experience with APIs.
Familiarity with modern engineering practices, including CI/CD pipelines and trunk-based development. We use Git (Azure DevOps).
Interest in cloud engineering. We use Microsoft Azure.
You understand the importance of automated testing of business‑critical functionality and quality assurance practices.
Willingness to dive into a complex domain, working with finance, investment performance & attribution and investment-related instruments.
You are able to solve complex problems in a structured manner.
You are enthusiastic about building state-of-the-art software, and have the mindset needed to make others understand your ideas.
Curiosity and adaptability to learn in-house tools and frameworks - including the APL programming language (no prior experience in APL required, we provide extensive training).
You are good at coordinating with both programmers and non-programmers, to ensure a full understanding of tasks.
You have a Master’s degree or higher within Computer Sciences, Engineering, Finance, Physics, Mathematics, Economics or similar experience.
If you have knowledge of a financial domain it is plus, otherwise we will bring you up to speed using technical discussions, training and a comprehensive onboarding program.

WHAT IS IT LIKE TO WORK HERE

SimCorp plans work in an agile manner, using 4 planning intervals (PI’s) per year, each consisting of 5 sprints of 2 weeks each, followed by a 3-week Innovation and Planning sprint, which can be used for mastering skills in various areas, or more freely investigating ideas with prototypes. It is important that our people learn and grow constantly, and SimCorp invests a lot to foster the continuous learning environment to support people on their journeys.

Global hybrid work policy
- We ask you to work 2 days a week from the office. If you choose you can work remotely the other days. Of course you are welcome at the office if that is your preference.
Growth and innovation
- Every 6th sprint is reserved for planning and innovation. So, with regular intervals you have a chance to explore and learn new skills or improve something that you believe will be beneficial to you, your team or the application.
Self- Direction
- High degree of self-organization. Each team and developer have a high degree of freedom to plan, organize and design their work.
Inclusive and diverse company culture
Pension and health benefits and bonus
Work-life balance
– We strongly believe that an equilibrium between professional responsibilities makes us all the best version of our self’s, both in private life and as a colleague in the workplace
Empowerment
– We believe that all voices are valuable and must be heard. You will involved in shaping our work processes

NEXT STEPS

Please send us your application in English via our career site as soon as possible, we process incoming applications continually. Please note that only applications sent through our system will be processed. At SimCorp, we recognize that bias can unintentionally occur in the recruitment process. To uphold fairness and equal opportunities for all applicants, we kindly ask you to exclude personal data such as photo, age, or any non-professional information from your application. Thank you for aiding us in our endeavor to mitigate biases in our recruitment process.
If you are interested in being a part of SimCorp but are not sure this role is suitable, submit your CV anyway. SimCorp is on an exciting growth journey, and our Talent Acquisition Team is ready to assist you discover the right role for you. The approximate time to consider your CV is three weeks.
We are eager to continually improve our talent acquisition process and make everyone’s experience positive and valuable. Therefore, during the process we will ask you to provide your feedback, which is highly appreciated.

WHO WE ARE

For over 50 years, we have worked closely with investment and asset managers to become the world’s leading provider of integrated investment management solutions. We are 3,000+ colleagues with a broad range of nationalities, educations, professional experiences, ages, and backgrounds.
SimCorp is an independent subsidiary of the Deutsche Börse Group. Following the recent merger with Axioma, we leverage the combined strength of our brands to provide an industry-leading, full, front-to-back offering for our clients.
SimCorp is an equal opportunity employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, without regard to race, gender, age, disability, or any other protected status under applicable law. We are committed to building a culture where diverse perspectives and expertise are integrated into our everyday work. We believe in the continual growth and development of our employees, so that we can provide best-in-class solutions to our clients.

As our new software Engineer, you will develop and maintain mission software with long service-lives, supporting configuration, analysis, and verification of airborne self-protection systems. Your work spans the full software lifecycle – from design and implementation to testing, deployment, and long-term evolution.

In this role, you will collaborate closely with Systems Engineers, architects, testers, and domain specialists who represent product and user needs. Working in an agile and iterative way, you help qualify and challenge how solutions are implemented, bringing technical judgement and practical experience where it adds value, with a strong focus on correctness, traceability, and operational reliability.

Experienced Cloud Developer

Brænder du for cloud-arkitektur, integrationer og moderne udviklingsprincipper – og motiveres du af at bygge robuste, skalerbare løsninger tæt på forretningen?

Så har vi en spændende mulighed i Kvik A/S, hvor du bliver en central, spiller i vores Cloud Integration & Development (CID) team.

Måske arbejder du i dag som udvikler og er klar til at tage næste skridt i din karriere?

Som Cloud Developer i Kvik A/S, tilbyder vi netop denne mulighed.

Om teamet (CID)

CID-teamet driver en moderne Microsoft cloud platform i Kvik og er med til at sikre stabile og løbende forbedrede digitale services til vores butikker og interne teams.

Vi arbejder i krydsfeltet mellem forretning og teknologi og bygger integrationer og API-services, der binder vores forretningssystemer sammen.

Vi arbejder tæt sammen med bl.a. BizApps (Power Platform/Dynamics 365), ERP (D365 Business Central), Data (MS DWH/Fabric) og Digital Marketing – og vi lægger vægt på kvalitet, samarbejde og en kultur med højt til loftet.

Det er derfor vigtigt at du ikke kun bringer stærke tekniske kompetencer ind i rollen, men også meget gerne en solid forretningsforståelse, og helt sikkert en vilje til at lære.

Om stillingen

Som Cloud Developer får du et bredt ansvar, hvor du både sætter teknisk retning, skaber overblik og omsætter arkitektur til virkelighed. Du bliver en nøgleperson i arbejdet med at udvikle og vedligeholde vores cloud‑principper, patterns- og standarder – og du hjælper teams og stakeholders med at træffe de rigtige tekniske valg.

Samtidig er du hands-on udvikler og deltager aktivt i design og implementering af C#/.NET baserede løsninger i Azure, herunder API’er, integrations-flows og eventdrevne komponenter baseret på messaging og asynkrone mønstre.

Du arbejder især med de forretningskritiske og komplekse dele af platformen, hvor robusthed, skalerbarhed og driftssikkerhed er afgørende.

Dine primære ansvarsområder

Cloud‑strategi og arkitektur: Udvikle og vedligeholde skalerbare cloud‑arkitekturprincipper og standarder (primært Microsoft-teknologi).
Thought leadership: Være et fagligt fyrtårn og bidrage til retning, kompetencesikring og best practices i CID’s virke.
Governance & compliance: Sikre overholdelse af sikkerhed, lovgivning og interne retningslinjer i cloud‑miljøer.
Innovation og optimering: Identificere nye teknologier og metoder, der skaber forretningsværdi og reducerer omkostninger.
Samarbejde og rådgivning: Arbejde tæt sammen med udviklingsteams, arkitekter og stakeholders for at sikre helhedsorienterede løsninger – og proaktivt drive integrations‑ (og evt. AI-) initiativer.
Automatisering og drift: Drive automatisering, DevOps-principper og Infrastructure as Code.
CI/CD og platform: Vedligeholde og videreudvikle CI/CD-processer og tekniske processer på tværs af vores services.
AI, udvikling og anvendelse Det forventes at du har erfaring med AI i tooling, anvendelse og kvalitetssikring. Det vil være en fordel med erfaring fra AI udviklingsprojekter, men ikke et krav.

Teknologier og værktøjer

Vores stack er Microsoft- centreret og inkluderer typisk:

Azure (Cloud development, Functions, integrationer, Service Bus, API Management, Redis Cache)
Cloud Architecture / platform design
Azure DevOps / CI/CD
.NET / C# og API design
Power Platform / Dynamics 365 (tæt samarbejde og integrationsflader)
Github Enterprise

Din profil

Vi forestiller os, at du:

Har solid erfaring med Azure og cloud arkitektur i praksis (gerne integrations-/platformfokus)
Har solid erfaring med C# / .NET
Har erfaring med API’er, integrationer og event‑baserede patterns
Har stærk forståelse for DevOps, CI/CD, automatisering og IaC
Kan kombinere arkitektur og rådgivning med evnen til at få ting til at ske i praksis
Trives i et tværgående setup med mange stakeholders og kan kommunikere klart – også på engelsk
Taler flydende dansk og kommunikerer ubesværet på engelsk i skrift og tale
Tager end-to‑-end ansvar for løsninger ud fra et “you build it, you own it”‑ princip, fra ‑C#kode‑ og arkitekturvalg til drift, overvågning og løbende forbedringer

Du tilbydes

Mulighed for at arbejde i hjertet af et forretningskritisk applikations- og integrationslandskab
Indflydelse og ansvar i et selvstyrende team med fokus på samarbejde og trivsel
En international virksomhed i vækst med spændende digitaliseringsinitiativer
Tæt sparring med erfarne kolleger og mulighed for at præge Kvik’s cloud og integrationsrejse

Praktisk

Arbejdssted: Risskov ved Aarhus (Mosevej 3 B, 8240 Risskov).

new_jobs.description:
Job Description

Senior Platform Engineer
– Public 360° – Tieto Indtech (m/f/d)

Tieto Public 360° – building secure, scalable digital services for the public sector across the Nordics.

About The Company

Tieto's Public 360° is a leading case management platform used across the Nordic public sector for over 20 years. Since 2014, the SaaS platform has been running on modernized Azure infrastructure with automated deployments while also supporting on-prem/hybrid/Domestic cloud installations.

The 360° Platform Currently Powers Three Solutions

Public 360° – Case and archive management

Plan & Build 360° – Building permit applications

eArchive 360° – Long-term data storage

The challenge

We're building on Public 360°'s modern foundation to expand across multiple cloud environments—strengthening Nordic digital sovereignty and enabling AI capabilities, all while maintaining the highest requirements for security and compliance.

The role

As a Senior Platform Engineer, you'll advance the technical capabilities of the 360° hosting platform. You'll design and operate cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes platforms, automation, and security systems that support continued growth and enable new AI-powered features.

Key Responsibilities

Build and operate the cloud platform foundation supporting Public 360° across Public Cloud and Domestic Cloud environments.
Deploy, manage, and continuously improve Kubernetes-based platforms and containerized workloads.
Drive automation through Infrastructure as Code (Bicep), GitOps, CI/CD, and self-service platform capabilities.
Establish secure and scalable platform services covering networking, identity, secrets management, monitoring, and operational governance.
Improve reliability and operational excellence through observability, automation, incident management, and best practices.
Support the modernization of Public 360° through cloud-native technologies, APIs, messaging, and microservices architectures.

Required Qualifications

Several years of experience in Platform Engineering, Cloud Engineering, DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering, or similar roles.
Strong Azure and cloud-native platform experience.
Strong hands-on Kubernetes experience, including:
Cluster deployment, installation, and lifecycle management.
Operations, upgrades, troubleshooting, and maintenance.
Networking, security, and scalability.
Experience operating Kubernetes in cloud, on-premises, or domestic cloud environments.

Experience with Microsoft Azure services, particularly AKS, cloud networking, security monitoring, logging, and observability platforms.
Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Bicep, Terraform or similar), GitOps, and CI/CD using Azure DevOps and/or GitHub.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with sovereign, domestic cloud, hybrid cloud, or other highly regulated environments.
Familiarity with messaging technologies such as RabbitMQ, Kafka, or Azure Service Bus.
Experience with Keycloak or other identity and access management platforms.
Experience operating distributed systems, microservices architectures, or multi-region Kubernetes environments.
Exposure to AI platform infrastructure, intelligent automation, or GenAI technologies.

Tech we use

We are Azure-first and automation-driven, building and operating our platform using Kubernetes (AKS), Docker, containers, GitOps, and Infrastructure as Code with Bicep. Our engineering teams use Azure DevOps and GitHub Workflows for CI/CD and automation, supported by Azure networking and cloud security services. We focus heavily on observability and reliability, using Grafana, Prometheus, Loki, and Alloy for monitoring and telemetry. Authentication and authorization are managed through Keycloak, while RabbitMQ provides messaging capabilities across our platform. Our API and ingress layer is built on technologies such as APISIX and NGINX, with certificate management handled through OpenBao and cert-manager. Development is primarily done using .NET (C#), TypeScript/JavaScript, PowerShell, and Bash, with Visual Studio and Visual Studio Code as our primary development tools.

Why join us

Build technology that improves citizen services across the Nordic public sector.
Work with modern cloud technologies and large-scale enterprise software.
Join a highly skilled and collaborative engineering environment with significant influence on technical decisions.
Opportunity to shape the future platform capabilities supporting Public 360°.
Professional growth through international collaboration, technical leadership opportunities, and continuous learning.
A culture built on trust, transparency, ownership, and innovation.

Practicalities

Location and work setup:
Flexible/hybrid, ideally near one of our development hubs in Scandinavia (Oslo, Stockholm, Copenhagen, or Espoo).

Language requirements:
Fluent English required. Nordic language skills are considered an advantage.

Are you our new colleague?

We look forward to hearing from you! We will fill the position as soon as we find the right person, so we encourage you to apply today.

If you have any questions regarding this role, please contact the hiring managers Ida Sirevaag
(ida.sirevaag@tieto.com) or Geir Are Bjørnsrud
(geirare.bjornsrud@tieto.com)

Additional Information

At Tieto, we believe in the power of diversity, equity, and inclusion. We encourage applicants of all backgrounds, genders (m/f/d), and walks of life to join our team, as we believe that this fosters an inspiring workplace and fuels innovation. Our commitment to openness, trust, and diversity is at the heart of our mission to create digital futures that benefit businesses, societies, and humanity.

new_jobs.title: Frontend Developer
new_jobs.description:
Shape the experience thousands of Danes use every day.

At Spillehallen.dk ApS — part of the Gaming group— we're looking for a developer who cares as much about how something feels as about how it's built.

This is not a role where someone hands you a Figma file and a ticket. You will sit close to the people who talk to our customers every single day, and close to the people who bring them here. You'll see the friction first-hand, form your own opinion about it, and then go fix it in the product.

You'll report directly to our CTO, but your everyday rhythm is set by Commercial Operations — Customer Center and Marketing. That's deliberate. The fastest way to build a better product is to sit where the problems actually surface.

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

- Improve the user experience on Spillehallen.dk: flows, navigation, forms, onboarding, responsiveness, accessibility and performance. You'll propose changes, not just implement them.
- Design and build in the same motion. Wireframe it, prototype it, build it in React and TypeScript, ship it, measure it.
- Work in Umbraco. Build and maintain page types, blocks, templates and components so Marketing and Customer Center can create and adjust content themselves, without a developer in the loop.
- Build AI-driven automated testing. Help us raise the bar on regression and end-to-end coverage using modern AI-assisted testing tooling, so we can ship faster with more confidence.
- Handle the real work that comes with a live platform: campaign pages, content structures, self-service improvements, small internal tools, and the quick fixes that make a colleague's day easier.
- Reduce support load by design. Fewer confusing screens means fewer tickets.
- Contribute to technical decisions on frontend architecture, design system and component structure.

OUR TECHNOLOGY

React, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML5 and CSS, Umbraco, .NET / C#, REST APIs, Microsoft SQL Server, Docker, Azure DevOps and Pipelines, Git.

We already use AI-assisted development tools such as Codex in our daily work, and we're actively expanding into AI-driven testing. We want colleagues who are genuinely excited about that shift — not sceptical bystanders, and not uncritical believers either.

WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

We're describing a strong junior or an aspiring senior: someone with a couple of years of real, professional experience who is clearly on the way up and wants a place with room to grow fast.

new_jobs.title: Sr Staff Software Engineer
new_jobs.description:
What if the work you did every day could impact the lives of people you know? Or all of humanity?

At Illumina, we are expanding access to genomic technology to realize health equity for billions of people around the world. Our efforts enable life-changing discoveries that are transforming human health through the early detection and diagnosis of diseases and new treatment options for patients.

Working at Illumina means being part of something bigger than yourself. Every person, in every role, has the opportunity to make a difference. Surrounded by extraordinary people, inspiring leaders, and world changing projects, you will do more and become more than you ever thought possible.

Summary

At Illumina, we are expanding access to genomic technology to realize health equity for billions of people around the world. Our efforts enable life-changing discoveries that are transforming human health through the early detection and diagnosis of diseases and new treatment options for patients.

Sequencing has moved genomics from single studies to population scale. Multi-million-sample cohorts, linked phenotypes and multi-omic data are now generated faster than most organizations can analyze them. Our team builds the data platform and the analytical applications that turn these assets into products: a cloud-native lakehouse for genomic and phenotypic data, large-scale statistical genetics pipelines that run reliably at population scale, and the APIs and user interfaces that let scientists ask questions of billions of records and get answers in seconds.

We are looking for a Sr. Staff Software Engineer for this effort in Singapore: someone who can take state-of-the-art analytical methods and turn them into scalable, high-performance, commercial software, and who can work fluently across bioinformatics scientists, cloud infrastructure engineers, and product management. You will work with a globally distributed team, prototyping quickly, demonstrating early, and iterating toward a releasable product.

Responsibilities

Turn advanced statistical genetics methods (for example, genome-wide and phenome-wide association testing for both common and rare variants) from prototypes into high-performance, scientifically accurate, commercially releasable products.
Design and implement analysis pipelines that scale to millions of samples on a cloud-native lakehouse, and establish the standardized, reusable design pattern for low-latency analysis on open table formats at petabyte scale.
Deliver the APIs, web UI and natural-language/agentic query interfaces through which scientific users explore association results and cohort/phenotype data interactively at scale.
Own the operability and unit economics of the platform: orchestrate, monitor, debug and cost-optimize workloads spanning millions of concurrent jobs, designing for fault tolerance and reproducible results.
Partner with bioinformatics scientists, cloud infrastructure teams and product management to translate scientific and customer needs into a product architecture and credible delivery plan aligned with the platform and data business strategy, applying a clear view of what distinguishes a commercial-grade offering from research and open-source community tooling.
Set technical direction and raise engineering standards through design review, mentorship and hands-on contribution, prototyping and iterating rapidly with a customer-first mindset across a globally distributed team.

Requirements

Degree in Computer Science / Engineering / Bioinformatics / Mathematics or a related field.
Demonstrated experience designing and delivering large-scale, data-analysis production software in the cloud (AWS, Azure, or GCP), including containerization (Docker), orchestration, infrastructure automation, and CI/CD.
Strong experience with modern data lake / lakehouse architectures, including open table format internals rather than usage alone: Apache Iceberg or Delta Lake table specifications, catalog services, snapshot lifecycle, partitioning and pruning strategy, compaction, and schema evolution, over columnar storage (Parquet) with distributed query engines (for example Spark, Trino, Databricks).
Solid algorithms and systems engineering foundation, with proven ability to implement performance-critical code in a compiled language such as C/C++, including concurrency, memory management, vectorization and SIMD, and work with columnar in-memory formats and vectorized engines such as Apache Arrow, DuckDB, or Velox.
Proven track record of profiling and optimizing end-to-end systems for runtime, memory, I/O and cloud cost at large scale, and of designing for horizontal scalability.
Proficiency in Python for rapid prototyping, data analysis, and productionized tooling, with familiarity with the scientific and ML/DL library ecosystem.
Experience designing and operating distributed batch and workflow systems that manage very large numbers of concurrent jobs, including metrics, tracing and structured logging, retry, checkpointing and idempotency, and failure triage at million-task scale.
Experience with scientific workflow languages and engines (for example Nextflow, WDL, CWL) and with execution on cloud batch or Kubernetes.
Experience designing and delivering service APIs with an API-first approach: REST or gRPC interface design, versioning and backward compatibility, and multi-tenant access patterns; plus enough full-stack fluency to partner on (or build) modern web front ends and to hold strong opinions on UI/UX for data-heavy scientific applications.
Experience validating numerically and statistically sensitive software: concordance testing against reference implementations, calibration checks, benchmark suites, versioned reference data, and end-to-end reproducibility.
Proven technical leadership and influence at senior level, with strong verbal and written communication skills, and the ability to self-manage and manage interdisciplinary relationships.
Demonstrated experience using AI tooling to plan, manage and accelerate the full software development lifecycle, and to materially increase engineering productivity and quality.

Experience / Education

Sr. Staff Software Engineer: Typically requires a minimum of 12 years of related experience with a Bachelor's degree; or 8 years and a Master's degree; or a PhD with 5 years experience; or equivalent experience.

Desired

Working knowledge of statistical genetics and population genomics: genome-wide and phenome-wide association studies, common and rare variant analysis (including gene-based burden and aggregate tests), mixed-model and whole-genome regression approaches, and the standard data formats and quality control practices of the field (VCF/gVCF, PLINK, BGEN, summary statistics, cohort and phenotype definition, ancestry and relatedness handling).
Hands-on experience with genomics-native storage and query stacks such as TileDB / TileDB-VCF, Hail, GLOW, or GenomicsDB.
Experience delivering commercial or clinical-grade genomics or life-science data products, including taking an internal or research tool through to a commercially released product, and a clear understanding of the differences in philosophy, obligations and trade-offs between commercial productization and academic, non-profit or research-community tooling.
Familiarity with techniques for low-latency query over very large result sets: precomputed summary indices, bitmap and zone maps, sketching, and tiered materialization.
Experience building agentic workflows and products, including tool/agent orchestration and MCP-style integrations, over enterprise data; and with machine learning, deep learning or foundation model training applied to genomic or biomedical data.
Experience implementing data governance controls: role-based and row/column-level access, audit trails, tenant isolation, and consent-driven restrictions on data use.
Experience with interactive data visualization for very large result sets, and with modern front-end frameworks.
Cloud cost engineering: cost-per-analysis modelling, spot and preemptible capacity strategy, storage tiering, and egress management.
Be curious, detail oriented, and analytical, with a proven ability to learn quickly.
Be customer-focused, team-oriented, and motivated, taking ownership of assigned tasks and of ambiguous problems.

Listed responsibilities are an essential, but not exhaustive, list of the usual duties associated with the position. Changes to individual responsibilities may occur due to business needs.

Software Engineer

Despre noi

Suntem un start-up care sprijină SOLOprenorii în drumul lor spre succes. Despre ce este rolul?

Construim un produs folosit deja de zeci de mii de oameni și vrem să-l ducem la următorul nivel.

Problema pe care o rezolvăm nu e simplă: legislație complicată, multe excepții și așteptări mari de la utilizatori.

Căutăm un engineer care vrea să contribuie la soluții reale și să crească într-un mediu cu impact direct în produs.

Misiunea ta în acest rol

Vei lucra pe probleme reale ale utilizatorilor noștri , unele bine definite, altele în curs de clarificare
Vei contribui la implementarea și îmbunătățirea sistemelor existente
Vei colabora cu echipa pentru a livra funcționalități în producție
Vei participa la decizii tehnice și vei învăța cum să le iei în timp
Vei folosi AI în workflow-ul tău pentru a crește viteza și calitatea

Ce ne dorim de la tine

2–4 ani experiență în dezvoltare software;
Experiență cu backend (ideal .NET Core, dar nu obligatoriu);
Experiență cu baze de date relaționale și modelare de date;
Capacitatea de a lucra pe probleme care nu sunt complet definite;
Interes pentru produs și modul în care este folosit de utilizatori;
Te folosești de AI (Cursor, Claude, Copilot sau similar) pentru a-ți îmbunătăți modul de lucru și înveți să validezi output-ul.

Ce oferim

Salariu competitiv (în funcție de nivel);
Zile nelimitate de concediu (pe care le și folosim);
Program flexibil;
Abonament premium la clinicile medicale Regina Maria;
Abonament Bookster;
Acces la tool-uri AI (Claude, Cursor, Copilot etc.) și buget de utilizare;
Lucrăm hibrid din București. Poți lucra până la 2 zile pe săptămână de acasă. În perioada de probă, te așteptăm zilnic la birou: e cea mai rapidă cale să înțelegi contextul, să cunoști echipa, și să ajungi să livrezi pe cont propriu.

Despre cum lucrăm în general

Modul În Care Lucrăm Este Influențat De Valorile În Care Credem Și Pe Care Ne Propunem Să Le Aplicăm În Tot Ce Facem

Creșterea continuă și accelerată e ceva fundamental - ne așteptăm de la fiecare coleg să își dorească să se dezvolte și să profite pe deplin de toate resursele pe care le punem la dispoziție pentru învățare. Apoi, ne așteptăm ca fiecare coleg să fie interesat mai ales de rezultat, nu doar de efort în sine.
Clientul este în centrul activității noastre: îi înțelegem nevoia reală, îl tratăm cu empatie și alegem soluții simple și clare pentru el. Facem toate acestea în timp ce ne comportăm cu bunăvoință unii față de alții, oferim și acceptăm feedback și menținem și consolidăm un spirit de echipă în care să ne regăsim cu toții.
Fiind un start-up, ne dorim alături oameni energici, curajosi, autonomi, cu o gândire dincolo de tipare, cu simțul umorului și cu o mare flexibilitate mentală, pentru că adesea realitatea din jur și activitățile noastre de zi cu zi se schimbă din mers în timp ce direcția rămâne clară: suntem aici pentru a sprijini SOLOprenorii.

new_jobs.title: Fullstack Software Engineer (x/f/m) - Global Architecture
new_jobs.description:
Health can’t wait
.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance.
Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a
unique culture
. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 800+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

🤘 How we do it ?

About

People joining Alan are always surprised and delighted by our innovative working method. We have a set of cultural values that guide our approach to work, such as:

🎯 What drives us - We're obsessed with helping members live healthier

Mission is the Boss
: long-term thinking, mission above all else
Member & customer-led
: obsessed with solving problems and delighting users

🏆 How we build excellence - We hire the best and empower them to succeed

Champions of excellence
: extremely high standards and talent density
Distributed ownership
: everyone owns their decisions and results
Radically transparent
: all information accessible, written-first, async decisions

🤝 How we grow together - We improve through honest feedback and bold thinking

Optimistic alchemy
: optimists who collaborate with genuine care
Empathetic challengers
: direct, caring feedback to help each other grow
Bold contrarians
: think differently, try new approaches

⚡ How we move fast — We fight complexity and focus on what matters

Disciplined execution
: decisive action with compounding focus
Fight for simplicity
: high-impact processes, smart frugality

⭐ The Engineering team ⭐

In our engineering team, we build the infrastructure, interfaces, and applications to provide first-class service to our members, health professionals, and even ourselves!

Being an engineer at Alan means joining a team of talented, committed and passionate engineers, with a lot of product interaction.

We move fast, with a lot of ownership, and are proud to tackle big problems!

Our process is very simple: those who make product decisions are the same ones who build them.

Our stack is Python/Flask, React, React Native, PostgreSQL.

Want to know more? Read this article if you want to discover how life as an Engineer at Alan and this article on our Engineering career path.

🌐 Enabling Global-First product development

In Alan's early expansion, we made a strategic decision to create separate codebases for each country we ventured into. This approach allowed us to quickly adapt and tailor our applications to meet the unique healthcare and regulatory requirements of France, Belgium, Spain, and Canada.

In 2024, we reached a crucial point where it was essential to merge these codebases into global, configurable modules
. Yet, writing local code is still easier than building global solutions. The Global Architecture team is central to this transformation — our goal is to enable any team at Alan to develop and launch features seamlessly across markets, as outlined in our 2025 technical strategy.

🚀 Your mission

Design Cross-Cutting Modules
You'll transform country-specific implementations into elegant global components that will become the new building blocks of other teams to build global features
Remove Technical Blockers for Product Teams
You’ll tackle technical blockers that cut across several domains and eliminate the need for team-specific workarounds, allowing product teams to focus on their core business
Orchestrate Data Transformations
You'll implement strategies to harmonize different countries' data models without losing local flexibility and consolidate existing data into unified schemas
Build and Own What You Create
You'll be responsible for the entire lifecycle of your solutions, from initial design through long-term maintenance. We don't just design — we build, deploy, and maintain what we create

🌟 Why This Role Matters

Focus on High-Impact, Cross-Domain Solutions
You work exclusively on blockers that span multiple business domains that are heavily depended upon. This means every solution you build has an impact across multiple teams
Enable Teams, Don't Replace Them
Your job isn't to substitute other teams or globalize everything. Instead, you'll work on technical obstacles that prevent teams from building global-first solutions and work with them to remove those obstacles
Learn and Share Globalization Patterns
As you design and implement global solutions, you'll develop an expertise in globalization patterns. You'll share these learnings with other teams, helping them make better decisions about global vs. local solutions in their own work

🚀 What we're looking for

You write code and maintain what you build. At Alan there is no architect in an ivory tower, we implement what we design
You’re able to navigate complex systems spanning multiple business domains and technical boundaries
You've worked with diverse architectural patterns and can articulate the nuanced trade-offs between them
You can spot technical obstacles that are blocking multiple teams and design solutions that remove those obstacles

⭐ Is it you we’re looking for?

We are looking for problem-solver engineers with 5+ years of experience who get excited about simplifying complex business problems:

You’ll be able to tackle high-impact & high-risk projects involving many engineers.
You’ll design efficient systems and engineering practices to align with and facilitate interactions between multiple teams/products.
You’ll have the opportunity to mentor other engineers & lead crews (more details in this article).
You’ll be able to contribute to hiring your future coworkers and shape candidates’ hiring experience (improving our technical assessment process etc...)

You would be a good fit at Alan if most of this sounds like you:

Well-versed in Object Oriented Programming such as Python, Java, C#, and enthusiastic about web technologies such as modern Javascript.
Willing to work in Python/JavaScript (but you don’t need to have experience with those 2 languages!).
Passionate about building products.
Self-starting and entrepreneurial.
Humble and still willing to grow (no matter your seniority!).
Collaborative, enthusiastic about teamwork, learning, and teaching.
Fluent in English (no need to speak French!).

For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the D-F level range.

But above all, we are looking for high potential and curiosity: make sure to show us this when you apply! Everything else is a bonus.

🙌 Perks & Benefits

At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need,
and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time
with co-workers.

Therefore, we offer:

Fair rewards
. Generous equity packages complement your base salary.
Flexible Office
. Amazing office space at our HQ, sponsored co-working hubs or a full-remote experience with home office equipment sponsorship, we want you to live where you’re the happiest.
All the tools you need
. Top of the range equipment: Macbook Pro, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and noise-canceling headphones.
Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours
. Organize your time as you wish.
Delightful healthcare insurance:
Extremely comprehensive health insurance - 100% for you and your children, 90-100% for partners depending on your country (permanent contracts only).
Transport
. Country-specific commuter benefits.
Learning & Training opportunities.
A highly flexible Training policy free books and budget to attend and speak at conferences if the opportunity arises.
Personal growth through coaching
: At Alan, coaching isn't just a perk -
it's core to who we are. Every Alaner is paired with a dedicated coach from day one, who helps maximize their impact, nurture engagement, and navigate Alan's values to develop their full potential.
Learn more about our coaching culture
.

Parental leave.
Extended parental leave for all new parents.

Important note: we hire people, not roles.

If you're excited about this opportunity but don't check every box, we'd love to hear from you.
Everyone, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply as it can only bring learnings or success.

If you identify yourself as a woman
: Did you know that research shows women often apply only when meeting 100% of requirements?

Remember, this is just a guide, not a checklist.

We'll be thrilled to receive your application!

Erlebe das Beste aus zwei Welten: Unser Geschäftsfeld Post Business Solutions agiert als starker B2B Digital Services Provider im sicheren Konzernumfeld der Österreichischen Post AG. Gesundheit & Arbeitsumfeld: Ganzheitliche Gesundheitsförderung mit vielfältigen Maßnahmen sowie ein kollegiales und krisensicheres Arbeitsumfeld

Du entwickelst und betreibst gemeinsam mit dem Team eine stabile, sichere und skalierbare Container-Plattform.
Du automatisierst Infrastruktur- und Betriebsprozesse mithilfe von Infrastructure as Code, CI/CD-Pipelines und Skripting.
Du analysierst wiederkehrende Incidents und Betriebsprobleme und sorgst für nachhaltige Lösungen statt kurzfristiger Workarounds.
Du identifizierst Automatisierungs- und Optimierungspotenziale und reduzierst manuelle Tätigkeiten.
Du arbeitest an modernen Deployment- und Betriebsstrategien für bestehende und neue Anwendungen.
Du unterstützt die Modernisierung unserer gewachsenen Systemlandschaft und bringst dein Know-how im Bereich Plattform-Engineering ein.
Du dokumentierst Lösungen, teilst dein Wissen im Team und bringst neue Ideen ein.

Du bringst Erfahrung mit Containern und Container-Plattformen mit.
Du verfügst über gute Linux-Kenntnisse und Erfahrung mit automatisierten Deployment- und Betriebsprozessen.
Du hast bereits mit Infrastructure as Code gearbeitet oder möchtest dein Know-how in diesem Bereich gezielt ausbauen.
Du hast idealerweise Erfahrung in C#, Blazor und oder CI/CD-Plattformen
Du interessierst dich für Cloud-native-Technologien, moderne Plattformarchitekturen und komplexe Systemlandschaften.
Du analysierst gerne Ursachen, denkst lösungsorientiert und arbeitest erfolgreich im Team.
Kenntnisse in Azure sowie Tools wie Terraform, Ansible, Bicep sind von Vorteil, aber kein Muss

new_jobs.title: Senior Full Stack Engineer (m/f/d)
new_jobs.description:
About Cakewalk

Cakewalk is access management for the entire workforce: AI agents and human identities. We built a single platform to govern and secure access in companies through policy-first access management, runtime provisioning, and identity-linked lifecycles.

We are looking for a Senior Full-Stack Engineer (m/f/d) to join our ambitious engineering team and help accelerate our product development.

You will join a team of 10 engineers as a senior individual contributor, reporting to an Engineering Manager. This role is for someone who combines technical strength, grit, and self-reflection, and who is excited to take meaningful ownership in a fast-moving environment.

About the Role

As a Senior Full-Stack Engineer, you will build and improve customer-facing functionality across our frontend and backend. You will own features from early product discussions through implementation, testing, release, and ongoing maintenance.

You will collaborate closely with Product and Customer Success to understand customer needs and turn them into reliable, maintainable solutions. You will also help us improve and expand our AI-augmented engineering workflows while remaining fully accountable for the quality, security, and architecture of the resulting code.

The approximate focus of the role is:
45% backend engineering
25% frontend engineering
20% AI tooling and agentic engineering workflows
10% infrastructure and platform engineering

What You’ll Do

Build and own product functionality
Design, build, test, and release new frontend and backend features.
Take end-to-end ownership of your work, including technical design, implementation, testing, documentation, deployment, and maintenance.
Make sound architectural decisions around design patterns, reusable components, APIs, data models, and system boundaries.
Help expand a product that governs access for both human users and AI agents.

Contribute to product development
Collaborate with Product during the early stages of feature design.
Provide both technical and functional input on proposed solutions.
Work closely with Customer Success to understand customer needs and implementation challenges.
Translate customer and product requirements into reliable technical solutions.

Advance AI-augmented engineering
Use AI-assisted development tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, or comparable IDE-integrated agents to build, test, document, and review software.
Work with our existing agentic engineering workflows and help improve and expand them.
Create and maintain reusable agent skills, contextual instructions, and related patterns that accelerate development and promote architectural consistency.
Standardize the context provided to coding agents through approaches such as AGENTS.md, skills, and similar mechanisms.
Maintain strict human-in-the-loop accountability for code quality, security, and architectural decisions.
Act as the final reviewer of AI-generated output and ensure that it meets our engineering standards.

Maintain a high quality bar
Write clean, reliable, secure, and maintainable code.
Apply effective testing practices.
Review code critically, regardless of whether it was written by a human or generated with AI assistance.
Treat bugs as an immediate priority. We do not knowingly leave defects in the platform: when we identify a bug, we fix it.
Contribute to technical documentation and Architecture Decision Records.
Communicate technical decisions and trade-offs clearly across engineering and non-engineering teams.

What We Expect

You should have:
At least four years of professional experience as a Full-Stack Engineer.
Strong professional experience building backend services and single-page web applications.
Strong experience with TypeScript, React, C# and .NET Core or closely comparable frontend technologies.
Practical experience using AI-assisted coding tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, or comparable development agents.
Experience managing or contributing to agentic development workflows.
A strong understanding of domain-driven design and experience applying it to production systems.
Strong experience designing and consuming REST APIs.
A good understanding of HTTP, OAuth, OpenID Connect, encryption, and API security.
Experience making data-informed technical decisions and clearly explaining the reasoning and trade-offs behind them.
Experience writing technical documentation, including Architecture Decision Records.
Experience implementing integration testing strategies.
Experience working with component libraries or design systems such as Material UI, styled-components, or comparable technologies.
An understanding of LLM capabilities and limitations, together with the analytical skills needed to verify and refine AI-generated solutions.
Fluent English and the ability to communicate comfortably with both technical and non-technical colleagues.
Availability during our core collaboration hours of 10:30 a.m.–5:00 p.m. CET.

A bachelor’s degree in software engineering, computer science, or a related subject is an advantage, but not a strict requirement.

Prior experience in Identity and Access Management or cybersecurity is not required. However, we expect the security awareness and foundational understanding appropriate for a senior software engineer.

Our Technology

Our current technology stack includes:

Frontend
TypeScript
React
Material UI
TanStack Query

Backend
C#
.NET Core
PostgreSQL
Redis
RabbitMQ

Platform and observability
AWS
Kubernetes
Grafana
Sentry

Our system is organized around modular monoliths and domain-driven design. We value engineers who understand architectural trade-offs and can help the system evolve as the product and organization grow.

What Success Looks Like

In your first three months
You will:
Develop a solid understanding of our codebase and engineering practices.
Build a strong foundational understanding of the Identity and Access Management domain.
Release your first backend feature.
Release your first frontend feature.
Begin contributing effectively to product and technical discussions.

After 6–12 months
You will:
Operate autonomously as a senior individual contributor.
Collaborate directly with Product to understand customer needs.
Turn those needs into well-designed, reliable, and maintainable software.
Own features throughout their complete lifecycle.
Contribute meaningfully to the evolution of our architecture and engineering practices.
Improve and expand our AI-assisted and agentic development workflows.

Some of the challenges you may work on include integrations with different products, protocols, AI agents, Model Context Protocol servers, and other emerging technologies.

Our Principles

Put Simplicity First
Our reason for existing is to simplify IAM. We make our product intuitive and powerful, our customer interactions valuable, and our internal processes efficient. We support our coworkers to ensure our collective success.

Think Big. Iterate Fast. Reflect Openly.
We focus on what is possible, prioritize outcomes over busy activity, and work in short cycles. We value deep thinking, radical transparency, and root-cause analysis over blame.

Everyone Sells Cakewalk
We are a product-driven organization, but our North Star is commercial success. Everything we do is ultimately for our customers.

Enjoy the Baking
Building a company is a challenge. We are here to win, but also to enjoy the ride. We foster an environment of growth and collaboration with fantastic humans.

What You Can Expect

An environment where strong reasoning and execution matter more than titles.
A technically pragmatic team that challenges the status quo in security and cares deeply about both product and sales.
Colleagues who combine brilliance in their fields with grit and self-reflection.
Teammates who support one another so that everyone can contribute their best work.
Direct collaboration with Product and Customer Success throughout the development process.
Founders who take a genuine interest in their people, build long-term relationships, and support every Cakewalker’s professional and personal growth.

Interviewing at Cakewalk

During the interview process, we want to understand:
Whether you can drive meaningful technical impact.
How you approach challenging engineering problems.
How you make and communicate technical decisions.
Whether our culture and working style align with the environment in which you do your best work.
How you can grow professionally and personally at Cakewalk.
How AI has affected your engineering workflow and judgment.

We openly use AI in our engineering work, but we place a high value on genuine human interaction. Please do not use AI tools during live interview conversations. It is always better to acknowledge that you do not know something than to rely on AI for an immediate answer.

Be prepared to discuss engineering principles, design patterns, clean architecture, domain-driven design, testing strategies, API design, and API security. We will be interested in your decision-making process, how you solve problems, and how you write and review code.

When sharing examples from your experience, we recommend using the CARR model:
Context: What was the situation or problem?
Action: What did you do?
Results: What was the outcome?
Reflection: What did you learn, and how did you grow?

Humility drives learning. During the process, you may receive direct feedback. We value candidates who listen carefully, reflect openly, and apply what they learn.
Before interviewing, we encourage you to learn about Cakewalk, our product, and the Identity and Access Management industry. Think about what distinguishes our approach and how your experience could help us build the governance layer for a workforce made up of both humans and AI agents.

A Final Note

We welcome candidates with different backgrounds and experiences. Studies have shown that people from underrepresented groups are less likely to apply unless they meet every listed qualification.
If you are excited about Cakewalk and believe you can succeed in this role, we encourage you to apply and allow our team to assess your experience.

new_jobs.title: Senior II Back-End Engineer
new_jobs.description:
We power people’s progress.

At Preply, we’re all about creating life-changing learning experiences. We help people discover the magic of the perfect tutor, craft a personalised learning journey, and stay motivated to keep growing. Our approach is human-led, tech-enabled - and it’s creating real impact.

We’ve just reached unicorn status with a $150M Series D, accelerating our vision to transform education through human-led, AI-enhanced learning. Today, 100,000+ tutors teach 90+ languages to learners in 180 countries - and we’re only getting started. As a category-defining company, we’re shaping what the future of learning looks like at global scale.

Every Preply lesson sparks change, fuels ambition, and drives progress that matters. Joining Preply means helping define the future of education at global scale, and building something that truly matters for millions of people, every day.

Meet the team!

Join Preply’s Teams and help us power people’s progress through life-changing learning experiences. We’re on a mission to combine the magic of the best tutors with cutting-edge AI to create personalized journeys that keep learners motivated and inspired.

The Preply Engineering Team
provides the tools to help unlock human potential through learning. We implement A/B tests to prove the value of our initiatives and improve our product based on data and students' and tutors' feedback. As part of our commitment to ensuring high-quality products, we prioritize monitoring and metrics analysis to identify areas for optimization and ensure our services are performing at their best.

As a Senior II Backend Engineer,
you'll drive technical direction across multiple squads, lead high-impact initiatives, and build the systems that power Preply's global growth engine. Your work will influence how we scale our platform, align teams around shared outcomes, and help millions of learners connect with tutors worldwide.

Python is our primary language, but prior experience with it isn't mandatory. We take a tech-agnostic approach and welcome engineers from various backgrounds, such as Java, Node.js, Ruby, Scala, .NET, PHP, or Go. What we truly look for is an eagerness to learn the language and the adaptability to hit the ground running with product development.

What You’ll Be Doing

Own, shape, and drive technical direction across multiple engineering squads.
Lead complex, ambiguous initiatives from idea to delivery, aligning engineers, teams, product managers, and stakeholders around shared outcomes.
Design, build, and evolve scalable backend systems using Python/Django, data pipelines, and third-party integrations that support long-term business growth.
Partner with PMs, EMs, and senior stakeholders to shape roadmaps, make technical trade-offs, and guide investment decisions.
Raise the engineering bar through mentoring, architectural reviews, and engineering best practices.
Drive reliability, observability, performance, and operational excellence across multiple services and teams.
Foster a quality-first culture through automation, documentation, and continuous improvement.
Participate in on-call rotation (1 week every 5 weeks).

What You Need To Succeed

Exposure to architectural patterns of a large, high-scale web application (e.g., well-designed APIs, high-volume data pipelines, efficient algorithms);
Proven experience leading complex, greenfield projects end-to-end
A track record of shaping architectural decisions and setting engineering standards that impact multiple teams or domains.
Comfort with shaping product scope, challenging requirements, and focusing on customer value.
Strong communication (English level B2+) with the ability to influence senior peers and leadership through clear reasoning and strong technical judgment.
AI Expertise: You're a forefront user of Agentic AI. You're able to bring hands on experience and start influencing the team beyond code generation; reserving judgment for architecture, business logic, and security, using AI as a thought partner and able to set up quality gates and safety nets to enhance existing engineering workflows and propose AI-native alternatives.
Willingness to join your team's on-call rotation (1 week out of every 5).

Why you’ll love it at Preply

An open, collaborative, dynamic, and diverse culture.
A generous monthly allowance for lessons on Preply.com, Learning & Development budget, and time off for your self-development;
A competitive financial package with equity, leave allowance, and health insurance;
Not in Barcelona? We offer an attractive relocation package to join us in our Preply Barcelona Hub;
Access to free mental health support platforms;
Access to Gympass-partnered wellness and gym centers throughout Spain to promote and support well-being and physical health;
The opportunity to shape the lives of learners and tutors through language learning and teaching in 175 countries (and counting!).

Our Principles

Care to change the world - We are passionate about our work and care deeply about its impact to be life changing.
We do it for learners - For both Preply and tutors, learners are why we do what we do. Every day we focus on empowering tutors to deliver an exceptional learning experience.
Keep perfecting - To create an outstanding customer experience, we focus on simplicity, smoothness, and enjoyment, continually perfecting it as every detail matters.
Now is the time - In a fast-paced world, it matters how quickly we act. Now is the time to make great things happen.
Disciplined execution - What makes us disciplined is the excellence in our execution. We set clear goals, focus on what matters, and utilize our resources efficiently.
Dive deep - We leverage business acumen and curiosity to investigate disparities between numbers and stories, unlocking meaningful insights to guide our decisions.
Growth mindset - We proactively seek growth opportunities and believe today's best performance becomes tomorrow's starting point. We humbly embrace feedback and learn from setbacks.
Raise the bar - We raise our performance standards continuously, alongside each new hire and promotion. We build diverse and high-performing teams that can make a real difference.
Challenge, disagree and commit - We value open and candid communication, even when we don’t fully agree. We speak our minds, challenge when necessary, and fully commit to decisions once made.
One Preply - We prioritize collaboration, inclusion, and the success of our team over personal ambitions. Together, we support and celebrate each other's progress.

Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion

Preply.com is committed to creating an inclusive environment where people of diverse backgrounds can thrive. We believe that the presence of different opinions and viewpoints is a key ingredient for our success as a multicultural Ed-Tech company. That means that Preply will consider all applications for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, age or veteran status.
